entries.translation: 战士

entries.english: +Damnation: It grants the ability to hurl damnation at the cost of health and magic, with strength depending on Evocations skill.
entries.translation: +天谴: 允许消耗生命与魔力投掷地狱火，强度取决于唤发技能。

entries.english: Anguish:   It makes its victims' attacks reflect back on them.
entries.translation: 痛楚: 使受害者的攻击反射回自身。

entries.english: Chaos Arc: It occasionally unleashes arcs of chaos on nearby creatures upon striking a foe.
entries.translation: 混沌电弧: 命中敌人时，偶尔会向附近生物释放混沌电弧。

entries.english:
Corpsefed: It gathers nearby corpses to temporarily increase the armour it provides.
rMiasma:   It protects you from foul pestilence.
entries.translation:
食尸: 收集附近的尸体，暂时提高其提供的护甲值。
抗瘴气: 保护你免受污秽瘟疫侵害。

entries.english: Curses:    It inflicts powerful necromantic curses on any living foe it strikes.
entries.translation: 诅咒: 对命中的活物施加强大的死灵诅咒。

entries.english: Damnation: Any ammunition fired from it explodes in a burst of damnation on striking a foe, dealing damage which bypasses armour.
entries.translation: 天谴: 射出的弹药命中敌人时，会爆发天谴，造成无视护甲的伤害。

entries.english: Dark:      It shrouds the wearer in darkness, reducing the range at which they can see and be seen by others.
entries.translation: 黑暗: 以黑暗笼罩穿戴者，缩小其视野及被其他生物看见的距离。

entries.english: Disarm:    It may disarm weapon-wielding foes when striking them, dealing extra damage in the process.
entries.translation: 缴械: 命中持有武器的敌人时，可能将其缴械，并在此过程中造成额外伤害。

entries.english: Discharge: It occasionally unleashes powerful arcs of lightning upon striking a foe. These may arc to other adjacent creatures (including the wielder, but dealing reduced damage to them) before grounding out.
entries.translation: 放电: 命中敌人时，偶尔释放强大的闪电电弧；电弧可能传导至其他相邻生物（包括持有者，但对其造成的伤害较低），之后才导入地面。

entries.english: Disrupt:   It unleashes wild and unpredictable magical effects upon striking a wizard or a creature with magical abilities.
entries.translation: 扰魔: 命中法师或具有魔法能力的生物时，释放狂野而难以预测的魔法效果。

entries.english: Ele:       It enhances your fire, ice, earth and air magic. If skilled in Evocations, you can discharge powerful blasts of elemental energy when striking with it.
entries.translation: 元素: 增强你的火系、冰系、土系与气系魔法。若擅长唤发，还能在近战命中时释放强大的元素能量。

entries.english: Envenom: If the wielder is skilled in Evocations, they can envenom those struck by it, dealing poison damage which bypasses armour.
entries.translation: 灌毒: 若持有者擅长唤发，可使命中的目标受到无视护甲的毒素伤害。

entries.english:
Freeze:    It freezes victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour. It may also slow down cold-blooded creatures.
Rev:       It becomes more effective when it hits something. This effect fades over time.
entries.translation:
冻结: 冻伤目标，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一，还可能使冷血生物迟缓。
加速: 命中目标时会变得更有效；此效果随时间消退。

entries.english: Freezing Cloud: It occasionally leaves clouds of freezing vapour upon striking a foe, and grants immunity to clouds of freezing vapour.
entries.translation: 冰冻云雾: 命中敌人时，偶尔留下冰冻云雾，并使持有者免疫冰冻云雾。

entries.english:
Gadgeteer:   Your evocable items recharge 30% faster and wands have a 30% chance to not spend a charge.
Wandboost:   Your wands are more powerful.
entries.translation:
巧匠: 可发动道具的充能速度提高 30%，魔杖有 30% 几率不消耗充能。
魔杖强化: 你的魔杖更强大。

entries.english: Hellfire Court: It may summon demons of flame and damnation when striking foes.
entries.translation: 地狱火宫廷: 命中敌人时，可能召唤掌控火焰与天谴的恶魔。

entries.english:
It massively reduces your stealth.
It interferes with translocations, delaying teleports.
Charlatan: It boosts your other skills by 20% of your base Evocations skill.
entries.translation:
大幅降低你的潜行。
干扰位移魔法，使传送延迟。
骗术: 按你的基础唤发技能的 20% 提高其他技能。

entries.english: Prune:     It halves damage taken while paralysed, petrified or unconscious.
entries.translation: 普鲁恩: 在麻痹、石化或昏迷时，使受到的伤害减半。

entries.english:
Radiate: It can be activated via the 'a'bility menu to radiate toxic energy, with effectiveness depending on Evocations skill.
Alch: It enhances your alchemy magic.
rPois∞: It grants immunity to poison.
entries.translation:
毒能辐射: 可通过能力菜单（a）发动毒能辐射，效果取决于唤发技能。
炼金: 增强你的炼金术。
毒免疫: 使你免疫毒素。

entries.english:
Note: If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags with the Tiles
version of Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup, scroll down to the end of this file.


Tiles specific commands
-----------------------

There are several different ways to interact with your environment, both
by typing the command keys, and by using the mouse.

Of notable interest is the clickable tab area to the right of the screen
that allows easy access to e.g. inventory, spells, or common commands.

Depending on your screen resolution, one of more of these panels may be
open at any time, though you can temporarily exchange the inventory view
with another type of tiled panel by clicking on the tab icons.

You can customize the priority of the control panels by modifying the
tile_layout_priority option in init.txt in the settings directory.


Movement
--------

You can move by using the arrow keys, the vi-keys, or the number pad.
(For the latter try both Numlock on and off.)

Numpad:   7 8 9     vi-keys:   y k u
           \|/                  \|/
          4-.-6                h-.-l
           /|\                  /|\
          1 2 3                b j n


To run several steps into the same direction, press Shift along with these
keys.

You can also move by clicking somewhere on the map or minimap with your
mouse. If the square is reachable from your current position and there are
no hostile monsters in sight, you will automatically travel there. If there
are hostile monsters in sight, you will only take a single step at a time.

For automatic exploration, you can either type the 'o' command or you can
click on the corresponding tile in the command panel to the right of your
screen. Like mouseclick travel, these will refuse to work if there are
hostile monsters in sight.


Getting information
-------------------

Doing a right-click with your mouse on any feature, monster or item on the
main map or in the tiled control panels will display the description of
said feature, monster or item on a separate screen.

A simple mouseover will usually display the same description, or as much of
it as can fit, in the message area.

Similarly, letting your mouse rest for a while on a feature, monster or
item will usually display a "tool tip" of applicable commands.


Attacking monsters
------------------

You can attack a monster in melee by moving into it with the movement keys
or by clicking on it with your mouse.

For ranged attacks (including spells and wands), mouse over the monsters
and wait for the tool tip to appear. Alternatively, you can cast spells by
clicking on the spell tiles in the spell panel, or fire ammunition or
evoke wands by clicking on them in the inventory panel.

In the command panel, you'll also find a tile described as "Autofight",
which, if clicked, will attack an adjacent monster in melee, or if there is
no adjacent monster, take one step in the direction of the closest monster.


Item usage
----------

The easiest way to use items is by clicking on them in the inventory panel.
The mouseover tool tip will tell you what a mouseclick will do, and also
the corresponding command key to execute the same action.
As an alternative, you can also use an item by selecting it in the inventory
('i' command) and then pressing the appropriate key in the action prompt.

To pick up items on the ground, you can either click on them one by one in
the floor section of the inventory panel, or you can click on the player
tile and pull up a menu of selectable items instead. In the latter case,
'Enter' will confirm your selection and start pick up.

Dropping items works similarly, either by clicking on single items in the
inventory panel, or by typing the 'd' command and then selecting items
from a menu.


Interacting with the dungeon
----------------------------

Again, doing a mouseover on features (such as staircases or doors) in the
main map will tell you how to interact with them.


Character status
----------------

Doing a right-click on the player tile will display a character overview
screen listing equipment, resistances and stats.

More detailed screens on specific aspects of your characters can be
accessed by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the command panel.


Character appearance
--------------------

You can change your character's appearance with the Doll Editor, accessed with
the '-' command. Use 'm' to switch between modes: Equip, where your appearance
dynamically updates based on the items you equip; Default, a sprite based on
your character’s race and background; and Custom, which allows you to fully
customize each part of your character's look. Use the number keys to switch
between custom doll slots and the arrow keys to modify the different parts of
each custom sprite. Save your changes and selection with 'Ctrl-S'.



If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags...
--------------------------------------------------------

Crawl renders its graphics using OpenGL and SDL. However, it needs hardware
acceleration to not run slowly. If you are on Windows, make sure to update
your graphics card driver. If you are on Linux, be sure that you are using
DRI.

It has been tested successfully with cards as old as the i865. Unfortunately,
it has been known to be slow on the i810 and there is little to be done in
that case but to run the console version instead or switch to a different
machine.

You can try tweaking a number of options in init.txt in the settings
directory to see whether performance improves:

travel_delay = -1
    This setting suppresses redrawing until travelling is finished or
    interrupted.

tile_update_rate = 1000
    By default, the screen gets redrawn at least every 1000 milliseconds,
    more often if you take actions that change the display. You could try
    cranking up this value, though this may lead to updating taking too long.

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    While running and resting the screen is redrawn every 17 milliseconds.
    If Crawl is slow while running or resting, increase this number.

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    Deactivating the tooltips means there's less stuff to draw every time.

clear_map = false
    Not having to redraw remembered monsters outside your line of sight
    takes some load off the redrawing routines.

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    The larger the map area the more cells there are to redraw each turn.
    If you've got a large display showing way more than the necessary 17x17
    grids of the map, you could try specifying a lower resolution.
entries.translation:
注意：若图形版 Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup 明显变慢或卡顿，请阅读文末的性能说明。



图形版专用操作
--------------

你可以用键盘命令或鼠标与周围环境交互。

屏幕右侧可点击的标签页能方便地打开物品栏、法术或常用命令面板。

根据屏幕分辨率，可能同时显示一个或多个面板。点击标签图标，可以暂时把物品栏面板
切换为其他图形面板。

修改 settings 目录中 init.txt 的 tile_layout_priority 选项，可以调整控制面板
的优先顺序。


移动
----

可用方向键、vi 按键或数字小键盘移动。小键盘可尝试开启或关闭 Numlock。

小键盘：  7 8 9     vi 按键： y k u
           \|/                \|/
          4-.-6              h-.-l
           /|\                /|\
          1 2 3              b j n

按住 Shift 再按方向键，可以向同一方向连续行走。

也可以用鼠标点击地图或小地图上的位置。如果该位置可以到达，且视野内没有敌对怪
物，就会自动前往。如果视野内有敌对怪物，则每次只会迈出一步。

按 o 或点击右侧命令面板中的自动探索图标，即可自动探索。与点击地图旅行一样，
视野内有敌对怪物时不能使用。


获取信息
--------

右键点击主地图或控制面板上的地形设施、怪物或物品，会打开其说明界面。

将鼠标移到相应位置，通常也会在消息区显示相同说明，或显示消息区容得下的部分。

将鼠标在地形设施、怪物或物品上停留片刻，通常会出现列出适用命令的提示框。


攻击怪物
--------

使用方向键朝怪物移动，或用鼠标点击怪物，即可进行近战攻击。

进行远程攻击（包括法术和魔杖）时，可把鼠标移到怪物上并等待提示框出现。也可以
点击法术面板的法术图标施法，或点击物品栏面板中的弹药、魔杖进行发射或发动。

命令面板中还有名为 Autofight（自动战斗）的图标。点击它会近战攻击相邻怪物；若
没有相邻怪物，则向最近的怪物迈出一步。


使用物品
--------

最方便的方法是在物品栏面板中点击物品。悬停提示会说明点击的效果，以及执行相同动
作的键盘命令。

也可以按 i 打开物品栏，选择物品，再按操作提示中相应的按键。

拾取地上物品时，可以在物品栏面板的地面区域逐个点击，也可以点击角色图标，打开物
品选择菜单。后者按 Enter 确认选择并开始拾取。

丢弃物品的方式类似：在物品栏面板中点击单件物品，或按 d 后在菜单中选择物品。


与地下城交互
----------

将鼠标移到主地图上的楼梯、门等地形设施，同样会显示如何与其交互。


角色状态
--------

右键点击角色图标，可以打开角色概览，查看装备、抗性和属性数值。

点击命令面板中的相应图标，可以查看角色各方面的详细信息。


角色外观
--------

按 - 打开角色外观编辑器。按 m 切换模式：Equip（装备）会根据穿戴物品动态更新
外观；Default（默认）使用由种族和背景决定的图像；Custom（自定义）允许逐个调
整外观部件。

用数字键切换自定义外观槽位，用方向键修改各个部件。按 Ctrl-S 保存修改和当前选
择。


若游戏明显变慢或卡顿……
--------------------------

Crawl 使用 OpenGL 和 SDL 绘图，需要硬件加速才能流畅运行。Windows 用户应更新
显卡驱动；Linux 用户应确认正在使用 DRI。

游戏曾在 i865 等较老显卡上成功运行；但已知 i810 的运行速度较慢。这种情况下，
通常只能改用字符版或换一台机器。

可尝试调整 settings 目录中的 init.txt，观察下列选项能否改善性能：

travel_delay = -1
    旅行结束或中断之前不重绘画面。

tile_update_rate = 1000
    默认至少每 1000 毫秒重绘一次；执行改变画面的动作时会更频繁。
    可以尝试增大此值，但可能导致画面更新不够及时。

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    连续行走或休息时，每 17 毫秒重绘一次。
    若行走或休息时卡顿，可增大此值。

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    关闭悬停提示，减少每次需要绘制的内容。

clear_map = false
    不重绘视野外记忆中的怪物，可减少重绘负担。

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    地图区域越大，每回合需要重绘的格子越多。
    若大屏显示的地图远大于所需的 17x17 格，可以尝试降低分辨率。

entries.english:
Crawl Quick-Start Guide
=======================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


So, you want to start playing Crawl straight away without bothering with the
manual? Read this, the guide to starting Crawl with a minimum of preparation.

I suggest printing it out and following its instructions while playing your
first few games (you can also press `?` twice while playing for a list of
commands). You should also try the tutorial mode; it only takes a few
minutes.

When you get some more time, you can read `crawl_manual.txt` in the docs/
directory for more detailed information.

INTRODUCTION TO CRAWL
---------------------

Crawl is a large and very random game of subterranean exploration in a fantasy
world of magic and frequent violence. Your quest is to travel into the depths
of the Dungeon (which is different each time you play) and retrieve the Orb of
Zot.

Crawl is an RPG of the `rogue-like` type, one of the descendants of Rogue. Its
graphics are simple but highly informative, designed to be understood at a
glance, and control is exercised largely through one-keystroke commands.

STARTING OUT
------------

After starting the program you will be greeted with a message asking for your
name. Don't spend too much time over this, as your first character will **not**
last very long (sorry, but it's true).

Next you are given menus of species and backgrounds from which to choose.
A mountain dwarf, minotaur or troll Fighter is a good bet. Elves are quite
fragile, humans are pretty average at everything, and the weirder species are
mostly too tricky for beginning players. Finally, you may be given a choice of
weapons. I suggest an axe (axes are fun).

Now you are in the game. The game screen has three parts:

 - the Map takes up the upper left part of the screen. In its very centre is
   the `@` sign (or player doll tile) which represents You. The bright parts of
   the Map are the parts you can see, while places which you have visited
   before but cannot currently see are darkened.
 - the Message box is the large part of the screen below the map. It describes
   events as they happen and asks you questions from time to time.
 - the Stats area (to the right of the Map) contains various indicators of
   your health and abilities.

EXPLORING
---------

Try walking around, using either the numeric keypad (try numlock off and on) or
the Rogue (`hjklyubn`) keys. Pressing `o` will activate auto-explore, which will
move until an enemy is seen, or some other notable event (e.g. finding a set of
stairs) occurs.

If you want to know what a certain character on the screen represents, you can
use the `x` (examine) command to get a short description, and then `v` to get
more information. You use the `O`, `C` commands to open or close doors, and the
`<` (up) and `>` (down) commands to climb staircases.

The Dungeon gets more dangerous (but more interesting!) as you go down. If you
get lost you can access a map of the whole level you are on with the `X`
command, which uses the whole screen.

ITEMS
-----

After walking around for a while, you will no doubt come across some items
lying around (you may come across some monsters as well; for help in dealing
with them skip to the Monsters section). You can pick up items with the `g`
(get) or `,` commands and drop them again with `d` (drop), and the `i`
(inventory) command shows you what you're carrying. While examining your
inventory, press any item's key to see more information about it, and to list
available commands.

There are several different types of items:

 - **Weapons**, represented by the `)` sign. Wield them with the `w` (wield)
   command.
 - **Armour** (`[`). Wear it, or take it off, with the `W` (Wear) command.
   Heavier armours give more protection, but may hamper your ability to dodge,
   cast spells, or fire ranged weapons.
 - **Ammunition** (which has the `(` sign). Throw it with `f` and `F` (fire).
 - **Wands** (`/`), **Scrolls** (`?`) and **Potions** (`!`) can be very
   valuable, but have limited uses (scrolls and potions can only be used once
   each, wands contain only a certain number of charges). Wands are e`V`oked,
   scrolls are `r`ead and potions are `q`uaffed. Unfortunately, you won't at
   first know what a scroll or potion does; it will only be described by its
   physical appearance. But once you have used, for example, a potion of curing,
   you will in the future recognise all potions of curing.
 - **Rings** (`=`) and **Amulets** (`"`) provide various mostly-helpful effects.
   They are put on with `P` (put on) and can be removed with `R`.
 - **Money** (`$`) can be used to buy stuff in shops.

There are a few other types of items, but you will discover these as you play.

MONSTERS
--------

You will also run into monsters (most of which are represented by letters of
the alphabet). You can attack a monster by trying to move into the square it
is occupying. Pressing Tab will automatically move toward & attack nearby
monsters.

When you are wounded you lose hit points (displayed near the top of the stats
list); these return gradually over time through the natural process of
healing. If you lose all of your hp you die.

To survive, you will need to develop a few basic tactics:

 - Rest between encounters. The `s`, `.`, delete or keypad-5 commands make you
   rest for one turn, while pressing `5` or Shift-and-keypad-5 make you rest
   for a longer time (you will stop resting when fully healed).
 - Never fight more than one monster if you can help it. Always back into a
   corridor so that they must fight you one-on-one.
 - Consumable items like scrolls and potions won't do you any good when you're
   dead, and most are more effective when used at the start of a tough fight
   than when you're near death. Try identifying some ahead of time by 'wasting'
   one from a stack while in a safe spot.
 - Remember to use projectiles before engaging monsters in close combat.
 - Learn when to run away from things you can't handle - this is important!
   It is often wise to skip a dangerous level. But don't overdo this.

DEATH
-----

Before long, you'll probably end up dead.

Death in Crawl is permanent; you cannot just reload a saved game and start
again where you left off. The `S` (save) command exists only to let you leave
a game part-way through and come back to it later. Quitting (`Ctrl-Q`) lets
you abandon a character if you can't even be bothered to help them escape alive.

Well, that's it for the quick-start guide. This should help you through your
first few games, but Crawl is extremely (some would say excessively) complex
and cannot be adequately described in so short a document. So when you feel
ready to start playing with magic, skills, and religions, browse the manual.

Happy Crawling!
entries.translation:
Crawl 快速入门
================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


不想先读手册，想直接开始玩 Crawl？这份指南会帮你以最少的准备开始冒险。

建议把它打印出来，在最初几局游戏中边玩边参考。游戏中连续按两次 `?`，
也能查看命令列表。还应试试教程模式，只需几分钟。

有空时，可以阅读 docs/ 目录中的 `crawl_manual.txt`，了解更详细的信息。

CRAWL 简介
------------

Crawl 是一款规模庞大、随机性很强的地下探索游戏。这个奇幻世界充满魔法，
也时常充斥暴力。你的任务是深入每局都不相同的地下城，取回佐特宝珠。

Crawl 是 `rogue-like` 类型的角色扮演游戏，是 Rogue 的后继者之一。
画面虽然简单，却信息丰富，力求一目了然；操作大多只需按一个键。

开始游戏
----------

启动程序后，会先询问你的名字。不必花太多时间，因为你的第一个角色
**不会**活得很久（抱歉，但这是事实）。

接下来从菜单选择种族和背景。山地矮人、牛头人或巨魔战士都不错。
精灵比较脆弱，人类各方面都很平均，更奇异的种族则大多不适合新手。
最后，可能还需要选择武器。推荐斧头，因为斧头很好玩。

现在你进入游戏了。游戏画面分为三个部分：

 - 地图位于屏幕左上方。正中央的 `@`（或角色图标）代表你。
   明亮部分是当前能看到的区域；曾去过、现在看不到的地方则会变暗。
 - 消息区位于地图下方，占据较大空间。它会叙述事件，并不时询问你。
 - 状态区位于地图右侧，显示生命、能力等各种指标。

探索
------

试着用数字键盘（可尝试开关 Numlock），或 Rogue 的 `hjklyubn` 键移动。
按 `o` 会启动自动探索，持续移动，直到看见敌人或发生其他值得注意的事件，
例如发现楼梯。

想知道屏幕上某个字符代表什么，可以按 `x` 查看简述，再按 `v` 阅读详情。
用 `O`、`C` 开门或关门，用 `<` 上楼、`>` 下楼。

地下城越深，越危险，也越有趣！迷路时可按 `X` 打开占满屏幕的楼层地图。

物品
------

走一会儿，你一定会发现地上的物品，也可能遇见怪物；应对怪物的方法见后文。
用 `g` 或 `,` 拾取，用 `d` 丢弃，用 `i` 查看携带物品。
在物品栏中按物品对应的键，可以查看详情和可用操作。

物品主要分为以下几类：

 - **武器**以 `)` 表示。按 `w` 持用。
 - **防具**以 `[` 表示。按 `W` 穿上或脱下。
   越重的防具通常防护越好，但可能妨碍闪避、施法或远程武器射击。
 - **弹药**以 `(` 表示。用 `f` 和 `F` 投射。
 - **魔杖**（`/`）、**卷轴**（`?`）和**药水**（`!`）可能非常有价值，
   但使用次数有限：卷轴和药水各只能使用一次，魔杖则只有一定次数的充能。
   按 `V` 唤发魔杖，按 `r` 阅读卷轴，按 `q` 喝药水。
   最初你不知道卷轴或药水的效果，只能看到外观描述。
   例如使用过一瓶治疗药水后，以后就能认出所有治疗药水。
 - **戒指**（`=`）和**护身符**（`"`）提供各种效果，大多有益。
   用 `P` 戴上，用 `R` 摘下。
 - **金币**（`$`）可以在商店购物。

还有一些其他物品类型，你会在游戏中逐渐发现。

怪物
------

你也会遇见怪物，大多用字母表示。朝怪物所在方格移动，就会攻击它。
按 Tab 会自动靠近并攻击附近怪物。

受伤时，你会损失生命值，显示在状态列表上方附近。
生命值会随时间自然恢复；生命耗尽，你就会死亡。

要活下去，你需要掌握一些基本战术：

 - 战斗之间要休息。`s`、`.`、Delete 或数字键盘 5 可休息一回合；
   按 `5` 或 Shift 加数字键盘 5 可长时间休息，完全恢复后会停止。
 - 尽量不要同时与多只怪物作战。退入走廊，让它们只能逐一与你交战。
 - 死后，卷轴和药水等消耗品就帮不上忙了。多数消耗品在艰难战斗开始时
   使用，比濒死时才用更有效。可以在安全处“浪费”同一叠中的一个来提前鉴定。
 - 与怪物近战前，记得先用投射物攻击。
 - 学会在无法应付时逃跑，这一点很重要！跳过危险楼层往往是明智之举，
   但也别过分依赖这种做法。

死亡
------

过不了多久，你大概就会死去。

Crawl 中的死亡是永久的，不能重新载入存档，从原处再来。
`S` 保存命令只是为了让你中途离开，以后继续同一局游戏。
如果连帮角色逃生都不想费心了，可以用 `Ctrl-Q` 放弃角色。

快速入门到此结束。它应该能帮你度过最初几局，但 Crawl 极其复杂，
有人甚至觉得复杂过头，无法用这么短的文档说清楚。
准备开始尝试魔法、技能和信仰时，请翻阅手册。

祝你冒险愉快！

entries.english:
Macros and Keymaps
==================

What are macros and keymaps? The simple explanation is:

Command macros make keys into commands.
Keymaps make keys into other keys.

Or a bit more verbose:

For the most part, people will probably want command macros. They allow
for things like making a key run a sequence of commands (e.g.
associating a key stroke to the casting of a certain spell) without
having to worry about messing up what that key does at prompts (e.g.
you can macro a number or letter without worrying about it making the
substitution when you're trying to drop an item).

Keymaps are for when you want to fix layout and behavioural problems on
your keyboard (i.e. unrecognised numpad sequences can by mapped into
their numbers, foreign keyboard layouts can be modified to be more
comfortable). There are also special sets of keymaps for the level map,
the targeting mode and confirmation prompts, which allow for mappings
that are restricted to just those situations.


How to create macros and keymaps?
=================================

The simplest way is in-game: Press either the '~' key or Ctrl-D, select
'm' to define a macro, then choose a key to assign for your macro and
enter the command sequence. For some keys (or key combinations), Crawl
will display a strange number (for example \{13} for the Return key).
These numbers are the key codes for certain non-alphanumeric keys and
can vary between different systems.

By default, most upper- and lowercase alphanumeric keys are already
assigned functions in Crawl. While you are free to remap those keys as
well, it might be best to start with some of the currently unused keys,
such as Ins or the function keys (F1 to F12), possibly combined with
Ctrl, Shift or both. On some systems, it may also be possible to
incorporate the Alt (Meta) key.

Defining keymaps works in exactly the same way. Just press 'k'
(default), 'x' (level-map), 't' (targeting) or 'c' (confirmation)
instead of 'm' after pressing '~'.

After defining such a macro or keymap, you should test it. If you are
comfortable with it, you should then save the macro. To save all macros
and keymaps, press '~' and then 's' to save macros at the tilde prompt).


The macro.txt file
==================

Macros and keymaps are stored in a file called macro.txt in your
settings/ directory. You can change where the file is read from and
written to by specifying a different directory with the macro_dir
option in your init file (see options_guide.txt for details). The
macro.txt file is human readable and editable, but you might have to
figure out the key codes for non-alphanumeric keys through in-game
experimentation or external utilities.

Lines beginning with the '#' are comments and will be ignored. Note
that Crawl won't necessarily preserve your comments when saving macros
and keymaps to the macro.txt file.

Each macro definition consists of exactly two lines. The first one
describes the macro trigger key and consists of "M:" followed by the
character or keycode of that key (for example 'a', 'A' or \{9} for
the A, Shift-A or Tab keys). The second one describes the macro action
and consists of "A:" followed by the command sequence to be associated
with the above key (for example "zap" for zapping the spell in slot a
at the previous target). Individual macro definitions should be
separated by empty lines.

For keymaps just replace the "M:" on the first line of the definition
with one of the following:
"K:"  default,
"K1:" level-map,
"K2:" targeting or
"K3:" confirmation.


Examples
========

This section contains some examples to give you an idea what macros and
keymaps can be used for. Note that for the sake of completeness, both
key line and command line are given, but that you should probably
substitute your own keys here as these may not always work for you.


'@' is a character that may not work by default on some keyboard
layouts. The following should remedy that by mapping '@' to '@'.

# @: display character status
K:\{17}
A:@


Playing a summoner can be annoying because you often need to cast the
same spells multiple times in a row, each casting requiring multiple
keystrokes. This macro allows casting the spell in slot 'a' with a
single keystroke. Note that you can redefine spell slots with the '='
key. We emphasise again that the F1 key may get a different code on
your system.

# F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{368}
A:za


Now that we've taken care of summoning, we still need to command our
summoned creatures. The following macro should make that easier as
well. Note that this macro assumes that the default_target option is
set to true (it is by default; see crawl_options.txt for details).

# Tab: Order allies to attack your previous or the nearest target
M:\{9}
A:ta.


Conjurers need a slightly different macros for casting, such as this
one, as they need to press '.' or Return to confirm firing at a target.
Again, this macro assumes that the default_target option is set to
true.

# F1: cast spell 'a' at your previous or the nearest target
M:\{368}
A:za.


However, even conjurers might not always want to fire at their previous
target, so the following set of macros allows them to cast the spell
in slot 'a' and then cycle through the available targets with the same
key and then confirming with the same key we used for firing in the
previous macro. This example also tries to illustrate how to take
advantage of the fact that keys can have different functions in the
different keymaps.

# Shift-F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{1392}
A:za

# Shift-F1: cycle through targets when in targeting mode
K2:\{1392}
A:+

# F1: fire at target when in targeting mode
K2:\{368}
A:.
entries.translation:
宏与键位映射
==============

什么是宏和键位映射？简单来说：

命令宏把按键变成一串命令。
键位映射把按键变成其他按键。

更详细地说：

多数人需要的是命令宏。它可以让一个按键执行一串命令，例如施放某个法术，
而不必担心改变这个按键在提示框中的含义。例如，你可以把数字或字母设为宏，
却不必担心在丢弃物品时也发生替换。

键位映射用于解决键盘布局和行为问题。例如，把无法识别的数字键盘序列
映射为对应数字，或调整外语键盘布局，让操作更顺手。
楼层地图、选目标模式和确认提示还各有专用映射集，可以只在特定情境下生效。


如何创建宏与键位映射？
========================

最简单的办法是在游戏中操作：按 `~` 或 Ctrl-D，选择 `m` 定义宏，
再选择触发按键，输入命令序列。有些按键或组合键会显示成奇怪的数字，
例如 Return 键显示为 \{13}。这些数字是某些非字母数字键的按键码，
不同系统可能不同。

Crawl 默认已经为多数大小写字母和数字键分配了功能。虽然也可以重新映射，
但最好先用尚未占用的键，例如 Ins 或 F1 至 F12，也可以组合 Ctrl、Shift，
或同时使用这两个修饰键。有些系统还支持 Alt（Meta）。

定义键位映射的方法完全相同：按 `~` 后，不选 `m`，而是选 `k`（默认）、
`x`（楼层地图）、`t`（选目标）或 `c`（确认提示）。

定义后应先测试。如果用起来合适，就保存宏。要保存全部宏与键位映射，
按 `~`，再在提示中按 `s` 保存。


macro.txt 文件
================

宏与键位映射保存在 settings/ 目录的 macro.txt 中。
在初始化文件中设置 macro_dir，可以改变读写此文件的目录，
详情见 options_guide.txt。macro.txt 可以直接阅读和编辑；
但非字母数字键的按键码，可能需要在游戏中试验或借助外部工具确定。

以 `#` 开头的行是注释，会被忽略。请注意，Crawl 将宏与键位映射写回
macro.txt 时，不一定保留你的注释。

每个宏定义恰有两行。第一行定义触发键，由 "M:" 加该键的字符或按键码组成。
例如，A、Shift-A 和 Tab 可分别写成 'a'、'A' 和 \{9}。
第二行定义宏动作，由 "A:" 加关联的命令序列组成，例如 "zap" 表示
对上一个目标施放 a 栏位的法术。不同宏定义之间应以空行分隔。

定义键位映射时，将第一行的 "M:" 替换为以下前缀之一：
"K:"  默认映射，
"K1:" 楼层地图，
"K2:" 选目标，或
"K3:" 确认提示。


示例
======

下面的例子展示宏与键位映射的一些用途。为了完整，同时列出触发键行和
命令行；这些按键不一定适用于你的系统，实际使用时可能需要换成自己的键。


某些键盘布局默认无法正确输入 '@'。下面的映射把 '@' 映射到 '@'，
应能解决这个问题。

# @: display character status
K:\{17}
A:@


召唤师经常需要连续多次施放同一法术，每次又要按好几个键，可能有些烦人。
下面的宏用一个按键施放 'a' 栏位的法术。按 '=' 可以重新指定法术栏位。
再次提醒，F1 在你的系统上可能对应不同按键码。

# F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{368}
A:za


解决了召唤，还需要指挥召唤物。下面的宏也能简化这项操作。
它假定 default_target 为 true；默认确实如此，详情见 crawl_options.txt。

# Tab: Order allies to attack your previous or the nearest target
M:\{9}
A:ta.


塑能师的施法宏略有不同，因为需要用 '.' 或 Return 确认发射。
这个宏同样假定 default_target 为 true。

# F1: cast spell 'a' at your previous or the nearest target
M:\{368}
A:za.


不过，塑能师也并非总想攻击上一个目标。下面这组宏可以施放 'a' 栏位的法术，
用同一个键循环选择目标，再用上例中发射法术的那个键确认。
本例也展示如何利用同一按键在不同映射集中可以具有不同功能的特性。

# Shift-F1: cast spell 'a'
M:\{1392}
A:za

# Shift-F1: cycle through targets when in targeting mode
K2:\{1392}
A:+

# F1: fire at target when in targeting mode
K2:\{368}
A:.

entries.english:
A: They may be in a part of the level that is not reachable from the upstairs
you came from. Try going up to the previous level and coming back down from
there via a different set of stairs. Note that most levels feature three
downstairs as well as three upstairs, not counting any escape hatches.

Alternatively, if you are in one of the branches, you might also have reached
its lowest level and have to turn around to explore another one. Check the
dungeon overview ('Ctrl-O') to see how deep you've delved into a given branch,
or the database ('?/b') for the number of levels for unseen branches.
entries.translation:
答：下楼梯可能位于本层另一片区域，从你来时的上楼梯无法到达。试着先返回上一层，再换一组楼梯下来。多数楼层有三处下楼梯和三处上楼梯，不计逃生舱口。

如果你身处某个分支，也可能已经到了底层，需要折返探索其他分支。查看地下城总览（'Ctrl-O'）可以知道自己深入各分支多少层；描述数据库（'?/b'）则可查询尚未见过的分支有多少层。

entries.english:
A: There isn't any such option, and we're not planning to add one, either.

Keep in mind that you don't absolutely have to fight every monster you
meet, and with ghosts it's even easier: they are generated in sealed
vaults, and it is your choice whether to open each ghost vault.

Alternatively, you could play a couple characters of strong species/background
combinations for the sole purpose of busting those ghosts, e.g. Troll
Berserkers. Or play online, where you'll mostly be killed by others' ghosts
instead!
entries.translation:
答：没有这个选项，我们也不打算添加。

请记住，你不必击败遇见的每一只怪物。对幽灵而言，避战更容易：它们出现在封闭的密室内，你可以自行决定要不要打开每一间幽灵密室。

你也可以专门用强力的种族与背景组合玩几局来清理幽灵，例如巨魔狂战士。或者改玩在线版，那样杀死你的主要就会是其他玩家的幽灵了！

entries.english:
A: First, you might want to read the philosophy section in the manual ('?N') to
read about general important principles in Stone Soup's game design.

As for specific differences, the most important are probably the following:

* Species is *much* more important than the character background (or "class").

* Bones files only contain ghosts, never their equipment or cause of death.

* You cannot sell items to shops or elsewhere.

* Resistances can be gained via mutations or items, never through eating.

* There are inevitable deaths, but new players can win without spoilers, if
  they learn from their mistakes. Very good players can win several consecutive
  games.

Also, our aim is to give Crawl a really smooth interface, so you should really
read through the command list ('??') some time. The following commands are
particularly convenient:

* 'o', for automatic exploration of an unknown level

* 'G', for automatic travel to another level ('G?' for help)

* 'X', to access the level map for travelling and other tasks ('X?')

* 'Ctrl-F', to find and travel to items you've seen before ('Ctrl-F?')

* 'Tab', to move towards or attack the nearest monster
entries.translation:
答：首先，可以阅读手册中的设计理念部分（'?N'），了解 Stone Soup 游戏设计所遵循的重要原则。

具体而言，最重要的区别大概有：

* 种族的影响*远大于*角色背景（或“职业”）。

* 遗骨文件只保存幽灵，不会保存其装备或死因。

* 你不能向商店或其他地方出售物品。

* 抗性可以通过变异或物品获得，不能通过进食获得。

* 有些死亡无法避免，但新玩家只要能从错误中学习，即使不看剧透也能获胜。顶尖玩家可以连续赢下多局。

我们也希望 Crawl 的界面十分顺手，因此建议找时间通读命令列表（'??'）。以下命令尤其方便：

* 'o'：自动探索未知楼层

* 'G'：自动前往另一楼层（'G?' 查看帮助）

* 'X'：打开楼层地图，用于旅行及其他操作（'X?'）

* 'Ctrl-F'：查找以前见过的物品并前往其位置（'Ctrl-F?'）

* 'Tab'：走向或攻击最近的怪物

entries.english:
A: If you've got trouble even reaching the Temple, you might want to try a game
or two in hints mode for some general playing hints.

Also, there are easy playing combinations and more challenging ones (marked in
dark grey on the selection screen). If you are new to Crawl, sticking to the
easier ones is advisable. In general, treat each new monster you meet with
utmost caution, try to choose the location where you fight monsters, and keep
an eye on your health and magic.

For specific hints dealing with a particular character, you can press '#'
in-game to create a "character dump" in your morgue directory that details your
equipment, items, skilling, and available spells. You can share this with other
players to get feedback and advice through any of the community discussion
resources listed at http://crawl.develz.org/.
entries.translation:
答：如果连抵达众神殿都很困难，可以先玩一两局提示模式，了解一些基本建议。

有些种族与背景组合比较容易，另一些则更具挑战性（在选择界面以深灰色标出）。新玩家最好先选容易的组合。一般来说，每遇到一种新怪物都应格外谨慎，尽量选择交战地点，并时刻留意自己的生命与魔力。

若想获得针对某个角色的具体建议，可以在游戏中按 '#'，在 morgue 目录生成“角色信息导出文件”，其中详列装备、物品、技能训练和可用法术。你可以通过 http://crawl.develz.org/ 列出的社区讨论渠道，把文件分享给其他玩家，听取反馈与建议。

entries.english:
A: Crawl renders its graphics using OpenGL and SDL. Because it uses OpenGL, it
depends on a little bit of hardware acceleration to not run slowly. If your
system is not set up to enable this, then Crawl will run quite poorly.

On Windows, the default driver that ships with Windows is extremely slow. Make
sure to update your graphics card driver to the latest one available. On Linux,
you should be sure to enable DRI.

In addition to these suggestions, you can also try to see whether tweaking some
options will improve performance. See docs/tiles_help.txt for details. If
things are still too laggy after all of that, you could try the non-graphical
console version, or wait for a future version that does not depend on OpenGL.
entries.translation:
答：Crawl 使用 OpenGL 和 SDL 绘图。由于采用 OpenGL，需要一定的硬件加速才能流畅运行。如果系统没有启用相应支持，游戏就会很慢。

Windows 自带的默认显卡驱动非常慢，请把显卡驱动更新至最新可用版本。Linux 下应确保启用 DRI。

除上述建议外，还可以尝试调整选项，看能否改善性能，详情见 docs/tiles_help.txt。如果这样仍然很卡，可以尝试没有图形的字符版，或等待将来不依赖 OpenGL 的版本。

entries.english:
A: Actually, by now we consider Stone Soup to be reasonably stable for a game
of such active development, so please don't get hung up about the 0.X
versioning and give it a try.

We've mostly kept the versioning for historic reasons and because it might
cause undue confusion. We might decide to change that at some point, but maybe
we won't.
entries.translation:
答：实际上，对于一款开发如此活跃的游戏，我们已经认为 Stone Soup 相当稳定。所以不必纠结于 0.X 的版本号，来试试吧。

沿用这种版本号主要是出于历史原因，也因为改动可能造成不必要的困惑。将来我们也许会改，也许不会。

entries.english:
<h>Keycodes for console and webtiles</h>

Keycodes can be entered as numbers, or in some cases, human readable strings.
The following tables give both the numeric keycode, and the string; modified
keys generally must be entered by number. When entering a keycode  as part of a
macro action, it should be wrapped using the following syntax for keycode n:
<w>\{n}</w>. This should also be used when defining a keycode by number in your
rc file. Example: when defining a macro that triggers F1, you can write
"\{F1\}" or "\{-265}". For named keys as part of a macro definition, the \{}
may be omitted.

Positive numeric values are ASCII character codes. Negative values are
crawl-internal keycodes for special keys. The sign is required for these to
be interpreted correctly. Keyboards vary quite a bit, and so not all of these
bindings are available on all keyboards; cases where there is often variation
are indicated specifically below.

The following is a quick-reference for some of the main keys you might want to
bind.

<w>8</w>: Backspace (and/or Delete, depending on keyboard)
<w>9</w>: Tab
<w>13</w>: Enter (and/or the Return key, depending on keyboard)
<w>27</w>: Esc

<w>-233</w>: Shift-Tab
<w>-222</w>: Ctrl-Tab (on some keyboards)
<w>-255</w>: Delete (on some keyboards)
<w>-265</w>: F1   <w>-264</w>: F2   <w>-263</w>: F3   <w>-262</w>: F4   <w>-261</w>: F5
<w>-260</w>: F6   <w>-259</w>: F7   <w>-258</w>: F8   <w>-257</w>: F9   <w>-256</w>: F10

Keycodes up to F22 are defined, but may not work on all builds. (On webtiles,
F11 and F12 are reserved.)

<w>Number pad and navigation keys:</w>

On many keyboards, <w>numlock</w> switches between the number keys and
navigation keys. Modifiers for these keys may not work on all keyboards. When
modified number pad keys do work, Shift and Ctrl typically treats those keys as
modified navigation keys regardless of numlock status.

Navigation keys:

<w>-245</w>: PgDn    <w>-234</w>: Shift-PgDn    <w>-223</w>: Ctrl-PgDn
<w>-246</w>: PgUp    <w>-235</w>: Shift-PgUp    <w>-224</w>: Ctrl-PgUp
<w>-247</w>: Clear   <w>-236</w>: Shift-Clear   <w>-225</w>: Ctrl-Clear
<w>-248</w>: End     <w>-237</w>: Shift-End     <w>-226</w>: Ctrl-End
<w>-249</w>: Home    <w>-238</w>: Shift-Home    <w>-227</w>: Ctrl-Home
<w>-250</w>: Insert  <w>-239</w>: Shift-Insert  <w>-228</w>: Ctrl-Insert
<w>-251</w>: Right   <w>-240</w>: Shift-Right   <w>-229</w>: Ctrl-Right
<w>-252</w>: Left    <w>-241</w>: Shift-Left    <w>-230</w>: Ctrl-Left
<w>-253</w>: Down    <w>-242</w>: Shift-Down    <w>-231</w>: Ctrl-Down
<w>-254</w>: Up      <w>-243</w>: Shift-Up      <w>-232</w>: Ctrl-Up

Number pad keys:

<w>-1007</w>: NP7   <w>-1008</w>: NP8   <w>-1009</w>: NP9
<w>-1004</w>: NP4   <w>-1005</w>: NP5   <w>-1006</w>: NP6
<w>-1001</w>: NP1   <w>-1002</w>: NP2   <w>-1003</w>: NP3
<w>-1000</w>: NP0
<w>-1010</w>: NPenter
<w>-1012</w>: NP/   <w>-1015</w>: NP*   <w>-1016</w>: NP+   <w>-1018</w>: NP-
<w>-1019</w>: NP.   <w>-1021</w>: NP=

Some number pad punctuation keys may not be distinguished from their "regular"
counterparts, again depending on keyboard and build.
entries.translation:
<h>终端版与 WebTiles 的按键码</h>

按键码可以用数字输入，有些也可以用可读的名称输入。下表同时列出数字按键码及名称；带修饰键的组合通常必须用数字输入。若在宏动作中输入按键码 n，应写成 <w>\{n}</w>；在 rc 文件中用数字定义按键码时，也应采用此语法。例如，定义由 F1 触发的宏时，可以写成“\{F1\}”或“\{-265}”。在宏定义中使用命名按键时，可以省略 \{}。

正数为 ASCII 字符码，负数为 Crawl 内部的特殊按键码。负号不可省略，否则无法正确解析。键盘之间差异很大，并非所有键盘都支持这些绑定；下文会特别指出常见差异。

以下是一些常用绑定按键的速查表。

<w>8</w>: Backspace（某些键盘上也可能是 Delete）
<w>9</w>: Tab
<w>13</w>: Enter（某些键盘上也可能是 Return）
<w>27</w>: Esc

<w>-233</w>: Shift-Tab
<w>-222</w>: Ctrl-Tab（部分键盘）
<w>-255</w>: Delete（部分键盘）
<w>-265</w>: F1   <w>-264</w>: F2   <w>-263</w>: F3   <w>-262</w>: F4   <w>-261</w>: F5
<w>-260</w>: F6   <w>-259</w>: F7   <w>-258</w>: F8   <w>-257</w>: F9   <w>-256</w>: F10

游戏定义了直到 F22 的按键码，但并非每种构建都能使用。WebTiles 保留了 F11 与 F12。

<w>数字小键盘与导航键：</w>

许多键盘用 <w>numlock</w> 在数字键与导航键之间切换。修饰键组合并非在所有键盘上都有效。即使带修饰键的小键盘按键能用，Shift 和 Ctrl 通常也会将它们当作对应的导航键组合，而不受 numlock 状态影响。

导航键：

<w>-245</w>: PgDn    <w>-234</w>: Shift-PgDn    <w>-223</w>: Ctrl-PgDn
<w>-246</w>: PgUp    <w>-235</w>: Shift-PgUp    <w>-224</w>: Ctrl-PgUp
<w>-247</w>: Clear   <w>-236</w>: Shift-Clear   <w>-225</w>: Ctrl-Clear
<w>-248</w>: End     <w>-237</w>: Shift-End     <w>-226</w>: Ctrl-End
<w>-249</w>: Home    <w>-238</w>: Shift-Home    <w>-227</w>: Ctrl-Home
<w>-250</w>: Insert  <w>-239</w>: Shift-Insert  <w>-228</w>: Ctrl-Insert
<w>-251</w>: Right   <w>-240</w>: Shift-Right   <w>-229</w>: Ctrl-Right
<w>-252</w>: Left    <w>-241</w>: Shift-Left    <w>-230</w>: Ctrl-Left
<w>-253</w>: Down    <w>-242</w>: Shift-Down    <w>-231</w>: Ctrl-Down
<w>-254</w>: Up      <w>-243</w>: Shift-Up      <w>-232</w>: Ctrl-Up

数字小键盘按键：

<w>-1007</w>: NP7   <w>-1008</w>: NP8   <w>-1009</w>: NP9
<w>-1004</w>: NP4   <w>-1005</w>: NP5   <w>-1006</w>: NP6
<w>-1001</w>: NP1   <w>-1002</w>: NP2   <w>-1003</w>: NP3
<w>-1000</w>: NP0
<w>-1010</w>: NPenter
<w>-1012</w>: NP/   <w>-1015</w>: NP*   <w>-1016</w>: NP+   <w>-1018</w>: NP-
<w>-1019</w>: NP.   <w>-1021</w>: NP=

某些小键盘标点按键可能无法与普通键区的对应按键区分，这同样取决于键盘和构建。

entries.english:
<h>Known items menu</h>

<h>Navigation and selecting items</h>
Use the usual navigation keys (<w>arrow</w> keys, <w>pgdn</w>/<w>pgup</w>, <w>home</w>, <w>end</w>) to select
items, and <w>Space</w>/<w>.</w> to toggle the autopickup mode for the selected item type.
Pressing an item type's letter key will also toggle its autopickup state.

<h>Selecting item types</h>
Item types displayed in grey use the default autopickup options set in your
configuration file. (Items that are useless to your character are displayed
in <darkgrey>dark grey</darkgrey>.) Selecting a type of item overrides those options
(indicated by <w>white</w> text), and toggles the item between the states:
 <w>+</w>  Items of this type will be picked up automatically.
 <w>-</w>  Items of this type will not be picked up automatically.
Autopickup can also be toggled for all unknown items of a given category.

<h>Category shortcuts</h>
You can quickly select all item types in a given category by pressing:
<w>!</w>   potions      <w>?</w>   scrolls      <w>(</w>   ammunition        <w>"</w>   amulets
<w>=</w>   rings        <w>/</w>   wands        <w>|</w>   magical staves
Global selects:  <w>*</w>   invert all   <w>^</w>   reset all to default

<h>Viewing unknown and known items</h>
<w>\</w> and <w>-</w> toggle between the known and unknown items menus. Note
that none of the above features are available from the unknown items menu.

<h>Restoring autopickup defaults</h>
Pressing <w>Ctrl-D</w> followed by an item letter or a category shortcut
cancels the override and restores the selected item or items to their default
settings.

<h>Regular expressions</h>
You can press <w>Ctrl-F</w> to enter a word (or a regular expression).
All matching items will be selected.
entries.translation:
<h>已知物品菜单</h>

<h>浏览与选择物品</h>
用常见浏览键（<w>方向</w>键、<w>pgdn</w>/<w>pgup</w>、<w>home</w>、<w>end</w>）选择物品，
用 <w>Space</w>/<w>.</w> 切换所选物品类型的自动拾取方式。
按物品类型对应的字母键也能切换其自动拾取状态。

<h>选择物品类型</h>
灰色显示的物品类型使用配置文件中的默认自动拾取选项。
对当前角色无用的物品显示为<darkgrey>深灰色</darkgrey>。
选择一种物品会覆盖默认选项（以<w>白色</w>文字表示），并在以下状态之间切换：
 <w>+</w> 自动拾取此类物品。
 <w>-</w> 不自动拾取此类物品。
也可为某一类别中所有尚未鉴定的物品切换自动拾取。

<h>类别快捷键</h>
按以下键可快速选择整个类别的物品类型：
<w>!</w> 药水    <w>?</w> 卷轴    <w>(</w> 弹药    <w>"</w> 护身符
<w>=</w> 戒指    <w>/</w> 魔杖    <w>|</w> 魔法杖
全局选择：<w>*</w> 全部反选    <w>^</w> 全部恢复默认

<h>查看未知与已知物品</h>
<w>\</w> 和 <w>-</w> 在已知与未知物品菜单之间切换。
注意，上述功能均无法在未知物品菜单中使用。

<h>恢复默认自动拾取设置</h>
按 <w>Ctrl-D</w>，再按物品字母或类别快捷键，
即可取消覆盖，使选定物品恢复默认设置。

<h>正则表达式</h>
按 <w>Ctrl-F</w> 输入词语或正则表达式，所有匹配的物品都会被选中。

entries.english:
<h>Level Map ('<w>X</w>' in the main screen):</h>
<w>Esc</w>        : Leave level map (also <w>Space</w> or any unused key).
<w>Dir.</w>       : Move the cursor.
<w>Shift-Dir.</w> : Move the cursor in larger steps (7 by default).
<w>-</w> or <w>+</w>     : Scroll level map 20 grids up or down.
<w>.</w>          : Start travel (also <w>Enter</w> and <w>,</w> and <w>;</w>).
             (Moves cursor to the last travel destination if still on @.)
<w>[</w> or <w>]</w>     : Examine the next higher or lower level.
             (Moves cursor to the staircase destination if a known staircase is
             highlighted.)
<w>G</w>          : View another level by choosing a branch and depth.
<w>o</w>          : Move the cursor to the next autoexplore target.
<w>{</w> or <w>}</w>     : Zoom out or in (tiles only).

<h>Travel exclusions</h>
<w>e</w>          : Create a travel exclusion, change its radius, or remove it.
<w>R#</w>         : Create a travel exclusion with a specified radius or change
             its radius to #, where # is a number from 1 to 8.
<w>E</w>          : Cycle through travel exclusions.
<w>Ctrl-E</w>     : Erase all travel exclusions on the level.

<h>Waypoints</h>
<w>w</w>          : Set waypoint to current position.
<w>W</w>          : Cycle through all waypoints on the level.

<h>Cycle through features</h>
<w><<</w> or <w>></w>     : Cycle through up or down stairs.
<w>^</w>          : Cycle through traps.
<w>\</w> or <w>Tab</w>   : Cycle through shops and portals.
<w>I</w>          : Cycle forward through all items.
<w>O</w>          : Cycle backward through all items.
<w>_</w>          : Cycle through altars.

<h>Other</h>
<w>v</w>          : Examine the last remembered state of the indicated tile.
<w>!</w>          : Annotate level.
<w>Ctrl-C</w>     : Clear monster memory.
<w>Ctrl-F</w>     : Forget level map.
<w>Ctrl-U</w>     : Restore forgotten level map.{{
if you.wizard() then
    return "\n\n"
          .. "<h>Wizard commands</h>\n"
          .. "<w>T</w>          : Teleport to cursor.\n"
          .. "<w>Ctrl-X</w>     : Completely wipe out map."
end }}
entries.translation:
<h>楼层地图（主界面的“<w>X</w>”）：</h>
<w>Esc</w>        ：离开楼层地图，也可用 <w>Space</w> 或任何未占用按键。
<w>Dir.</w>       ：移动光标。

entries.english:
<h>Editing macros and keymaps</h>

To edit a current macro/keymap, select from the menu using the arrow keys or
by hotkey. (Hotkeys that are used to navigate the menu can be selected by
arrow keys). To create a new mapping by entering a key, use the [<w>~</w>] key
or the corresponding menu item, and then enter the key. This allows you to
create (and edit) mappings that use menu keys. Use the [<w>!</w>] key to switch
to keymap editing mode (see below for more information on keymaps).

<w>Macros</w> allow remapping keys that are sent to the game when inputting
commands. This can be used to redefine a command key, or to define an unused
key. They map a key to a sequence of keystrokes, and keystrokes do carry over
into submenus.

Example 1: mapping <w>e</w> to <w>p</w> would let the `e` key trigger the same
command as the `p` key (which on the default settings is autofire).

Example 2: mapping <w>1</w> to the sequence <w>zaf</w> would let the `1` key
cast a spell that is on the letter `a` with default targeting.

Example 3: mapping <w>F1</w> to <w>Q&a</w> would let the F1 key quiver the spell
that is on letter `a`.

<w>Keymaps</w> are lower-level key substitutions that replace keys entirely with
a sequence of keystrokes. They are recommended for changing keys uniformly to
deal with alternative keyboard layouts. Keymaps are contextual, and the
default/"regular" context is used anywhere that a non-specialised context is not
active. Macros take the result of keymaps as input.

Example: In some European keyboard layouts, the § symbol replaces ~. Therefore,
it could be useful to keymap § to ~ in both the regular and menu keymap contexts
so that the main menu and macro menu become a bit easier to access. (In other
layouts, this applies instead to ½.)

When used for mapping commands, keymaps can have unexpected side effects: e.g.
mapping <w>1</w> to <w>zaf</w> via keymap is not recommended, because this will
make it hard to type `1` when entering a skill target.

<w>Keycodes</w>: Both macros and keymaps accept keycodes when describing the
action, in the form of <w>\{n}</w> to enter keycode <w>n</w>. (Use <w>\\</w> to
enter a backslash.) For example, use <w>\{9}</w> to enter the keycode for the
<w>tab</w> button. You can bind macros and keymaps by keycode by using <w>~~</w>
at the macro edit menu.

<w>Saving</w>: Bindings edited at this menu are saved in a .macro file in your
save directory. They will be overridden by settings in your options file. See
the `macro` command in options_guide.txt for more information.
entries.translation:
<h>编辑宏与按键映射</h>

要编辑已有宏或按键映射，可用方向键或快捷键在菜单中选择。用于菜单导航的快捷键，可以通过方向键选中。要通过输入按键创建新映射，请按 [<w>~</w>] 或选择对应菜单项，再输入按键。这样也能创建和编辑使用菜单按键的映射。按 [<w>!</w>] 切换至按键映射编辑模式；下文有更详细的说明。

<w>宏</w>可重映射输入游戏命令时发送的按键。它既能重新定义命令键，也能定义尚未使用的按键。宏将一个按键映射为一连串按键，且这串按键会继续送入随后打开的子菜单。

例 1：把 <w>e</w> 映射为 <w>p</w>，即可用 `e` 触发与 `p` 相同的命令；默认设置中，该命令为自动发射。

例 2：把 <w>1</w> 映射为 <w>zaf</w>，即可用 `1` 按默认瞄准方式施展字母 `a` 对应的法术。

例 3：把 <w>F1</w> 映射为 <w>Q&a</w>，即可用 F1 将字母 `a` 对应的法术设为备选。

<w>按键映射</w>属于更底层的按键替换，会把一个按键完全替换为一串按键。它适合统一修改按键，以适应不同键盘布局。按键映射具有上下文；当没有专用上下文生效时，使用默认的“常规”上下文。宏接收按键映射的输出作为输入。

例如，某些欧洲键盘布局用 § 代替 ~。此时可在常规及菜单两种上下文中，把 § 映射为 ~，以便更容易打开主菜单和宏菜单。某些其他布局则使用 ½。

用按键映射绑定命令，可能产生意外的副作用。例如，不建议通过按键映射把 <w>1</w> 改成 <w>zaf</w>，因为这样在输入技能目标时就很难输入 `1`。

<w>按键码</w>：宏和按键映射都允许在动作中用 <w>\{n}</w> 输入按键码 <w>n</w>。使用 <w>\\</w> 输入反斜杠。例如，用 <w>\{9}</w> 输入 <w>tab</w> 键的按键码。在宏编辑菜单中使用 <w>~~</w>，可以通过按键码绑定宏和按键映射。

<w>保存</w>：此菜单编辑的绑定保存在存档目录的 .macro 文件中，并会被选项文件中的设置覆盖。更多信息见 options_guide.txt 的 `macro` 命令。

entries.english:
<h>Picking up and dropping items</h>

<h>Navigation and selecting items</h>
Use the usual navigation keys (<w>arrow</w> keys, <w>pgdn</w>/<w>pgup</w>, <w>home</w>, <w>end</w>) to select
items, and <w>Space</w>/<w>.</w> to toggle whether the selected item will be picked up or
dropped. Pressing an item's letter key will also toggle its pickup/drop state.
Gear, potions, scrolls, and evocable items are on separate pages which can be
switched between by <w>left arrow</w> and <w>right arrow</w>.
Press <w>Return</w> to accept the current set of items.

Entering a number before selecting by letter will toggle just that quantity of
a stack of items.

<h>Regular expressions</h>
You can press <w>Ctrl-F</w> to enter a word (or a regular expression). All matching
items will be selected.

<h>Category shortcuts</h>
You can quickly select items by type by pressing:
<w>!</w>   potions      <w>(</w>   weapons        <w>)</w>   ammunition      <w>[</w>   armour
<w>/</w>   wands        <w>|</w>   magical staves <w>?</w>   scrolls         <w>:</w>   books
<w>"</w>   amulets      <w>=</w>   rings          <w>}</w>   miscellaneous
Global selects:  <w>,</w>   select all     <w>*</w>   invert all      <w>-</w>   deselect all
                 <w>;</w>   select last unequipped
Note that for dropping, the <w>,</w> command uses the <w>drop_filter</w> option, which
narrows the range of items to be (de)selected. The default is all useless items.
entries.translation:
<h>拾取和丢弃物品</h>

<h>浏览与选择物品</h>
用常见浏览键（<w>方向</w>键、<w>pgdn</w>/<w>pgup</w>、<w>home</w>、<w>end</w>）选择物品，
用 <w>Space</w>/<w>.</w> 切换选中物品的拾取或丢弃状态。
按物品对应的字母键也能切换其拾取或丢弃状态。
装备、药水、卷轴和可发动的物品分在不同页面，可用<w>左方向键</w>和<w>右方向键</w>切换。
按 <w>Return</w> 确认当前选中的物品。

先输入数量，再按字母选择，就只会切换一叠物品中相应数量的选择状态。

<h>正则表达式</h>
按 <w>Ctrl-F</w> 输入词语或正则表达式，所有匹配的物品都会被选中。

<h>类别快捷键</h>
按以下键可按类型快速选择物品：
<w>!</w> 药水    <w>(</w> 武器    <w>)</w> 弹药    <w>[</w> 防具
<w>/</w> 魔杖    <w>|</w> 魔法杖  <w>?</w> 卷轴    <w>:</w> 书籍
<w>"</w> 护身符  <w>=</w> 戒指    <w>}</w> 杂项
全局选择：<w>,</w> 全选    <w>*</w> 全部反选    <w>-</w> 全部取消
          <w>;</w> 选择上次卸下的装备
注意，丢弃物品时，<w>,</w> 命令受 <w>drop_filter</w> 选项影响，
该选项限制可被选择或取消选择的物品范围，默认只包括无用物品。

entries.english:
<h>Skill management</h>

You gain experience for killing monsters (and very few other activities). This
experience is used to train skills. The skill screen allows you to select which
skills to train.

By pressing its letter, you can cycle if and how a skill is trained:
  <darkgrey>- deselected</darkgrey>    Skill will not be trained.
  + selected      Skill will be trained.
  <w>* focused</w>       Skill will be weighted higher for training.

Pressing a capital letter selects that skill and deselects all the others.
This shortcut is useful when you want to train only one skill.

Training can be done in two modes, which are toggled with the <w>/</w> key.
  - automatic:    Skills are weighted based on your use of them.
  - manual:       Experience is spread evenly across all activated skills.

In training target mode you can set skill training targets: target skill levels
at which training of the skill will be automatically disabled.

How fast you train a skill is governed by the following factors:
  - aptitude: Shown <white>white</white> in the Apt column. Higher numbers mean that less
              experience is needed to advance a skill. Depends on species.
  - skill manuals: Rare books giving an aptitude bonus of <lightred>+4</lightred> in one skill.

On top of that, there are some effects which directly modify a skill, for
example having trained a related skill (crosstraining), or certain god powers.
Reduced skills are shown in <magenta>magenta</magenta>, and enhanced skills in <green>green</green>.
The training percentage (in <brown>brown</brown>) shows the relative amount of experience
which will be used to train this skill.

Apart from (de)selecting skills, you also have the following toggles:
  <w>/</w> :  Switch between automatic and manual training modes.
  <w>*</w> :  Display all skills, even those which aren't currently useful.
  <w>?</w> :  Allows you to read the descriptions of skills.
  <w>_</w> :  Show or hide skill level modifications (god powers, crosstraining).
  <w>!</w> :  Switch between displaying training percentage, skill cost, or training
       targets.
entries.translation:
<h>技能管理</h>

击杀怪物（以及极少数其他活动）会获得经验，用于训练技能。
技能界面允许你选择要训练哪些技能。

按技能对应的字母，可循环切换是否训练及训练方式：
  <darkgrey>- 未选择</darkgrey>    不训练该技能。
  + 已选择        训练该技能。
  <w>* 专注</w>          训练时该技能的权重更高。

按大写字母会选择该技能，并取消其他所有技能的训练。
只想训练一项技能时，这个快捷方式很有用。

训练分为两种模式，按 <w>/</w> 键切换：
  - 自动：技能权重取决于你的实际使用情况。
  - 手动：经验平均分配给所有已开启训练的技能。

在训练目标模式下，你可以设置目标技能等级；达到目标后会自动停止训练该技能。

技能训练速度取决于以下因素：
  - 天资：在天资栏以<white>白色</white>显示。数值越高，提升技能所需的经验越少，取决于种族。
  - 技能手册：稀有书籍，能为一项技能提供 <lightred>+4</lightred> 天资加成。

此外，有些效果会直接改变技能等级，例如训练相关技能带来的交叉训练，或某些神赐能力。
被削弱的技能以<magenta>品红色</magenta>显示，被增强的技能以<green>绿色</green>显示。
训练百分比（<brown>棕色</brown>）表示分配给该技能的相对经验份额。

除选择或取消技能外，还可以切换以下选项：
  <w>/</w>：在自动和手动训练模式之间切换。
  <w>*</w>：显示所有技能，包括当前无用的技能。
  <w>?</w>：阅读技能说明。
  <w>_</w>：显示或隐藏技能等级修正（神赐能力、交叉训练）。
  <w>!</w>：在训练百分比、技能消耗和训练目标之间切换。

entries.english:
<h>Searching the stash-tracker</h>

You can search for items and dungeon features by name (or a substring of the
name). In the list of search results, you can select a search result by its
hotkey to travel to its location.

Some examples of search strings:
<w>mutation</w>      find all potions of mutation, including potions in shops.
<w>throwing net</w>  finds every single throwing net and piles of nets.
<w>shop</w>          lists all shops. Press <w>!</w> and a shop's letter for the stock.
<w>Lair:2</w>        find everything known to be on Lair:2.
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      finds everything on Dungeon levels 2-4. Regexes are allowed!
              Note that /D:[3-10] will not work as intended, since [x-y] is a
              regex character range.
<w>rPois</w>         finds all items with an rPois resistance.
<w>rC++</w>          finds all items with an rC++ resistance.
<w>+3</w>            finds all items with a +3 enchantment.
<w>/Lair.*axe</w> and <w>axe && Lair</w> both show all axes in the Lair.

Some shortcuts:
<w>.</w>             lists everything on your current level.
<w>..</w>            lists all items you know.
<w>0</w> to <w>9</w>        lists all items at the specified waypoint.
<w>*</w>             lists all items at all waypoints.
<w>@<<query></w>      lists everything matching <<query> on your current level.
<w>/<<regex></w>      lists items matching <<regex> as a regular expression.
<w>=<<string></w>     lists items containing <<string> as a substring.

You can also examine shops and items in the search results by pressing <w>?</w> and
then selecting the hotkey for the search result. This will give a description
of the item or the contents of the shop.

The stash search string is case-insensitive.

<h>Searching by item properties:</h>

You can search for spell names (such as <w>Ignite Poison</w>) to find spellbooks
that contain the spell.

You can search for artefact item properties (such as <w>/prevents.*teleport</w>)
to find artefacts that have the property.

You can search by some additional item properties: <w>artefact</w> or
<w>artifact</w> will find identified artefacts, <w>ego</w> or <w>branded</w>
will find non-artefacts with a brand and unidentified items which may be
branded, <w>throwable</w> will find things you can throw, <w>dropped</w> will
find items you have dropped, <w>in_shop</w> will find items in shops, and (if
the autopickup_search option is enabled) <w>autopickup</w> will find items that
would be automatically picked up.

Skill names (such as <w>Polearms</w> or <w>Long Blades</w>) will find all weapons that
train that skill. You can also look for <w>melee weapon</w> and <w>ranged weapon</w>.

You can also search by item types such as <w>book</w> or <w>manual</w> or <w>jewellery</w>.
For armour slots, use <w>helmet</w> (all headgear), <w>gloves</w>, <w>shield</w>, and <w>body</w>.
Use <w>armour && !!body</w> to list all armour pieces except for body armour.

<h>Finding Dungeon Features:</h>

You can search for dungeon features by name: all shops will be found by a search
for <w>shop</w> (including shops that do not have "shop" in their name); other
dungeon features can also be found by name: <w>dispersal trap</w>, <w>altar</w>,
etc. You can also search for altars by deity name: <w>Zin</w>.

<h>Non-regex operators:</h>

You can use !! to negate a search string, && for a boolean AND, || for
boolean OR, and <<<< >> for grouping.

For instance, to find rings (jewellery) but not ring mail you could use:
<w>ring && !!mail</w>

Note that <w>/</w> and <w>=</w> apply to individual patterns, not the entire query:
you should search for <w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>, not
<w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>.
entries.translation:
<h>搜索物品记录</h>

你可以按名称或名称的一部分搜索物品与地下城设施。在搜索结果中，按对应快捷键即可前往结果所在位置。

搜索词示例：
<w>mutation</w>      查找所有变异药水，包括商店中的药水。
<w>throwing net</w>  查找每张投掷网及投掷网堆。
<w>shop</w>          列出所有商店；按 <w>!</w> 再按商店字母可查看货物。
<w>Lair:2</w>        查找已知位于野兽巢穴第 2 层的一切。
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      查找主地下城第 2 至 4 层的物品；可以使用正则表达式！
              注意：/D:[3-10] 不会按预期工作，因为 [x-y] 表示正则字符范围。
<w>rPois</w>         查找具有 rPois 毒素抗性的物品。
<w>rC++</w>          查找具有 rC++ 寒冷抗性的物品。
<w>+3</w>            查找附魔值为 +3 的物品。
<w>/Lair.*axe</w> 与 <w>axe && Lair</w> 都会列出野兽巢穴中的所有斧类。

一些简写：
<w>.</w>             列出当前层的一切。
<w>..</w>            列出所有已知物品。
<w>0</w> 至 <w>9</w>       列出指定导导航点处的所有物品。
<w>*</w>             列出所有导导航点处的所有物品。
<w>@<<query></w>      列出当前层中匹配 <<query> 的一切。
<w>/<<regex></w>      将 <<regex> 作为正则表达式搜索物品。
<w>=<<string></w>     搜索包含 <<string> 这一子串的物品。

在搜索结果中按 <w>?</w>，再按对应结果的快捷键，也可以检查商店与物品，查看物品说明或商店货物。

物品搜索不区分大小写。

<h>按物品属性搜索：</h>

你可以搜索法术名，例如 <w>Ignite Poison</w>，来查找包含该法术的魔法书。

你可以搜索神器属性，例如 <w>/prevents.*teleport</w>，来查找具有该属性的神器。

还可以使用额外的物品属性：<w>artefact</w> 或 <w>artifact</w> 查找已鉴定神器；<w>ego</w> 或 <w>branded</w> 查找带印记的非神器，以及可能带印记的未鉴定物品；<w>throwable</w> 查找可投掷物；<w>dropped</w> 查找你丢弃过的物品；<w>in_shop</w> 查找商店中的物品；如果启用了 autopickup_search 选项，<w>autopickup</w> 会查找将被自动拾取的物品。

技能名，例如 <w>Polearms</w> 或 <w>Long Blades</w>，可以查找使用该技能的所有武器。也可以搜索 <w>melee weapon</w> 与 <w>ranged weapon</w>。

还可以搜索物品类别，例如 <w>book</w>、<w>manual</w> 或 <w>jewellery</w>。防具栏位可使用 <w>helmet</w>（所有头部装备）、<w>gloves</w>、<w>shield</w> 与 <w>body</w>。使用 <w>armour && !!body</w> 可列出躯干防具以外的所有防具。

<h>查找地下城设施：</h>

你可以按名称搜索地下城设施：<w>shop</w> 会找到所有商店，包括名称中没有“shop”的商店。其他设施也能按名称查找，例如 <w>dispersal trap</w>、<w>altar</w> 等。还可以按神祇名称搜索祭坛，例如 <w>Zin</w>。

<h>非正则运算符：</h>

使用 !! 对搜索词取反，&& 表示逻辑“与”，|| 表示逻辑“或”，<<<< >> 用于分组。

例如，要查找戒指（首饰）而排除环甲，可以使用：
<w>ring && !!mail</w>

注意：<w>/</w> 与 <w>=</w> 只作用于单个模式，而非整个查询。因此，应搜索 <w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>，而非 <w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>。

entries.english:
<h>Create specified monster</h>

To create a monster with the default equipment for its species, simply enter
the species name, such as <w>kobold</w> or <w>Yiuf</w>.

A hydra or slymdra can be given a specific number of heads by calling it an
n<w>-headed</w> <w>hydra</w> or n<w>-headed</w> <w>slymdra</w> (with a maximum of 20 heads):

<w>four-headed hydra</w>

To set the colour a (very) ugly thing takes when it is first created, use:

<w>white very ugly thing</w>

The valid colours are <w>brown</w>, <w>cyan</w>, <w>green</w>, <w>purple</w>, <w>red</w> and <w>white</w>.

A mutant beast can be customised by prefacing it with a maturity level and/or
hyphen-separated set of traits, as follows:

<w>mature shock-weird mutant beast</w>

The valid maturity levels are <w>larval</w>, <w>juvenile</w>, <w>mature</w>, <w>elder</w> and <w>primal</w>. The
facets are <w>sting</w>, <w>bat</w>, <w>fire</w>, <w>weird</w>, <w>shock</w> and <w>ox</w>.

A slime creature's size can be set to other than normal using the prefixes
<w>large</w>, <w>very large</w>, <w>enormous</w> or <w>titanic</w>:

<w>very large slime creature</w>

If a monster is a member of a band, you can request that it be eligible for
band members by adding the keyword <w>band</w> to the name. For instance:

<w>orc warlord band</w>

Specifying <w>band</w> doesn't force bands to be placed - it requests that the game
use the normal chances of creating a band. A band will only be placed if there
is space for it.

A monster can be given specific items by following the monster name with a
semi-colon and then with an item list. For example:

<w>orc ; rapier | quick blade . chain mail | plate armour</w>

will generate an orc wielding either a rapier or a quick blade and wearing
either chain mail or plate armour. Randarts and ego items are only generated
if they are explicitly requested. Note that any items that the monster was
originally generated with will be removed and destroyed. This can be used to
force a monster to have no items whatsoever:

<w>orc; nothing</w>

For further information, see <cyan>docs/develop/levels/syntax.txt</cyan>, section <cyan>ITEMS</cyan>.
Any reference to a slash (<w>/</w>) should be replaced with a pipe (<w>|</w>) and any comma
(<w>,</w>) with a full stop (<w>.</w>).

The same syntax is also used to create a specific type of dancing weapon:

<w>dancing weapon; rapier</w>

Limitations: If a monster is given a random launcher, there is no way to force
the ammo type to match the launcher type. As a special case, however, a
launcher dancing weapon is always generated with some suitable ammunition.

You can specify that a monster will always generate a corpse by using the tag
<w>always_corpse</w>, or that it will never generate a corpse with <w>never_corpse</w>.

By default, monsters are generated asleep. This is changed by prefixing the
name with <w>generate_awake</w>.

<w>generate_awake boulder beetle</w>

A prefix of <w>patrolling</w> prevents it from walking out of sight of the the place
where it was created.

You can set the monster's god using the <w>god</w>: specifier as follows:

<w>orc god:the_shining_one</w>

If the monster is to be a gift of the specified god, this should be suffixed
with <w>god_gift</w>:

<w>orc god:the_shining_one god_gift</w>

Note that the monster will not be considered a god gift unless <w>god_gift</w> is
explicitly set.

You can set the monster's faction by specifying <w>att</w>: one of:

* <w>att:hostile</w> -- the default
* <w>att:friendly</w> -- tame, will follow you
* <w>att:neutral</w> -- hostile to both you and att:hostile monsters
* <w>att:good_neutral</w> -- hostile to att:hostile
* <w>att:fellow_slime</w> -- tame, won't follow you

Monsters can be given colours that override their default colour:

<w>col:darkgrey fungus</w>

The colour <w>any</w> can be given, in which case a random colour will be chosen.

You can override the displayed monster tile using the <w>tile</w>: specifier as
follows:

<w>rat tile:mons_giant_bat</w>

In tiles version, this would create a monster that uses the "<cyan>mons_giant_bat</cyan>"
tile, but is otherwise identical to a rat. In ASCII mode, this will do
nothing.

If you want to place a random monster suitable for the level the map is
generated on, you can use

<w>random</w>

If you want to place a random monster suitable for some other place, you can
use a place: tag in the monster spec:

<w>place:Abyss</w>

Using <w>place</w>: implies that you want a random monster. You can also request
zombies from random monsters suitable for some other depth as (e.g.):

<w>place:Elf:3 zombie</w>

The available modifiers are <w>zombie</w>, <w>draugr</w>, <w>simulacrum</w>, and <w>spectre</w>.

<h>Overriding Monster Names</h>

Individual monsters can be given names as follows:

<w>kobold name:Durwent</w>

This will cause the monster to appear as "<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>". Spaces can be
placed in the name by substituting them with the _ symbol. It is worth noting
that "<cyan>the <<race></cyan>" will be appended to all names, which should be considered
when coming up with them.

There are three different modifiers that can be used on a name:
<w>name_adjective</w>, <w>name_suffix and </w>name_replace. <w>name_adjective</w> makes the
name act as an adjective. For example:

<w>kobold name:ugly name_adjective</w>

Will cause "<cyan>An ugly kobold</cyan>", "<cyan>The ugly kobold hits you</cyan>", and so on.

<w>name_suffix</w> does the same, but after the monster's base name:

<w>kobold name:wearing_mittens name_suffix</w>

Will give "<cyan>A kobold wearing mittens</cyan>", "<cyan>The kobold wearing mittens hits you</cyan>",
and so on.

<w>name_replace</w> causes the base name to be replaced by given name, as if the
monster was a unique:

<w>kobold name:Durwent name_replace</w>

Will result in "<cyan>Durwent</cyan>" rather than "<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>". The corpse will
still be a "<cyan>kobold corpse of Durwent</cyan>".

<w>name_species</w> uses the name for corpses as-is, without prefixing it with
"<cyan>kobold</cyan> <cyan>corpse of X</cyan>" for <w>name_replace</w>. It also avoids the usual name tag
that displays above unique and renamed monsters in local tiles.

In combination with <w>name_replace</w> or <w>name_species</w>, there are two further tags
that can be used when renaming monsters, but not giving them an actual "name":
<w>name_descriptor</w>, and <w>name_definite</w>.

For example:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace</w>

Will result in "<cyan>goblin hits you</cyan>". However, adding <w>name_descriptor</w> from the
above flags will result in "<cyan>The goblin hits you</cyan>" and in the description of the
monster, "<cyan>A goblin</cyan>".

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor</w>

The <w>name_definite</w> flag ensures that it is never referred to as "<cyan>a</cyan>" or "<cyan>an</cyan>",
but that the definite object is always used. Therefore, you will see "<cyan>The
<cyan>goblin</cyan> <cyan>hits you</cyan>", as per above, but also "<cyan>The goblin</cyan>" in its description.
Setting <w>name_definite</w> will automatically set the flag <w>name_descriptor</w>,
therefore meaning that:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_definite</w>

is exactly the same as:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor name_definite</w>

<w>name_zombie</w> can be used to redefine already zombified monsters (including
draugr, simulacra and spectrals).

Finally, <w>name_nocorpse</w> will cause the name to be completely ignored for
corpses. For example:

<w>wizard name:sad name_adjective name_nocorpse</w>

will result in "<cyan>a sad wizard</cyan>" that leaves "<cyan>a wizard corpse</cyan>".

For instances where space in definitions is limited, you can use abbreviated
forms of these tags:

* <w>name_suffix</w> -> <w>n_suf</w>
* <w>name_adjective</w> -> <w>n_adj</w>
* <w>name_replace</w> -> <w>n_rpl</w>
* <w>name_species</w> -> <w>n_spe</w>
* <w>name_descriptor</w> -> <w>n_des</w>
* <w>name_definite</w> -> <w>n_the</w>
* <w>name_zombie</w> -> <w>n_zom</w>
* <w>name_nocorpse</w> -> <w>n_noc</w>

<h>Overriding Monster Stats</h>

Further monster customisation can be made by using <w>hd</w> and <w>hp</w>. These two tags
allow you to completely overwrite the original hit dice and hit points of a
monster:

<w>kobold hd:20</w>

Creates a kobold with a hit dice of 20. As its hp is randomised, based on its
hit dice, this will also be re-rolled. Monsters with a specific hit point
value will not have this value change.

You can also have a specific value for hit points:

<w>kobold hp:20</w>

Creates a kobold with 20 hit points. This is also useful for monsters (such as
statues) which come with non-randomised HP values.

Monsters can be marked as summoned by using <w>dur</w> and <w>sum</w> tags. The <w>dur</w> tag
accepts an integer between 1 and 6 inclusive. The <w>sum</w> tag accepts the name of
a spell (parsed as per the <w>spells</w> tag, described below) or any of <w>clone</w>
(Rakshasa), <w>animate</w> (from animate dead), <w>chaos</w> (made from pure chaos), <w>miscast</w>
(summoned from by spell miscast effect), <w>zot</w> (summoned by a Zot trap), <w>wrath</w>
(summoned by a god in an act of retribution), <w>aid</w> (summoned by a god in order
to give aid).

Of the spells, <w>shadow_creatures</w> has the most significant effect, in that
monsters will dissipate into the shadows rather than disappear in a puff of
smoke. Using non-summoning spells will also have no effect.

Tagging a monster with <w>seen</w> will override the system and force that monster to
be marked as already viewed; this means that it won't generate messages such
as "<cyan>A kobold comes into view</cyan>".

<h>Overriding Monster Spells</h>

Monster spell sets can be overridden with a <w>spells</w>: tag, used as follows:

*<w>goblin spells:throw_flame.50.wizard</w>
*<w>ancient lich spells:symbol_of_torment.26.wizard; glaciate.51.wizard</w>

(a list of spell slots, consisting of a spell name with spaces replaced with
underscores, a frequency of casting and set of spell slot flags specified
afterwards with <w>.</w>, with slots separated by <w>;</w>. There should be no spaces around
the <w>;</w> or after the <w>spells</w>: prefix)

Spell names must exactly match the names in <cyan>spl-data.h</cyan>, with spaces replaced
by underscores. Spell frequencies are an (x in 200) chance that that spell
will be cast. Spell flags include:

* <w>natural</w>, <w>magical</w>, <w>demonic</w>, <w>wizard</w>, or <w>priest</w> - the manner in which this
spell is being cast. Wizards and priests can be silenced and will trigger
appropriate conducts (Trog will appreciate killing wizards, Beogh will
appreciate killing priests). Magical, demonic, and wizard spells are subject
to anti-magic effects. Natural spells do not generate noise.
* <w>emergency</w> - the monster will only cast the spell when low on health.
* <w>breath</w> - the spell is a breath weapon, and using it triggers a breath
timeout during which the spell cannot be cast again.
* <w>no_silent</w> - the spell cannot be used while silent, even if it is an ability
type normally not subject to silence.
* <w>instant</w> - the spell does not expend the monster's energy; they may take
another action on the same turn.
* <w>noisy</w> - forces the spell to make noise even if it is a natural ability.

You may use <w>none</w> specify that a slot should be left empty. You can force a
spell-less monster with:

<w>orc wizard spells:none</w>

<h>Setting enchantments</h>

You may give a monster any number of enchantments. It may start hasted, blind,
have permanent RMsl, etc. The syntax is <w>ench:<<name>:<<duration>:<<degree></w> or
<w>perm_ench:<<name>:<<degree></w>. The <w><<degree></w> and <w><<duration></w> fields may be
omitted.

For example:

* <w>orc perm_ench:blind perm_ench:mad</w>
* <w>dream sheep ench:sticky_flame</w>
* <w>stone giant dur:1 ench:berserk</w>
entries.translation:
<h>创建指定怪物</h>

若要创建携带其种族默认装备的怪物，只需输入种族名称，例如 <w>kobold</w> 或 <w>Yiuf</w>。

可以用 n<w>-headed</w> <w>hydra</w> 或 n<w>-headed</w> <w>slymdra</w> 指定多头蛇或黏液多头蛇的头数，最多 20 个头：

<w>four-headed hydra</w>

要指定丑陋怪或极丑陋怪刚生成时的颜色，请使用：

<w>white very ugly thing</w>

有效颜色为 <w>brown</w>、<w>cyan</w>、<w>green</w>、<w>purple</w>、<w>red</w> 和 <w>white</w>。

可以在名称前添加成熟程度，以及用连字符分隔的特征组，来自定义变异兽：

<w>mature shock-weird mutant beast</w>

有效成熟程度为 <w>larval</w>、<w>juvenile</w>、<w>mature</w>、<w>elder</w> 和 <w>primal</w>。特征为 <w>sting</w>、<w>bat</w>、<w>fire</w>、<w>weird</w>、<w>shock</w> 和 <w>ox</w>。

使用 <w>large</w>、<w>very large</w>、<w>enormous</w> 或 <w>titanic</w> 前缀，可将黏液生物设为非普通体型：

<w>very large slime creature</w>

如果怪物属于某个怪物群，可以在名称后添加 <w>band</w>，请求按通常规则为它生成同群成员。例如：

<w>orc warlord band</w>

指定 <w>band</w> 并不强制生成怪物群，而是请求使用正常概率。只有空间足够时才会放置怪物群。

在怪物名后添加分号，再列出物品，可以指定怪物携带的物品。例如：

<w>orc ; rapier | quick blade . chain mail | plate armour</w>

这会生成一个持有西洋剑或快剑、穿着链甲或板甲的兽人。只有明确指定时，才会生成随机神器或带词缀物品。怪物原本生成的所有物品都会被移除并摧毁；因此也可以用它强制怪物不携带任何物品：

<w>orc; nothing</w>

更多信息见 <cyan>docs/develop/levels/syntax.txt</cyan> 的 <cyan>ITEMS</cyan> 章节。其中出现的斜杠（<w>/</w>）应换成竖线（<w>|</w>），逗号（<w>,</w>）应换成句点（<w>.</w>）。

同一语法也用于创建指定种类的舞动武器：

<w>dancing weapon; rapier</w>

限制：如果给怪物随机远程发射武器，就无法强制弹药类型与之匹配。不过，远程舞动武器是特例，总会附带一些合适的弹药。

使用 <w>always_corpse</w> 可以指定怪物必定留下尸体，使用 <w>never_corpse</w> 则指定它绝不留下尸体。

怪物默认以睡眠状态生成。给名称添加 <w>generate_awake</w> 前缀可改变这一点。

<w>generate_awake boulder beetle</w>

添加 <w>patrolling</w> 前缀，可防止怪物走出其生成地点的视野范围。

使用 <w>god</w>: 指定怪物信奉的神祇，例如：

<w>orc god:the_shining_one</w>

如果怪物应当是指定神祇的恩赐，还需要添加 <w>god_gift</w> 后缀：

<w>orc god:the_shining_one god_gift</w>

注意：除非明确设置了 <w>god_gift</w>，否则怪物不会被视为神赐。

使用 <w>att</w>: 指定怪物的阵营，可选值为：

* <w>att:hostile</w> -- 默认状态
* <w>att:friendly</w> -- 驯服，会跟随你
* <w>att:neutral</w> -- 敌视你及 att:hostile 怪物
* <w>att:good_neutral</w> -- 敌视 att:hostile 怪物
* <w>att:fellow_slime</w> -- 驯服，但不会跟随你

可以给怪物指定颜色，以覆盖其默认颜色：

<w>col:darkgrey fungus</w>

可以指定颜色 <w>any</w>，此时会随机选择颜色。

使用 <w>tile</w>: 指定显示的怪物图块，例如：

<w>rat tile:mons_giant_bat</w>

在图块版中，这会创建一个使用“<cyan>mons_giant_bat</cyan>”图块、其他方面与老鼠完全相同的怪物。在 ASCII 模式下则没有效果。

要生成适合地图所在楼层的随机怪物，可以使用：

<w>random</w>

要生成适合其他地点的随机怪物，可以在怪物定义中使用 place: 标签：

<w>place:Abyss</w>

使用 <w>place</w>: 就意味着请求随机怪物。也可以请求从适合其他深度的随机怪物生成僵尸，例如：

<w>place:Elf:3 zombie</w>

可用修饰词为 <w>zombie</w>、<w>draugr</w>、<w>simulacrum</w> 和 <w>spectre</w>。

<h>覆盖怪物名称</h>

可以为单个怪物命名，例如：

<w>kobold name:Durwent</w>

这会让怪物显示为“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。名称中的空格可以用 _ 代替。命名时请注意，所有名称后都会添加“<cyan>the <<race></cyan>”。

名称可用三种不同的修饰词：<w>name_adjective</w>、<w>name_suffix and </w>name_replace。<w>name_adjective</w> 使名称充当形容词。例如：

<w>kobold name:ugly name_adjective</w>

这会生成“<cyan>An ugly kobold</cyan>”“<cyan>The ugly kobold hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_suffix</w> 作用相似，但位于怪物基础名称之后：

<w>kobold name:wearing_mittens name_suffix</w>

这会生成“<cyan>A kobold wearing mittens</cyan>”“<cyan>The kobold wearing mittens hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_replace</w> 用指定名称替代基础名称，就像独特怪物一样：

<w>kobold name:Durwent name_replace</w>

结果会是“<cyan>Durwent</cyan>”，而非“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。其尸体仍会是“<cyan>kobold corpse of Durwent</cyan>”。

<w>name_species</w> 会让尸体直接使用该名称；对于 <w>name_replace</w>，不再添加“<cyan>kobold</cyan> <cyan>corpse of X</cyan>”前缀。它还会隐藏本地图块版中通常显示在独特怪物与改名怪物上方的名称标签。

与 <w>name_replace</w> 或 <w>name_species</w> 配合时，还有两个标签可用于修改称呼方式，而不赋予实际“姓名”：<w>name_descriptor</w> 与 <w>name_definite</w>。

例如：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace</w>

这会生成“<cyan>goblin hits you</cyan>”。但加入上述 <w>name_descriptor</w> 标记后，会生成“<cyan>The goblin hits you</cyan>”，怪物说明中则显示“<cyan>A goblin</cyan>”。

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor</w>

<w>name_definite</w> 保证称呼永远不使用“<cyan>a</cyan>”或“<cyan>an</cyan>”，而始终使用定冠词。因此，除了上述“<cyan>The
<cyan>goblin</cyan> <cyan>hits you</cyan>”，说明中也会显示“<cyan>The goblin</cyan>”。设置 <w>name_definite</w> 会自动设置 <w>name_descriptor</w>，因此：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_definite</w>

与以下写法完全相同：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor name_definite</w>

<w>name_zombie</w> 可用于重新定义已经亡灵化的怪物，包括尸鬼、冰像及幽灵。

最后，<w>name_nocorpse</w> 会让尸体完全忽略该名称。例如：

<w>wizard name:sad name_adjective name_nocorpse</w>

这会生成“<cyan>a sad wizard</cyan>”，留下的则是“<cyan>a wizard corpse</cyan>”。

如果定义空间有限，可以使用这些标签的缩写：

* <w>name_suffix</w> -> <w>n_suf</w>
* <w>name_adjective</w> -> <w>n_adj</w>
* <w>name_replace</w> -> <w>n_rpl</w>
* <w>name_species</w> -> <w>n_spe</w>
* <w>name_descriptor</w> -> <w>n_des</w>
* <w>name_definite</w> -> <w>n_the</w>
* <w>name_zombie</w> -> <w>n_zom</w>
* <w>name_nocorpse</w> -> <w>n_noc</w>

<h>覆盖怪物属性</h>

使用 <w>hd</w> 与 <w>hp</w> 可以进一步自定义怪物，完全覆盖其原有生命骰与生命值：

<w>kobold hd:20</w>

这会创建生命骰为 20 的狗头人。由于生命值依据生命骰随机生成，其生命值也会重新随机。具有固定生命值的怪物则不会因此改变生命值。

也可以指定确切的生命值：

<w>kobold hp:20</w>

这会创建生命值为 20 的狗头人。对于生命值不随机的怪物，例如雕像，这也很有用。

使用 <w>dur</w> 与 <w>sum</w> 标签可以将怪物标记为召唤物。<w>dur</w> 接受 1 至 6（含两端）的整数。<w>sum</w> 接受法术名（按下述 <w>spells</w> 标签的规则解析），或以下任一值：<w>clone</w>（罗刹的复制体）、<w>animate</w>（操纵死尸）、<w>chaos</w>（纯混沌构成）、<w>miscast</w>（施法失误效果召来）、<w>zot</w>（佐特陷阱召来）、<w>wrath</w>（神祇为惩戒而召来）、<w>aid</w>（神祇为援助而召来）。

法术中，<w>shadow_creatures</w> 的效果最显著：怪物会散入阴影，而非化为烟雾消失。使用非召唤法术则不会产生这类效果。

使用 <w>seen</w> 标记，会强制将怪物设为已经见过，因此不会出现“<cyan>A kobold comes into view</cyan>”等消息。

<h>覆盖怪物法术</h>

使用 <w>spells</w>: 标签可以覆盖怪物法术组，例如：

*<w>goblin spells:throw_flame.50.wizard</w>
*<w>ancient lich spells:symbol_of_torment.26.wizard; glaciate.51.wizard</w>

（这里是一组法术槽。每个槽由法术名、施放频率及法术槽标记构成；名称中的空格用下划线替换，后续字段以 <w>.</w> 分隔，各槽以 <w>;</w> 分隔。<w>;</w> 两侧及 <w>spells</w>: 前缀之后都不应有空格。）

法术名必须与 <cyan>spl-data.h</cyan> 中的名称完全匹配，并将空格替换为下划线。施放频率表示每次以 x/200 的概率施展该法术。法术标记包括：

* <w>natural</w>、<w>magical</w>、<w>demonic</w>、<w>wizard</w> 或 <w>priest</w> -- 指定施放方式。巫师和祭司可被沉默，并触发相应神祇行为判定：特洛戈赞赏击杀巫师，比欧弗赞赏击杀祭司。魔法、恶魔和巫师法术受反魔法影响。自然能力不制造噪音。
* <w>emergency</w> -- 怪物只在生命值较低时施展此法术。
* <w>breath</w> -- 该法术是吐息武器；使用后会进入一段无法再次施展的吐息冷却时间。
* <w>no_silent</w> -- 沉默时无法使用，即使这种能力通常不受沉默影响。
* <w>instant</w> -- 不消耗怪物行动能量，因此它可以在同一回合再次行动。
* <w>noisy</w> -- 强制法术制造噪音，即使它是自然能力。

使用 <w>none</w> 可以指定空法术槽。要强制怪物没有任何法术，可使用：

<w>orc wizard spells:none</w>

<h>设置附魔状态</h>

你可以赋予怪物任意数量的附魔状态，例如生成时加速、失明或永久偏转投射物。语法为 <w>ench:<<name>:<<duration>:<<degree></w> 或 <w>perm_ench:<<name>:<<degree></w>。<w><<degree></w> 与 <w><<duration></w> 字段可以省略。

例如：

* <w>orc perm_ench:blind perm_ench:mad</w>
* <w>dream sheep ench:sticky_flame</w>
* <w>stone giant dur:1 ench:berserk</w>
