entries.english:
Remembers your ancestor as a battlemage, a warrior capable of relentless offence
with both melee and conjurations. This choice is permanent and cannot be undone.
entries.translation: 将先祖记作一位战斗法师，一位能以近战与塑能魔法持续猛攻的战士。此选择永久生效，无法撤销。

entries.english:
Remembers your ancestor as a hexer, a cunning rogue capable of swift
knifework and debilitating spellcasting. This choice is permanent and cannot be
undone.
entries.translation: 将先祖记作一位妖术师，一位能以迅捷刀法与削弱法术制敌的狡黠游荡者。此选择永久生效，无法撤销。

issues.review: context_review:施法行为或削弱法术描述，不是技能标题

entries.english:
Reveals Ru's truth to your enemies, dealing severe damage to all enemies in
your line of sight. Affected creatures may be paralysed, slowed or have their
magic drained. The damage dealt increases with your piety and experience level.
entries.translation: 向敌人揭示入的真理，对视野内所有敌人造成严重伤害。受影响的生物可能麻痹、减速，或受到反魔法干扰。伤害随虔诚和经验等级提高而增加。

entries.english:
Scatters your physical form into a swarm of vampire bats, melding your equipment
but allowing you to move quickly and evasively. The number of bats that issue
from your body is so immense that it even fills nearby spaces like a choking
cloud, assailing enemies and gradually putting them to sleep.

After using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover
enough power to use it again. (Shapeshifting skill will increase the rate at
which this skill recharges.)
entries.translation:
将身体分散为一群吸血蝙蝠，使装备融入身体，但让你移动迅速、身法灵活。从体内涌出的蝙蝠数量极多，甚至如令人窒息的云雾般填满附近空间，袭击敌人，并逐渐使其入睡。

使用后，你必须获得经验值，才能恢复足够的力量再次使用此能力。（变形术技能会加快此能力的恢复速度。）

entries.english:
Attempts to bind the soul of a living, holy, or demonic being into your eternal
service. If the targeted monster is slain before it leaves your sight, it will
return as a bound soul, retaining the equipment, spells and abilities it had in
life.

Only beings who are relatively uninjured may be targeted, and the focus required
to keep their soul from escaping will consume 1/3 of the user's current health -
returning it only upon slaying them. The attempt will fail entirely if the
targeted monster leaves your sight before the process is complete.

The bound soul's health is influenced by the user's Invocations skill. It will
follow its captor through stairs, and can be recalled from other levels.

Only one soul can be bound at a time.
entries.translation:
尝试束缚一个活物、神圣生物或恶魔的灵魂，使其永远为你效力。若目标怪物在离开你的视野前被杀死，就会作为受缚灵魂归来，保留生前的装备、法术和能力。

只能以伤势较轻的生物为目标。为防止其灵魂逃逸而集中精神，会消耗使用者当前生命的 1/3，只有杀死目标后才会返还。若过程完成前目标离开你的视野，尝试就会彻底失败。

受缚灵魂的生命取决于使用者的祈祷技能。它会随束缚者上下楼梯，也可从其他楼层召回。

同时只能束缚一个灵魂。

entries.english:
Turns the user into living lightning and zaps them at the chosen monster,
dealing electric damage to everything in their path and depositing the user
at the bolt's end. After using this ability, you will be unable to use it
again for a short time.
entries.translation: 使使用者化为活体闪电，射向选定怪物，对路径上的一切造成电击伤害，并在闪电终点重新现身。使用后，短时间内无法再次使用此能力。

entries.english:
Permanently bloodies a weapon of your choice with the essence of pain
itself. This blessing cannot be used on artefact weapons. You must choose
between this gift or that of knowledge of the most powerful necromantic spells,
and either gift may only be received once.
entries.translation: 以痛苦本身的精髓永久浸染一件自选武器，不能用于神器武器。此赐福与最强大死灵法术的知识只能二选一，且只能领取一次。

entries.english:
Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting
fly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots
and scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful
din fills the air.

These items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short
distance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire
through them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your
foes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.

After using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover
enough power to use it again.
entries.translation:
完全展现你的骚灵本性，让你附身的所有防具短暂飞出，独立于你的其他行动发动攻击。靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，欢快的喧闹声充斥四周。

这些物品仍与你相连，只能被指挥到近处，但它们受到的伤害不会由你承担，你也可以自由地穿过它们射击。它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的不利状态，有时是晕眩、吸能，甚至混乱。

使用后，你必须获得经验值，才能恢复足够的力量再次使用此能力。

entries.english:
Sends funds to a merchant to help them set up shop at your location. The cost of
funding a shop increases with the number of shops funded.
entries.translation: 向商人提供资金，帮助其在你所在的位置开店。资助的店铺越多，开店费用越高。

entries.english:
Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any
unoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.
entries.translation: 喷出浓酸，腐蚀命中的目标，并在经过的空格上留下腐蚀云雾。

issues.review: context_review:地图格子或界面条件标签，不是图块模式名称

entries.english:
Corrupts the current level by unleashing Abyssal energies on it. This will
cause the area nearby to change appearance, and will gate in creatures from the
Abyss bent on causing destruction. This will not work on levels already
corrupted or in the Abyss itself. The size of the effect is increased by
Invocations skill.
entries.translation: 在当前楼层释放深渊能量，使其腐化。附近区域的面貌会改变，并打开通道，放出一心破坏的深渊生物。无法用于已腐化的楼层或深渊本身。影响范围随祈祷技能提高而扩大。

entries.english:
Plays four cards from a deck in the time it normally takes to draw a
single card.
entries.translation: 用通常抽取一张牌所需的时间，从一副牌组中连续打出四张牌。

entries.english:
Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. Activating the
ability has no cost and simply prepares you to start digging; once active,
moving into a wall will start tunnelling. Doing so makes some noise and drains
the user's maximum health.

Once active, activating the ability again or making any non-digging movement
action will cancel the Dig status.
entries.translation:
允许在软岩和锈蚀栅栏中挖掘通道。发动此能力没有消耗，只是进入准备挖掘的状态；生效后，向墙壁移动就会开始挖掘。这会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。

生效后，再次发动此能力，或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作，都会取消挖掘状态。

entries.english:
Greatly increases your maximum health and magic points, depending on
Invocations skill. Your current health and magic points will also be increased
proportionally.
entries.translation: 大幅提高生命与魔力上限，增幅取决于祈祷技能。当前生命与魔力也会按比例提高。

entries.english:
Donates half of your gold to Zin, which will increase your piety over time. The
overall increase is determined by the size of your donation.
entries.translation: 将一半金币捐给辛，使虔诚随时间逐渐增加。总增幅取决于捐献规模。

entries.english: Draws a card from a deck of power.
entries.translation: 从一副力量牌组中抽取一张牌。

entries.english:
Enters you into single combat with a worthy foe. On success, you and the
challenged foe will be transported to Okawaru's Arena to fight to the death,
with no escape until you either emerge victorious or are slain.

Half of your missing health will be restored as the duel begins, and upon
victory, Okawaru will return your health and magical power to whatever they
were before you issued the challenge - letting you shake off any damage taken
during it in the blink of an eye.
entries.translation:
让你与一位配得上的对手单独决斗。成功后，你与被挑战者会被传送至奥格瓦如的竞技场，战至一方死亡。只有获胜或被杀，才能离开。

决斗开始时，会恢复你已损失生命的一半。获胜后，奥格瓦如会将你的生命与魔力恢复到发起挑战前的数值，让你转瞬间摆脱决斗中受到的伤害。

entries.english:
Causes your elemental clouds to coalesce into friendly elementals. Your
Invocations skill increases the maximum number of elementals that can be
created with one use of the ability.
entries.translation: 将你的元素云雾凝聚成友善的元素生物。祈祷技能会提高一次使用最多能创造的元素生物数量。

entries.english:
Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting
at the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.

While in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by
encumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the
latter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made
while Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,
and heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.

Each spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end
once you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).

At your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum
of {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.
entries.translation:
将幽焰催至炽盛，燃尽积累的全部记忆，大幅增强施法能力。

在此状态下，伤害类法术不消耗魔力，不受负重影响，并获得施法成功率和法术强度加成，后者随经验等级提高。在燃忆状态下进行的法术爪击，还会造成与所施法术等级成正比的额外伤害，并按所造成伤害的一定比例治疗你。

在燃忆状态下，每次施法都会消耗一份记忆。记忆耗尽时，状态就会结束；即使仍有记忆，经过短暂时间后也会结束。

以你当前的经验等级，所能容纳的记忆最多支持以此方式连续施放 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。

issues.expected: 地面/楼层/地板/向下取整

entries.english: <Berserk ability>
entries.translation: <Berserk ability>

entries.english:
Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. These unholy forces harm the victim and
anyone adjacent, and are not affected by any means of protection, such as armour
or resistances. However, certain creatures, usually those able to invoke
damnation themselves, are entirely unscathed by damnation. The power of this
ability scales with the Evocations skill.
entries.translation: 以天谴轰击目标敌人。这股邪恶力量会伤害目标及其相邻生物，不受护甲值或抗性等任何防护手段影响。不过，某些生物完全不受天谴伤害，通常是那些自己也能调用这种力量的生物。此能力的威力随唤发技能提高而增强。

entries.context: textdb:descript/ability.txt:evoke the staff of olgreb ability
entries.english:
Causes the caster to radiate toxic energy, continuously inflicting poison on
everything in line of sight for as long as the aura lasts. The power of this
ability scales with the Evocations skill, and this ability is available only
while wielding the Staff of Olgreb.
entries.translation: 使施法者散发剧毒能量，在光环持续期间，不断使视野内所有目标中毒。此能力的威力随唤发技能提高而增强，且只有持用奥格雷布之杖时才能使用。

entries.english:
Engulfs the user's surroundings in Yredelemnul's inexorable grip. So long as you
remain within this profane sanctuary, all hostile creatures that share it with
you will be bound in place, and their life force will be continuously drained to
restore your own. Victims who are isolated from their allies will take damage at
a greatly increased rate.

The affected area will shrink over time, and a new one cannot be created until
the old one has fully expired.
entries.translation:
以伊莱德莱姆努尔不可挣脱的掌控笼罩使用者周围。只要你留在这片亵渎的庇护领域内，其中所有敌对生物都会被定在原地，其生命力也会不断被吸取，用来恢复你的生命。与盟友隔离的受害者会更快地受到伤害。

影响范围会逐渐缩小，旧领域完全消失前，无法创造新的领域。

entries.english:
Conjures a swarm of animate flames all around you. These rapidly seek the
nearest monsters, burning them. They will dissipate harmlessly if unable to
reach a target or if you swap places with them.
entries.translation: 在你四周唤出一群活焰。它们会迅速追逐最近的怪物，并灼烧目标。若无法抵达目标，或你与其交换位置，它们就会无害地消散。

issues.review: context_review:有活力的火焰，不是亡灵动画术名

entries.english:
Heals a creature other than yourself by a moderate amount, depending on
Invocations skill. Using this ability on hostile monsters will try to turn them
neutral. This works best on living creatures, with the undead and demons being
progressively harder to pacify. Intelligent creatures are also more difficult
to pacify.

Ghosts of dead adventurers and demon lords are too wrathful to be pacified,
mindless creatures are too unintelligent to be pacified, and no monster can be
pacified while it is asleep.

Whether the pacification succeeds or not, the invested piety and magic points
are lost. If it does succeed, the monster is healed and you gain the monster's
full experience value. Otherwise, the monster is unaffected and you gain
nothing.
entries.translation:
中等幅度治疗自己以外的一个生物，治疗量取决于祈祷技能。对敌对怪物使用时，会尝试使其转为中立。对活物最有效，亡灵更难安抚，恶魔则更难；有智慧的生物也更难安抚。

死去冒险者的幽灵与恶魔领主怒意过盛，无法安抚；无心智生物不具备足够的智慧，也无法安抚。睡着的怪物同样无法安抚。

无论安抚成功与否，投入的虔诚与魔力都会消耗。成功时，怪物会受到治疗，你获得其全部经验值；失败时，怪物不受影响，你也一无所获。

entries.english:
Invokes a storm of heavenly clouds. While the storm rages, your evasion and
combat accuracy and damage are substantially increased, and striking enemies
with martial attacks increases this bonus. The storm weakens over time and
fades away once the bonus reaches zero. The heavenly clouds prevent
invisibility, and obscure the vision of those outside the storm.
entries.translation: 召来一场天界云雾风暴。风暴持续期间，你的闪避值、战斗命中率与伤害都会大幅提高，以武术攻击命中敌人可继续提高这些加成。风暴会随时间减弱，加成降至零时便会消散。天界云雾会阻止隐形，并遮蔽风暴外生物的视线。

entries.english:
Hops toward a chosen destination, landing somewhere nearby. After using this
ability, you will be unable to hop again until you have spent some time not
moving. (Other actions, such as casting spells and attacking, are fine.)
entries.translation: 向选定目的地跳跃，在附近某处落地。使用后，需要经过一段不移动的时间才能再次跳跃；施法、攻击等其他动作不受此限制。

entries.english:
Blasts a targeted enemy with damnation. These unholy forces harm the victim and
anyone adjacent, and are not affected by any means of protection, such as armour
or resistances. However, certain creatures, usually those able to invoke
damnation themselves, are entirely unscathed by damnation.
entries.translation: 以天谴轰击目标敌人。这股邪恶力量会伤害目标及其相邻的所有生物，不受护甲值或抗性等任何防护手段影响。不过，某些生物完全不受其伤害，通常是那些自己也能调用这种力量的生物。

entries.english:
Hurls a gout of umbral fire from the Black Torch, which deals irresistible
damage to living, demonic, and holy beings. The torchlight will also briefly
empower any of your undead servants caught in its blast, and is harmless to
those who worship Yredelemnul. The damage is increased by Invocations skill.

This ability can be used only while the torch is lit, and only a limited number
of times on each floor. The number of uses available per floor increases with
piety, and stoking the Black Torch's flames with a particularly remarkable soul
by killing a unique named enemy will also provide an additional use.
entries.translation:
从黑炬中掷出一股幽影之火，对活物、恶魔和神圣生物造成无法抵抗的伤害。爆发中的己方亡灵仆从会短暂得到强化，而伊莱德莱姆努尔的信徒不会受到伤害。伤害随祈祷技能提高而增加。

此能力仅在黑炬点燃时可用，且每层的使用次数有限。每层可用次数随虔诚提高而增加；击杀有独特名字的敌人，以其非凡灵魂为黑炬添火，也会额外获得一次使用机会。

issues.expected: 地面/楼层/地板/向下取整

entries.english:
Restores your ancestor to an idyllic vision of their best self. Their wounds
are forgotten and a glow of perfection infuses them, giving them a short-lived
but dramatic increase in strength, spellcasting, and armour. The quality of the
healing and duration of the idealisation granted are both improved by the
Invocations skill.
entries.translation: 使先祖恢复为你心目中最完美的模样。其伤势会被遗忘，完美的光辉充盈其身，短暂而显著地提高力量、施法能力与护甲值。治疗效果与理想化持续时间都随祈祷技能提高而改善。

entries.english:
Leaps through the air in the blink of an eye. While it is impossible to control
your destination, the movement is so abrupt and agile that no monster will be
able to land a blow on you until you can act again, and many may lose track of
your position entirely.

You must spend a short while recovering between each use of this ability.
entries.translation:
转瞬间跃过空中。虽然无法控制落点，动作却极其突然灵巧，以至于在你能再次行动前，没有怪物能命中你，许多怪物甚至会完全失去你的踪迹。

每次使用后，都必须短暂恢复才能再次使用。

entries.english:
Performs an incredibly fast leap to a targeted location, causing an explosion
upon landing which damages all adjacent foes. The amount of damage done
increases with your piety and experience level.
entries.translation: 以惊人速度跃向目标位置，落地时引发爆炸，伤害所有相邻敌人。伤害随虔诚和经验等级提高而增加。

entries.english:
Invokes a night from before the stars first burned in the sky, engulfing your
surroundings in impenetrable darkness. The user's sight radius will be reduced
to nothing, preventing enemies from tracking or aiming abilities at you, and
slowly expand back to normal over the duration of the effect. Your stealth will
also be increased.

It cannot be invoked again until its effect has fully ended, as even the very
first night of creation must eventually give way to day.

Invocations skill increases the duration of the effect.
entries.translation:
唤来星辰尚未在天空燃起前的夜晚，以无法穿透的黑暗吞没周围。使用者的视野半径会降至零，使敌人无法追踪你或瞄准你使用能力，随后在效果持续期间缓慢恢复正常。你的潜行也会提高。

效果完全结束前无法再次调用，因为即使创世之初的第一夜，最终也必须让位于白昼。

祈祷技能会延长效果持续时间。

entries.english:
Purges your body of poison, confusion, slowness, petrification, weakness, and
sickness. Any drained maximum health will also be fully restored.
entries.translation: 清除你体内的毒素、混乱、缓慢、石化、虚弱和疾病，并完全恢复因吸能而损失的生命上限。

entries.english:
Grants you knowledge of the most powerful and sinister Necromancy spells:
Haunt, Borgnjor's Revivification, Infestation, and Death's Door. You must choose
between this gift or that of branding a weapon with pain, and either gift may
only be received once.
entries.translation: 授予你最强大而阴险的死灵法术知识：鬼魂缠身、博格尼奥的复生术、虫群寄生和死亡之门。此赐福与赋予武器痛苦印记只能二选一，且只能领取一次。

entries.english:
Anoints a defeated apostle, and welcomes them as a permanent follower. They will
follow you between floors and into any peril, willingly giving their life for
the cause and their kin.

If they die, Beogh will eventually revive them once you gain sufficient piety -
this process can be greatly accelerated by satisfying Beogh with the slaying of
all foes who may have contributed to their apostle's death.

You can have at most 3 followers accompanying you at a time, though you may
freely dismiss old ones to invite new ones.
entries.translation:
为一位被击败的使徒施行膏礼，接纳其成为永久追随者。他们会随你穿行楼层、共赴险境，甘愿为信仰与同族献出生命。

若他们死去，在你获得足够虔诚后，比欧弗终会将其复活。杀死所有可能参与导致使徒死亡的敌人、令比欧弗满意，可大幅加快这一过程。

同时最多可有 3 位追随者随行，但你可自由遣散旧追随者，邀请新人。

entries.english:
Sacrifices the ability to evoke any magical items, and prevents you from having
any ranks in the Evocations skill.

This includes wands and other items which use Evocations skill - that is, it does
*not* affect reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders
magical staves much less effective in melee.
entries.translation:
牺牲发动任何魔法物品的能力，并使唤发技能无法拥有任何等级。

这包括魔杖及其他使用唤发技能的物品；也就是说，*不*影响长距攻击武器、变形护符和神塔小雕像。这也会使魔法法杖的近战效果大幅减弱。

entries.english:
Sacrifices your skills, causing you to have all of your skill aptitudes
decreased by one. This will likely cause you to lose ranks in trained skills.
entries.translation: 牺牲技能，使所有技能的天资降低一级。这很可能导致已训练的技能等级下降。

entries.english:
Transforms the area around the user into a domain of unbreakable law for a short
duration. So long as anyone stands within this sanctuary, no harm may be done to
them by others, and they may do no harm to others in turn.

Beings with hostile intent are unable to enter a sanctuary and those already
nearby when it is created will be forced to flee.
entries.translation:
将使用者周围短暂化为不可违逆的律法领域。只要身在庇护所内，就不会受到他人伤害，也无法伤害他人。

怀有敌意的生物无法进入庇护所；庇护所形成时已在附近的敌对生物会被迫逃离。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
Allows you to move at supernatural speeds, making any normal movements up to a
distance of two tiles instant. Martial attacks performed under the effect of
Serpent's Lash are more damaging and never miss.
entries.translation: 使你以超自然速度移动，让最多两格距离的普通移动瞬间完成。在腾蛇鞭效果下进行的武术攻击伤害更高，并且必定命中。

issues.review: context_review:地图格子或界面条件标签，不是图块模式名称

entries.english:
Sends you to a random position one to three floors down, as if you jumped into
a shaft trap. It takes some time to dig the shaft.
entries.translation: 如同跳入竖井陷阱，将你送到下方一至三层的随机位置。挖掘竖井需要一些时间。

entries.english: [[Sign of Ruin spell]]
entries.translation: [[Sign of Ruin spell]]

entries.english:
[[Smiting spell]] The strength of the smiting is increased by Invocations skill.

Beogh will not allow you to use this directly against another apostle during a
divine trial.
entries.translation:
[[Smiting spell]] 神罚的威力随祈祷技能提高而增强。

比欧弗不允许你在神圣试炼中直接用此能力对付另一位使徒。

entries.english:
Removes you completely from the flow of time. Time will pass as it usually does,
and monsters will wander away and sometimes even fall back to sleep. After some
time has passed, you will return in the same state as the very second you
departed.

Invocations skill increases the likelihood that your absence will have been so
long that alert monsters have fallen asleep again.
entries.translation:
使你完全脱离时间流。时间仍照常流逝，怪物会游荡离去，有时甚至重新入睡。一段时间后，你会以离去那一瞬间的状态归来。

祈祷技能越高，你离去的时间长到足以让警觉怪物重新入睡的可能性就越大。

entries.english:
Summons a powerful warrior against evil, either an angel or a daeva. The
duration of their assistance is increased by Invocations skill, and glory in
battle may lead the Shining One to bless them with an even longer stay.
entries.translation: 召唤一位强大的邪恶克星：天使或提婆。其协助时间随祈祷技能提高而延长；若在战斗中立下功勋，光明神还可能赐福，使其停留更久。

entries.english:
Draws three cards from any deck, and allows you to choose one to play,
discarding the other two.
entries.translation: 从任意牌组抽取三张牌，选择其中一张打出，弃掉另外两张。

entries.english:
Vaults off an adjacent wall towards enemies, striking all enemies adjacent to
the landing spot and taking two turns to complete the motion.
entries.translation: 蹬踏相邻墙壁跃向敌人，攻击落点周围所有敌人。整个动作耗时两个回合。

issues.review: context_review:密室或蹬墙动作，不是宝库分支

entries.english:
Turns all of the water near you into a surging tide that attempts to drown every
enemy standing in or above it. Those who need air to breathe will also become
Flooded, preventing them from casting spells affected by Silence for several
turns and dealing minor asphyxiation damage.

After using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover
enough power to use it again.
entries.translation:
使你附近的所有水域化为汹涌潮水，尝试淹没站在其中或其上方的每个敌人。需要空气呼吸的目标还会进入淹水状态，在数回合内无法施放受静默影响的法术，并受到少量窒息伤害。

使用后，你必须获得经验值，才能恢复足够的力量再次使用此能力。

entries.english:
Speaks a word of chaos, forcing enemies nearby to blink away from the user.
Additionally, those affected may be slowed, ensnared, or terrified by the
experience. Invoking a word of chaos is no easy feat and will drain the user's
maximum health somewhat, and the ability then cannot be used again for a short
time.
entries.translation: 说出混沌真言，迫使附近敌人闪烁离开使用者。受影响者还可能被减速、缠绕或吓退。调用混沌真言并非易事，会降低使用者的部分生命上限，随后短时间内无法再次使用。

issues.review: context_review:经历、体验或升级动作，不是独立经验数值标签
context_review:闪现逃脱或闪烁离开的动作，不强制套用法术名

entries.english:
Alchemists start with the Poisonous Vapours spell, and their magic is very
effective against foes susceptible to poison.
entries.translation: 炼金术士起始掌握毒气术，其魔法对易受毒素影响的敌人十分有效。

entries.english:
Berserkers believe in Trog, the magic-hating god of frenzy. Not much can stop a
raging berserker early on, apart from hubris.
entries.translation: 狂战士信奉憎恶魔法的狂怒之神特洛戈。初期几乎没有什么能阻挡暴怒的狂战士，除了狂妄自大。

entries.english:
Conjurers begin with the Magic Dart spell, and can learn other non-elemental
spells to reliably blast their foes.
entries.translation: 塑能师起始掌握魔法飞弹，还能学习其他非元素法术，可靠地轰击敌人。

entries.english:
Enchanters know a variety of Hexes that can incapacitate their foes, and are
equipped with an enchanted dagger and potions of invisibility.
entries.translation: 妖术师掌握多种能让敌人失去行动能力的妖术，并配有附魔匕首和隐形药水。

entries.english:
Gladiators are ready for the arena with light armour, a weapon of their choice,
and a few throwing weapons and nets.
entries.translation: 角斗士身穿轻甲、手持自选武器，携带少量投掷武器和投网，随时准备进入竞技场。

entries.english: Hunters carry a shortbow, light armour and a scroll of butterflies.
entries.translation: 猎手携带短弓、轻甲和蝴蝶卷轴。

entries.english:
Necromancers start out with the Soul Splinter spell. Eventually, they can turn
the dead into allies and use the life force of the living to restore themselves.
entries.translation: 死灵法师起始掌握灵魂碎裂。最终，他们能够将死者变为盟友，并汲取生者的生命力恢复自身。

issues.review: context_review:法术专名已经说明对象，不必重复法术二字

entries.english:
Reavers start with a weapon of their choice and deadly magic to supplement it
when in need. They start with the Kiss of Death spell.
entries.translation: 掠夺者起始携带自选武器，并能在需要时用致命魔法辅助作战。他们起始掌握死亡之吻。

entries.english:
Shapeshifters use talismans to shift their form, making them powerful melee
fighters (especially when unarmed) at the cost of armour.
entries.translation: 变形者用变形护符改变自身形态，牺牲护甲来换取强大的近战能力，徒手战斗时尤其如此。

entries.english:
Warpers start with a weapon of their choice, a scroll of blinking, darts of
disjunction, and some Translocation spells in their library.
entries.translation: 位移术士起始携带自选武器、闪烁卷轴和离散飞镖，法术库中还有一些位移系法术。

entries.english:
The Abyss is a truly bizarre place, ever-changing and twisted. It is filled
with all sorts of monsters, mostly of demonic nature, whose common aim is to
feast on intruders. It is also the garbage dump for many sorcerers, who delight
in sending would-be champions like you to these proving grounds of madness.
Reportedly, there is some structure to the chaos, as Lugonu seems to concoct
schemes around this place and its denizens.

Portals to the Abyss are found abundantly in the Depths.

The Abyss consists of seven infinite levels. The abyssal rune of Zot can be
found from the third level onwards, and is more common at greater depths.
Portals back to the dungeon are scattered throughout the Abyss, and are found
more commonly at greater depths or while carrying the abyssal rune.

Killing monsters will warp the substance of the Abyss, eventually generating a
gateway out. Further persistence will wear holes in the Abyss, allowing descent
into deeper layers.

The fabric of the Abyss takes greater notice of the powerful; no matter how
they arrive, more experienced adventurers will find themselves drawn deeper
within the maddening expanse of that realm.
entries.translation:
深渊是真正离奇之地，永远变化、永远扭曲。这里满是各种怪物，多数具有恶魔本性，共同的目标就是吞食入侵者。它也是许多术士的垃圾场；他们乐于把你这样自命英雄的人送进这片疯狂试炼场。据说混沌中仍有某种秩序，因为卢戈努似乎正围绕此地及其居民策划阴谋。

地底中有许多通往深渊的传送门。

深渊由七个无限大的楼层构成。从第三层开始可以找到深渊符文，越深越常见。返回地下城的出口散布各处；越深入，或身上带着深渊符文时，越容易发现出口。

击杀怪物会扭曲深渊的物质，最终产生出口。继续坚持下去，还会在深渊撕开裂隙，让你进入更深的楼层。

深渊的结构对强者格外敏感：无论以何种方式到来，经验更丰富的冒险者都会发现，自己被吸入这片疯狂国度的更深处。

issues.review: context_review:深渊符文使用完整既定名称，不强制补佐特

entries.english:
The Crucible of Flesh is an infernal pit where Makhleb's most devoted and
detested alike are made to sanctify themselves in blood. No sane mortal would
ever choose to come here, and yet even victims of the Destroyer's greatest ire
may be granted passage out once more, should they mete out mutilation equal to
the demonic torturers of this realm.
entries.translation: 血肉熔炉是一处地狱深坑，马科列布最虔诚与最憎恶的人，都会被迫在此以鲜血圣化自身。没有神志正常的凡人会自愿来这里。然而，即使是承受毁灭者最深愤怒的受害者，只要造成的残害能与此地的恶魔刑吏相比，也可能再次获准离开。

issues.review: context_review:穿行、时间流逝或出口语境，不强制使用通道

entries.english:
The Crypt is a huge repository for the ancient dead. The air is chill and
fetid, the walls cold and damp. Bones are strewn liberally everywhere, and
every noise echoes worryingly, violating the overbearing silence of the grave.
entries.translation: 墓室是安放古老死者的巨大场所。空气寒冷腐臭，墙壁冰凉潮湿，骸骨四处散落。每一声响动都会激起令人不安的回声，冒犯坟墓压倒一切的寂静。

entries.english:
The Desolation was once ruled by the divines Sheza and Sargol. After the dread
twins were cast down, the good gods reduced their former realm to salt, that
such a terrible cult would never rise again. Amidst the ruins, only the last
cultists of the dead gods, their heretical constructs, and the guardians
of the cult's legendary treasure yet remain.
entries.translation: 荒盐之地曾由神明 西泽 与 赛格尔 统治。可怕的双神被推翻后，善神将他们昔日的国度化为盐土，以免如此恐怖的邪教再次兴起。如今，废墟中只剩亡神最后的信徒、他们异端的构装体，以及邪教传说宝藏的守卫。

entries.english:
Gehenna is a realm of lava, flames and damnation. Those who linger will have
fire and brimstone rained down upon them.

The acrid smoke renders scrolls unreadable.
entries.translation:
欣嫩谷充满熔岩、烈焰与天谴。逗留者将遭受火焰与硫磺之雨。

刺鼻的浓烟使卷轴无法阅读。

entries.english:
The {{ if you.branch() == "Elf" or you.branch() == "Swamp" or
you.branch() == "Snake" or you.branch() == "Shoals" or you.branch() == "Spider"
then return "glacial chasm"; else return "ice cave"; end }} is a desolate cavern
shaped from solid ice and filled with the echoes of bestial howls. The intricate
carvings and statues which once lined its walls have been warped and obscured by
centuries of slow melting and refreezing.
entries.translation:
{{ if you.branch() == "Elf" or you.branch() == "Swamp" or
you.branch() == "Snake" or you.branch() == "Shoals" or you.branch() == "Spider"
then return "冰川裂隙"; else return "冰窟"; end }}是一座由坚冰塑成的荒凉洞窟，回荡着野兽的嚎叫。墙边昔日精致的雕刻与塑像，经过数百年缓慢融化与再度冻结，早已扭曲模糊。

entries.english:
The ossuary is a small tomb containing the remains and grave goods of some
distant relatives of the pharaohs, along with the corpses of their retainers
and household animals. It is undoubtedly riddled with many traps, and its
undead denizens are unlikely to take kindly to looting.
entries.translation: 埋骨地是一座小型陵墓，埋着法老某些远亲的遗骸与陪葬品，还有侍从和家养动物的尸体。这里无疑布满陷阱，亡灵居民大概也不会欢迎盗墓者。

entries.english:
Tartarus is a decaying netherworld. Over time, the undead, demons and devils of
this place drain the life from any who dare to enter.

The all-pervading rot saps visitors' willpower.
entries.translation:
塔尔塔罗斯是一个腐朽的地下世界。此地的亡灵、恶魔与魔鬼，会逐渐吸走所有胆敢闯入者的生命。

无处不在的腐败会削弱来访者的意志。

issues.review: context_review:腐败或腐朽描述，不是状态标题

entries.english:
The Tomb of the Ancients is a place of damnation, of horrors animated by the
vilest necromancy. The list of those who have returned from this place of pure
death is exceedingly short.
entries.translation: 古人灵庙是受诅咒之地，其中的恐怖存在由最恶毒的死灵魔法驱动。从这片纯粹死亡之地生还的人，屈指可数。

entries.english:
A ziggurat is a strange tower constructed of incrementally larger combat
arenas, each containing greater wealth and even greater danger than the last.
Beware, for a ziggurat is not a place for the faint of heart: even the bravest
and most skilled adventurers have met their ends in one. While a portal to
safety will be present on every level, once left, a ziggurat cannot be
re-entered.

One ziggurat is guaranteed in the Depths. Tales tell of a magical item found
at the bottom of each ziggurat, granting access to a new ziggurat in turn. Such
an item is also said to be found at the bottom of the Tomb of the Ancients. Each
time a ziggurat is conquered by exiting it from the final floor, subsequent
ziggurats will become increasingly dangerous and lucrative.
entries.translation:
神塔是一座奇异高塔，每层的战斗场地都比上一层更大，财富更多，危险也更甚。请小心，这里容不得胆怯：即使最勇敢、最娴熟的冒险者，也曾在此丧命。每层都有通往安全地带的出口，但离开之后便无法重新进入。

地底保证会出现一座神塔。传说每座神塔底层都有一件魔法物品，可以开启下一座神塔；据说古人灵庙底层也有这种物品。每当你从神塔最后一层离开、完成征服后，之后的神塔就会更危险，也更富饶。

issues.expected: 地面/楼层/地板/向下取整

issues.review: context_review:通往安全地带的出口，按功能描述
context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
The Realm of Zot is a region of the dungeon that is so terrifying, so full of
madness, frenzy and lunacy, that it has been locked securely against random
trespassers. Only the most demented adventurers would dare gather the required
keys, break the seal and penetrate deeper — all in the vain hope for a fabled
artefact no one has ever laid eyes on before.
entries.translation: 佐特领域是地下城的一片区域。这里如此恐怖，充满狂乱、暴躁与癫狂，因此被严密封锁，阻止闲杂人等闯入。只有最疯癫的冒险者，才敢收集所需钥匙、打破封印、继续深入——全为徒劳追寻一件从来无人亲眼见过的传说神器。

entries.english:
The card depicts a dragon whose scales are sloughing off, revealing a sheep
underneath.

Drawing this card will attempt to polymorph and malmutate nearby enemies into
weaker forms, and will briefly daze those that cannot be polymorphed.
entries.translation:
牌面上，一条龙的鳞片正在剥落，露出下面的一只绵羊。

抽出此牌，会尝试让附近敌人变形成更弱的形态，并施加有害变异；无法变形的敌人则会短暂晕眩。

issues.review: context_review:施加有害变异的动作，不是法术标题

entries.english:
The card depicts an iron wheel, menacing with spikes and rusted with blood.

Drawing this card unleashes a necromantic attack spell.
entries.translation:
牌面上是一只铁轮，尖刺狰狞，血迹锈结。

抽出此牌，会释放一道死灵攻击法术。

entries.english:
The card depicts several feral hogs wallowing in a mud pit.

Drawing this card will make its user turn pink and root for truffles.
entries.translation:
牌面上，几头野猪正在泥坑里打滚。

抽出此牌，会让使用者变得粉红，并开始拱土寻找松露。

entries.english:
The card depicts a royal crypt, its entrance sealed by a heavy stone slab.

Drawing this card entombs its user in protective, temporary walls of solid rock.
At lower power levels or with adjacent creatures, the tomb may be imperfect.

The tomb is sustained by the presence of its creator within it, and moving from
the centre of the tomb will cause its walls to crumble away.
entries.translation:
牌面上是一座皇家墓室，入口被沉重的石板封住。

抽出此牌，会在使用者周围筑起临时的坚固岩壁，形成保护性的坟墓。威力较低或附近有生物时，坟墓可能并不完整。

坟墓依赖创造者留在其中才能维持；一旦离开中心，墓墙就会崩塌。

entries.english:
The card depicts a pointy wizard's hat, scorched and resting on a pile of ashes.

Drawing this card causes wild magic (as if from miscasting a spell) to act upon
its user's enemies. Each creature affected will restore some of the user's
magic.
entries.translation:
牌面上，一顶烧焦的尖顶法师帽落在灰烬堆中。

抽出此牌，会使狂野魔法（如同法术失控）作用于使用者的敌人。每影响一个生物，都会为使用者恢复一些魔力。

entries.english:
A swarm of tiny vampire bats, so dense that it is impossible to count them all.
They will relentlessly assail anything but the undead who stands in their midst,
gradually lulling them to sleep with their soporific bites - and continuing to
feed off their helpless body, once they fall.
entries.translation: 一群密得数不清的小吸血蝙蝠。它们会不停袭击其中除亡灵以外的一切生物，以催眠般的叮咬逐渐使其入睡；受害者倒下、无力反抗后，它们仍会继续吸血。

entries.english: <_smoke_cloud_>
entries.translation: <_smoke_cloud_>

entries.english: <_smoke_cloud_>
entries.translation: <_smoke_cloud_>

entries.english:
A petrifying cloud. Creatures caught in the cloud for any length of time will
find themselves turning to stone, though more experienced creatures may be able
to resist the effects.
entries.translation: 一团能使生物石化的云雾。生物只要停留其中，就会开始变成石头，不过经验更丰富的生物可能抵抗这种效果。

issues.review: context_review:能使生物石化的云雾效果说明

entries.english:
A cloud of lingering despair and necromantic energy. Living creatures trapped
within will repeatedly lose small fractions of their maximum health, though
protection from negative energy will mitigate the effects.
entries.translation: 一团挥之不去的绝望与死灵能量。困在其中的活物会反复失去相当于其生命值上限一小部分的生命，负能量防护可以减轻这种效果。

entries.english: <_smoke_cloud_>
entries.translation: <_smoke_cloud_>

entries.english:
A cloud of countless tiny fragments of magnetised metal, still vibrating
slightly from a recent electrical discharge. They will function as an attractor
for the Magnavolt spell until they dissipate.
entries.translation: 一团无数细小的磁化金属碎片，仍因刚才的放电而微微振动。消散之前，它们会成为巨磁电涌（Magnavolt）的吸引目标。

entries.english:
A cloud of vile, choking fumes. Any creature spending time in it will be at
risk of becoming confused by the gases, unless resistant to poison. Tougher,
more experienced creatures are less likely to be affected.
entries.translation: 一团恶臭呛人的烟气。不具备毒素抗性的生物停留其中时，有遭到气体影响而混乱的风险。更强壮、经验更丰富的生物不易受到影响。

entries.english: <_smoke_cloud_>
entries.translation: <_smoke_cloud_>

entries.english:
A cloud of spectral mist. It causes minor damage to all creatures other than
the undead. Dangerous but short-lived spectral undead creatures will coalesce
from the mist over time.
entries.translation: 一团幽魂迷雾。它会对亡灵以外的所有生物造成轻微伤害。随着时间推移，雾中还会凝聚出危险但短命的幽魂亡灵。

entries.english:
A raging forest fire. Any creature not entirely immune to fire will be hurt by
time spent in the flames. The flames will intermittently flare up and fill
their surroundings with lesser fires. Any trees unfortunate enough to be nearby
will often find themselves transformed into more kindling for the fire.

Ranged cold attacks passing through the cloud are substantially reduced in
range, dissipating the cloud in the process.

If placed near or over water, the heat will generate steam nearby.
entries.translation:
一场熊熊燃烧的森林大火。只要生物并非完全免疫火焰，停留其中就会受到伤害。火势会间歇性地猛涨，在周围引燃较小的火焰。不幸靠近的树木往往也会化为新的燃料。

穿过云雾的远程寒冷攻击射程会大幅缩短，同时使云雾消散。

若位于水面上或水边，其热量会在附近产生蒸汽。

entries.english: Moves the cursor to the next location that autoexplore will travel to.
entries.translation: 将光标移到自动探索将要前往的下一个位置。

entries.english: It has half the normal encumbrance for the purpose of ranged combat.
entries.translation: 进行远程战斗时，它的负重惩罚只有通常的一半。

entries.english:
When worn alongside a magical staff, it doubles the effectiveness of that
staff's primary enhancer and causes melee attacks made with it to restore a
small amount of MP.
entries.translation: 同时装备魔法棍杖时，它会使棍杖的主要法术增强效果翻倍，并让使用该棍杖的近战攻击恢复少量魔力。

entries.english:
It pushes those it hits backwards, briefly stunning them in the process. If it
pushes them into a solid feature, they will instead take an additional one-third
of any damage that pierces their armour.
entries.translation: 它会将受击者击退，并使其短暂眩晕。若将其推向坚实地形，则改为额外造成穿透护甲伤害的三分之一。

entries.english:
It is tipped with a substance that sends those it hits into a mindless frenzy,
attacking friend and foe alike.

The chance of successfully applying its effect increases with your Throwing and
Stealth skill.
entries.translation:
它的尖端涂有使受击者陷入无意识狂乱的物质，让其不分敌我地攻击。

成功施加效果的几率随你的投掷和潜行技能提高。

entries.english:
It empowers your Necromancy spells and improves their success rate, but imposes
a health cost for other magic.
entries.translation: 它增强死灵系法术并提高其成功率，但会让其他魔法额外消耗生命。

entries.english:
It causes any target it hits to become temporarily untethered in space, blinking
away from you for several turns and taking minor damage each time it does so.
entries.translation: 它使受击目标暂时失去空间锚定，在接下来数回合中不断向远离你的方向闪烁，每次闪烁都受到少量伤害。

entries.english:
It sometimes drains living victims (1/2 chance). This deals an additional
one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour as well as a flat 2-4
damage, and also weakens them slightly.
entries.translation: 它有时会吸取活物的生命力（1/2 几率），额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一，再加上固定的 2–4 点伤害，并略微削弱目标。

entries.english:
It may return the magic spent to cast spells, but lowers their success rate. It
always returns the magic spent on miscasts. The spell refund chance is increased
by your Evocations skill.
entries.translation: 它可能返还施法消耗的魔力，但会降低施法成功率。施法失败时总会返还魔力。成功施法后的返还几率随你的唤发技能提高。

entries.english:
It burns victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces
defenders' armour.
entries.translation: 它灼烧受击者，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一。

entries.english:
It burns victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces
defenders' armour. Big, fiery blades are also staple armaments of hydra-hunters.
entries.translation: 它灼烧受击者，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一。巨大的烈焰刀剑也是海德拉猎手的常备武器。

entries.english:
It has been infused with foul flame, dealing an additional three-quarters damage
to holy beings, an additional one-quarter damage to undead and demons, and an
additional half damage to all others, so long as it pierces armour. Holy beings
and good god worshippers cannot use this.
entries.translation: 它灌注了污秽烈焰。攻击穿透护甲后，对神圣生物额外造成四分之三伤害，对亡灵和恶魔额外造成四分之一伤害，对其他目标额外造成一半伤害。神圣生物和善神信徒无法使用它。

entries.english:
It freezes victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces
defenders' armour. It may also slow down cold-blooded creatures.
entries.translation: 它冻伤受击者，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一，还可能减缓冷血生物的速度。

issues.review: context_review:迟缓、反应慢、减缓速度是描述语，不强制使用法术名

entries.english:
It has been blessed by the Shining One, dealing an additional three-quarters of
any damage that pierces undead and demons' armour. Undead and demons cannot use
this.
entries.translation: 它受到了光明神的祝福，对亡灵和恶魔额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之三。亡灵和恶魔无法使用它。

entries.english:
It improves your accuracy and damage with thrown weapons, such as rocks and
javelins (Slay +4).
entries.translation: 它提高你投掷石块、标枪等武器时的命中与伤害（Slay +4）。

entries.english:
It causes witnesses of your kills to go into a frenzy, attacking everything
nearby with great strength and speed.
entries.translation: 它使目睹你击杀的生物陷入狂乱，以极强的力量和速度攻击附近一切目标。

entries.english:
It shields you if your last action was a melee attack. The shielding is half as
effective if your offhand is occupied by an item other than a weapon.
entries.translation: 若你上一个动作是近战攻击，它会为你提供防护。若副手被武器以外的物品占用，防护效果减半。

issues.review: context_review:shields 作保护动词或复数盾类，不是技能名称

entries.english:
Any ammunition fired by it continues flying after striking targets, potentially
hitting everything in its path until it leaves sight.
entries.translation: 它发射的弹药击中目标后仍会继续飞行，可能击中路径上的所有目标，直到飞出视野。

entries.english:
It shields the wearer if their last action was a melee attack (+10 SH) and
redirects blocked melee attacks to other nearby enemies.
entries.translation: 若穿戴者上一个动作是近战攻击，它会提供防护（格挡值 +10），并将格挡住的近战攻击转向附近其他敌人。

entries.english: It allows you to see invisible things.
entries.translation: 它让你看见隐形事物。

issues.review: context_review:看见隐形事物的效果说明，不强制使用属性标题

entries.english:
It increases your damage by an additional 50% with ranged and thrown weapons
against incapacitated targets. Incapacitated targets are those that are asleep,
paralysed, petrified, confused or caught in a net.
entries.translation: 你使用远程或投掷武器攻击无法正常行动的目标时，它会额外提高 50% 伤害。这类目标包括睡眠、麻痹、石化、混乱或被网困住的生物。

entries.english:
It fires a beam of energy whenever it strikes an enemy while its wielder has
no less than 80% of their maximum hit points remaining. Unwielding it will
briefly Weaken its wielder.
entries.translation: 持用者的剩余生命不低于最大生命的 80% 时，它每次击中敌人都会射出一道能量束。卸下它会使持用者短暂虚弱。

issues.review: context_review:生命与最大生命，省略值字的自然描述

entries.english: A delicate arrangement, smashed to pieces and consigned to slow starvation.
entries.translation: 一组精巧的插花，被砸得粉碎，只能慢慢枯死。

issues.review: context_review:碎片、粉碎或全套装备的中文表达

entries.english:
A hoard of breadstuffs, baked and fried from minor divine gifts of flour and
growth cultures, granted extended shelflife through sacred succour. You already
carry as much food as you will ever need for this journey, but a light snack
shouldn't hurt.
entries.translation: 一堆烘烤、油炸的面食，原料是神祇小小恩赐的面粉与发酵菌种，保质期也受神圣庇护而延长。你携带的食物已经足够完成旅程，但吃点零嘴总无妨。

entries.english:
A pile of assorted fruit, ranging from common dungeon staples like chokos and
snozzcumbers, to rarer treats such as apples and oranges. You already carry as
much food as you will ever need for this journey, but the occasional nibble
wouldn't hurt.
entries.translation: 一堆各色水果，既有地下城常见的佛手瓜和鼻涕瓜，也有苹果、橘子等少见的美味。你携带的食物已经足够完成旅程，但偶尔尝一口总无妨。

entries.english:
A murky flag of dark conquest shimmering with vile energies, planted in the name
of some grand despoiling crusade.
entries.translation: 一面象征黑暗征服的阴沉旗帜，闪动着邪恶能量，为某场大肆劫掠的远征而立。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a crawl-hole back to the lair
entries.english: A passage leading back to the Lair of Beasts.
entries.translation: 一个返回野兽巢穴的出口。

issues.review: context_review:穿行、时间流逝或出口语境，不强制使用通道

entries.english:
A portal leading to the heart of a volcano. Rocks are falling from the roof and
sides of the tunnel, filling the entry.
entries.translation: 一个通往火山的门户。岩石不断从隧道顶部和侧面落下，将会堵住入口。

entries.english:
[[A dispersal trap]]

It is currently recharging and will become active again in a short while.
entries.translation:
[[A dispersal trap]]

它正在重新充能，稍后便会再次启动。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a faded altar of an unknown god
entries.english:
An ancient altar, stripped of all identifying characteristics by the passage of
aeons. Praying at it will convert you to an unknown god, and the altar's deity
will greatly appreciate conversion at so ancient a site of worship.
entries.translation:
一座古老的祭坛，时间冲刷掉了它的全部特征。
在那里祈祷，将会皈依一个未知的神。
祭坛的神灵会非常感念于你在这样古老的礼拜场所进行皈依。

issues.review: context_review:穿行、时间流逝或出口语境，不强制使用通道

entries.english:
A portal leading to a bailey, gradually fading away as the standard is lowered
to the ground.
entries.translation: 一个通往堡场的门户，会随着旗帜降至地面而逐渐消失。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a flickering gateway to a bazaar
entries.english:
A portal leading to a bazaar, where itinerant merchants gather to sell their
wares. They never stay in one place for very long.
entries.translation:
一个通往市集的门户，行商聚集在那里出售商品。
他们永远不会在一个地方呆很长时间。

entries.english:
A vibrant bouquet of flowers in a clay vessel, kept alive with ample water
and some minor magic.
entries.translation: 一束插在陶器中的鲜艳花朵，靠充足的水和些许魔法维持生机。

issues.review: context_review:低阶恶魔、亚龙等语境，不是次级法术前缀

entries.english: A portal leading to an ice cave. The archway is gradually melting away.
entries.translation: 一个通往冰窟的门户。拱门在渐渐融化。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a gate leading back out of this place
entries.english: A gate that will let you return whence you came.
entries.translation: 这个大门，你穿过它能回到你来的地方。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a gateway leading out of cocytus
entries.english: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>
entries.translation: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a gateway leading out of dis
entries.english: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>
entries.translation: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a gateway leading out of tartarus
entries.english: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>
entries.translation: <A gateway leading out of Gehenna>

entries.english:
A portal leading to a bazaar, where itinerant merchants gather to sell their
wares. They will wait for you, but once you get a chance to browse their
inventory, the merchants will depart in search of other customers.
entries.translation:
一个通往市集的门户，行商聚集在那里出售商品。
他们会等你，但一旦你浏览过他们的存货，商家将出发寻找其他客户。

issues.review: context_review:物品栏语境已由拾取物品界面动作表明

entries.english: A portal leading to a ziggurat.
entries.translation: 一个通往神塔的门户。

entries.english: A portal leading to a gauntlet.
entries.translation: 一个通往竞技场的门户。

entries.english:
A portal leading to a glacial chasm, far more dangerous than the icy caverns
found in the shallower reaches of the Dungeon. The archway is gradually melting
away.
entries.translation: 一个通往冰川裂缝的门户，比地下城浅层的冰窟危险得多。拱门在渐渐融化。

entries.english: A stone statue whose features have long since withered away.
entries.translation: 一座石像，其形象早已被时间消磨。

entries.english:
A crystal wall etched with murals depicting, in great and gruesome detail,
exactly what will be done to anyone caught stealing from the Vaults.
entries.translation:
这面水晶墙上蚀刻着壁画，
以极其可怕的细节描绘着从宝库中盗窃被抓的人的悲惨下场。

entries.english:
A metal wall etched with murals depicting, in great and gruesome detail,
exactly what will be done to anyone caught stealing from the Vaults.
entries.translation:
这面金属墙上蚀刻着壁画，
以极其可怕的细节描绘着从宝库中盗窃被抓的人的悲惨下场。

entries.english: A portal leading to a wizard's laboratory. It is fading away.
entries.translation: 一个通往巫师实验室的门户。它在逐渐消失。

entries.english:
A base type statue for other statue flavours. If you see this, file a bug
report.
entries.translation: 一座其他风格雕塑的基本款雕塑。如果你碰到这个，请提交错误报告。

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.english:
A wall of bluish-grey metal. As every dungeon electrician knows, it will ground
even magical bolts of lightning.
entries.translation: 一面蓝灰色金属墙。地下城中的每个电工都知道，它甚至能让闪电箭接地。

entries.english:
A singular flower, suffused with gloom and held in a ceramic grip. It
is difficult to tell whether it is even still alive.
entries.translation: 一朵笼罩愁云的花，被陶制器皿握住，甚至很难判断它是否还活着。

issues.review: context_review:花朵枯死的愁苦描写，不是法术名称

entries.english:
A cursed staircase leading further down, imbued with magic to prevent any
return back up the stairs. Adventurers taking this passage will need to find a
return stairway somewhere else on the level where they arrive.
entries.translation:
一个被诅咒的通往下层的楼梯，注入着魔力，以阻止任何回返。
走这条通道的冒险者，到达所通往的楼层后，需要找到其他能够返回楼梯。

entries.english:
A cursed staircase leading up, imbued with magic to prevent any return back
down the stairs. Adventurers taking this passage will need to find a return
stairway somewhere else on the level where they arrive.
entries.translation:
一个被诅咒的通往上层的楼梯，注入着魔力，以阻止任何回返。
走这条通道的冒险者，到达所通往的楼层后，需要找到其他能够返回楼梯。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a portal leading out of this place
entries.english:
A shimmering magical gate leading back to the place you came from. You will be
unable to return here once you pass through it.
entries.translation: 这个闪着微光的魔法门导向你回到原来的地方。一旦你穿过它，就再也无法回来了。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a rocky tunnel leading out of this place
entries.english:
An unstable passage in the volcanic rock, admitting a draft of cool air from
beyond. It leads back to the place you came from. You will be unable to return
here once you pass through it.
entries.translation:
一个火山岩体中不稳定的通道，外面的冷空气可以从中进入。
它导向你回到原来的地方。一旦你穿过它，就再也无法回来了。

entries.english:
A monument to the glory of a dead god. The statue has been methodically
defaced; not a single distinguishing feature remains.
entries.translation:
一座纪念碑，用来纪念已故的神的荣光。
这座雕塑已经被有条不紊地损毁了，没剩下一个可辨识的特征。

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.english:
A door, covered in runic writing. It looks like there is something special
behind it — perhaps danger, perhaps treasure. You may break the runes by
opening it like any other door, but creatures of the dungeon will not dare
to try.
entries.translation:
这扇门上满是符文记号。
门的后面应该有什么特别的东西——可能是危险，也可能是宝藏。
像打开其他门那样就能破坏符文，但地下城里的生物可不敢尝试。

entries.english:
A door, covered in runic writing, made from magically translucent wood. It has
been created to seal away great danger or glorious treasure. You may break the
runes by opening it like any other door, but creatures of the dungeon will not
dare to try.
entries.translation: 一扇布满符文、由魔法半透明木材制成的门。它被造来封住巨大的危险或珍贵的宝藏。你可以像开普通门一样破开符文，但地下城中的生物不敢尝试。

entries.english:
A magically shifting statue seemingly content to glimmer and dance in place,
dedicated to the ineffable cosmic games of chaos.
entries.translation: 一座神奇的变幻着的雕塑，似乎满足于在此为难以言喻的宇宙混乱游戏献上微光和舞蹈。

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.english:
A geometric statue of solid silver, in both material and form championing
security and stasis.
entries.translation: 一座由纯银制成的几何图形状雕塑，无论是材质还是形式，都在颂扬安全和静止。

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a slimy stone staircase leading down
entries.english:
A stone staircase leading further down.

{{
    if you.god() == "Jiyva" then
        return "It is slick with slippery slime, but that is no obstacle for one " ..
               "such as yourself who has embraced the way of all slime."
    else
        return "It is slick with slippery slime which will make it impossible " ..
               "for you to climb back up again until the power ruling this place " ..
               "is destroyed (or you choose to join it). However, being coated in " ..
               "this slime will greatly increase your HP and MP regenaration for " ..
               "short while afterward."
    end
}}
entries.translation:
一座通往更深处的石楼梯。

{{
    if you.god() == "Jiyva" then
        return "楼梯沾满滑溜的黏液，但这不会妨碍" ..
               "像你这样拥抱一切黏液之道的人。"
    else
        return "楼梯沾满滑溜的黏液，导致你" ..
               "无法沿原路爬回，直到统治此地的力量" ..
               "遭到摧毁（或你选择加入它）。不过，沾上" ..
               "这种黏液后，你的生命和魔力恢复速度会在" ..
               "随后短时间内大幅提高。"
    end
}}

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a slimy stone staircase leading up
entries.english:
A stone staircase leading back up.

{{
    if you.god() == "Jiyva" then
        return "It is slick with slippery slime, but that is no obstacle for one " ..
               "such as yourself who has embraced the way of all slime."
    else
        return "It is slick with slippery slime, making it impossible for you to " ..
               "climb until the power ruling this place is destroyed (or you choose " ..
               "to join it)."
    end
}}
entries.translation:
一座返回上方的石楼梯。

{{
    if you.god() == "Jiyva" then
        return "楼梯沾满滑溜的黏液，但这不会妨碍" ..
               "像你这样拥抱一切黏液之道的人。"
    else
        return "楼梯沾满滑溜的黏液，使你无法" ..
               "攀爬，直到统治此地的力量遭到摧毁（或你选择" ..
               "加入它）。"
    end
}}

entries.english: An entrance that the opposition may appear from.
entries.translation: 敌人可能会入场的地方。

issues.review: context_review:护符开启神塔的入口动作，使用门的自然译法

entries.english: A wall decorated with images you might see in a tomb.
entries.translation: 这面墙上装饰着你可能会在坟墓中看到的图像。

entries.english:
A statue with strange and alien features. Is it because the statue is worn and
tarnished that it has become so unrecognisable? Or is it that the subject was
something demonic and evil?
entries.translation:
这座雕塑看起来非常奇怪诡异。雕塑是因为磨损和失去光泽，就变得如此难以辨认？
还是它的主题就是什么恶魔和邪恶的东西？

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.english:
A one-way portal to another place on this level. When using a transporter,
adjacent allies and monsters will travel with you to the other side.
entries.translation: 一道通往当前楼层其他位置的单向转移装置。使用时，相邻的盟友与怪物都会与你一同前往另一端。

issues.review: context_review:通往安全地带的出口，按功能描述

entries.english:
The destination site of a transporter. As the portal is one-way, you cannot use
this location to return back through the transporter.
entries.translation: 转移装置的落点。转移装置是单向的，因此无法从这里返回。

issues.review: context_review:通往安全地带的出口，按功能描述

entries.english: <A crystal wall>
entries.translation: <A crystal wall>

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a wall of the weird stuff which makes up pandemonium
entries.english:
A wall made from the weird stuff which makes up Pandemonium. It seems to be
like rock in most other aspects.
entries.translation: 这面墙由构筑魔窟的奇特材料制成。在其他大多数方面，似乎都和岩石一样。

entries.english:
A trap which inflicts dangerously unpredictable magical effects on those
unlucky enough to step on it. You may find yourself petrified, contaminated
with enormous amounts of wild magic, have mighty fiends summoned against you,
or the like. Hostile monsters may trigger this trap themselves to invoke its
effects against you, but your allies will avoid stepping on it.
entries.translation: 一座会向不幸踩中者施加危险而难以预测魔法效果的陷阱。你可能遭到石化、被大量野性魔法污染，或面对召唤而来的强大魔王等。敌对怪物可能主动触发它来对付你，但你的盟友会避免踩上。

entries.english:
An ensorcelled metal wall coated in an inscrutable non-linear script, recording
the regrets of the interred and their visitors alike. As with all metal walls,
it is next to impossible to destroy, and will ground all varieties of bounding
lightning.
entries.translation: 一面施了魔法的金属墙，表面布满难以解读的非线性文字，记录着葬于此地者与来访者的遗憾。如同其他金属墙，它几乎无法被摧毁，并能使各类弹射闪电接地。

entries.english:
A magical trap crafted by some avaricious master wizard. When you or a hostile
monster steps on it, you will lose a percentage of your mp, while up to three of
the strongest hostile spellcasters in sight will have their spells empowered.
Your allies will avoid stepping on it.
entries.translation: 某位贪婪大法师制造的魔法陷阱。你或敌对怪物踩上时，你会失去一定比例的魔力，而视野内最强大的敌对施法者中，最多三个会得到法术强化。你的盟友会避免踩上它。

entries.english: A worn granite statue depicting an elephant standing guard.
entries.translation: 这座有些磨损的花岗岩雕塑刻画着一头大象在放哨。

issues.review: context_review:雕塑与雕像为同义描述

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:an ice choked empty arch of ancient stone
entries.english: An inoperative portal, nearly completely encased in a mass of ice.
entries.translation: 一个失效的门户，几乎完全被冰块包裹。

entries.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:an ice covered gate leading back out of this place
entries.english:
A portal leading back to the place you came from. Its magic is holding the ice
at bay, preventing it from blocking the gate. You will be unable to return here
once you pass through it.
entries.translation: 一道返回来处的传送门。门上的魔法将冰挡在外面，使其无法封住入口。一旦穿过，就无法再回到这里。

entries.english:
A statue of an ancient warrior, festooned with trophies from fallen victims.
Some dark substance oozes from the gaps in its visor; surely it must be oil..?
entries.translation:
一尊古代战士的雕像，上面饰有从手下败将那里获得的战利品。
一些深色物质从其面甲的缝隙渗出，当然，这一定是油……？

entries.english:
This area is bathed in translocational energy, causing creatures to blink away
from the originator of the energy with an increasing chance the closer they are
to the caster.
entries.translation: 这片区域充满位移能量，使生物向远离能量来源的方向闪烁；离施法者越近，闪烁几率越高。

issues.review: context_review:闪现逃脱或闪烁离开的动作，不强制套用法术名

entries.english:
This wall is covered in magical ice that freezes victims who wander nearby.
This damage bypasses any armour the target may have, and will slow cold-blooded
creatures. Each victim is only ever affected by one icy wall at a time.

The creator of this icy covering and any of their allies can walk safely past
this wall.
entries.translation:
这面墙上覆盖着有魔力的冰，会冻结在附近徘徊的受害者。
这种伤害能无视目标可能拥有的任何护甲，还会暂时减缓冷血动物的速度。
每个受害者一次只能受到一堵冰墙的影响。

墙上覆着的这种冰的创造者及其任何盟友都可以安全地经过这面墙。

issues.review: context_review:迟缓、反应慢、减缓速度是描述语，不强制使用法术名

entries.english:
The ground here is liquefied, making movement slow and causing any attempts to
attack in melee to sometimes fail.
entries.translation: 这片地面被液化，移动会被减缓，发出任何近战攻击都有可能失手。

issues.review: context_review:迟缓、反应慢、减缓速度是描述语，不强制使用法术名

entries.english: A thick layer of gritty mud. [[liquefied]]
entries.translation: 一层厚厚的砂质泥浆。[[liquefied]]

entries.english:
Blasphemers against the word of Beogh find themselves assaulted by waves of
orcish warriors, or by dancing electric weapons. Beogh may also simply smite
such blasphemers – and when smiting true sinners, Beogh has a heavy hand
indeed! Those who still worship Beogh will also find their followers regularly
deserting them.
entries.translation: 亵渎 比欧弗 教诲的人，会遭到一波波兽人战士或舞动的电击武器袭击。祂也可能直接降下惩击；面对真正的罪人，祂下手尤其沉重！仍然信奉祂的人，还会不断遭遇追随者叛离。

issues.review: context_review:神罚攻击动作，不强制套用能力标题

entries.english:
Followers of Cheibriados move more slowly as they gain favour. As they move
slower, worshippers of Cheibriados are granted increased attributes.
Cheibriados rewards the faithful with the power to slow other creatures and the
power to briefly distort the flow of time. Devout worshippers will gain the
ability to inflict great harm on all those who move more quickly than they do,
and finally the ability to step out of the flow of time entirely.
entries.translation: 信徒获得的神宠越多，移动就越慢；移动越慢，得到的属性提升就越多。切布理亚多 赐予忠诚信徒减慢其他生物、短暂扭曲时间流动的力量。虔诚者能够重创所有比自己移动更快的生物，最终甚至可以完全踏出时间之流。

entries.english:
Offenders against Cheibriados will find their movements remain slow while
the attention of Cheibriados remains upon them, and may have any magical hasting
stripped away. They may also become further slowed, be put to sleep, or be
beset by the unparalleled volume of the inevitable passage of time ringing
throughout the Dungeon.
entries.translation: 只要 切布理亚多 仍然关注冒犯者，他们的移动就会保持缓慢，身上的魔法加速也可能被剥除。他们还可能进一步减速、陷入沉睡，或遭受时间必然流逝的震耳巨响；那声音回荡在整座地下城之中。

entries.english:
Followers of Dithmenos are surrounded by an unnatural quiet, which helps the
sounds they make go unnoticed. As they rise in devotion, they will find their
own shadow begins to imitate some of their actions, attacking when they attack
and even casting shadowy magics that mimic the form - if not the substance - of
whichever schools of magic they had been utilising.

More devout worshippers additionally gain the ability to swap places with their
shadow to mislead enemies, grasp other beings' shadows to unleash their magic on
the worshipper's behalf, and finally call down a night so dark that it hides all
denizens of the dungeon from each other.
entries.translation:
信徒周围笼罩着异样的寂静，使其发出的声音不易引人注意。随着虔诚加深，他们的影子会开始模仿部分行动：在他们攻击时攻击，甚至施展影子魔法，模仿他们所使用魔法学派的形式，尽管其本质并不相同。

更虔诚的信徒还能够与影子交换位置以迷惑敌人，攫住其他生物的影子，使其替自己释放魔法，最终还能召来深沉的黑夜，让地下城中的所有生物彼此无法看见。

issues.review: context_review:迷惑敌人的动作，不是误导术名称

entries.english:
When angered, Dithmenos turns the shadows against victims. Monsters emerge from
the darkness, both illusions woven from shadow and the very shadow themselves
turning against sinners. Dithmenos' subtle punishments are, if anything, more
dangerous: victims find the shadows ripped away from them, hunted with nowhere
to hide; or find themselves smothered in shadow and sleeping, perhaps forever.
entries.translation: 迪斯姆诺 愤怒时，会让阴影反过来对付受罚者。怪物从黑暗中现身，既有阴影编织的幻象，也有阴影本身，向罪人发起攻击。祂更隐秘的惩罚或许还要危险：受罚者身边的阴影可能被剥去，在追猎中无处藏身；也可能被阴影吞没，沉睡不醒，甚至永不醒来。

entries.english:
The Healer offers followers a number of means to heal themselves from damage
and other ill effects. Followers may also attempt to pacify hostile monsters
and turn them neutral. Elyvilon may directly intervene to save a follower's
life, and if there has been no such intervention recently, is sure to prevent
a killing blow against especially pious followers. Elyvilon may also
occasionally protect the follower's allies from death.
entries.translation: 治疗者提供多种手段，让信徒治疗伤害及其他不良效果。信徒也可以尝试安抚敌对怪物，使其变为中立。艾利维隆 可能直接干预，挽救信徒的生命；对于尤其虔诚的信徒，只要近期没有进行过这类干预，祂就一定会阻止致命一击。祂有时也会保护信徒的盟友免于死亡。

entries.english:
Elyvilon is not a god known for wrath. Still, those earning Elyvilon's ire will
find the Healer occasionally protecting their foes from their attacks, and even
from death.
entries.translation: 艾利维隆 并不以愤怒著称。不过，招致祂不满的人会发现，治疗者偶尔会保护他们的敌人，使其免受攻击，甚至免于死亡。

entries.english:
Fedhas is the god of plant and fungal life. Followers are prevented from
harming any species under Fedhas' protection. In return, Fedhas grants a number
of abilities that promote the growth of plants and fungi. These abilities may
incidentally prove useful to adventurers.
entries.translation: 费德哈 是植物与真菌生命之神。信徒不得伤害任何受祂保护的物种。作为回报，费德哈 赐予多种促进植物与真菌生长的能力。这些能力也可能顺便给冒险者带来帮助。

entries.english:
Plants and fungi will not attack Fedhas' worshippers without provocation.
Worshippers may walk through plants or fungi, and even fire missiles or spells
through them without causing harm. Fedhas grants powers to temporarily grow a
menagerie of plant allies whose strength and duration increase with Invocations
skill. Worshippers may grow a protective wall of briar patches as well as
ballistomycetes that fire damaging spores whose explosions confuse living
creatures. Devout followers can overgrow a stretch of solid terrain with a
cluster of plant allies or even summon a mighty oklob plant.
entries.translation: 植物与真菌若未受挑衅，便不会攻击信徒。信徒可以穿过它们，也能让投射物与法术穿过它们而不造成伤害。费德哈 赐予暂时培育多种植物盟友的力量，其强度和持续时间随祈祷技能提高。信徒能培育起保护作用的荆棘墙，以及发射伤害性孢子的球菌；孢子爆炸会使活物混乱。虔诚者可以让一片坚实地形长出成簇的植物盟友，甚至召来强大的奥克罗布植物。

issues.review: context_review:让地形长出植物的动作描述

entries.english:
For Gozag, both flesh and spirit are inferior to wealth, and therefore all
monsters are turned to gold upon death. Other monsters may then be briefly
distracted by imaginings of great wealth. Stalwarts can purchase immediate help
in the form of potions, and may also pay to attract shopkeepers into the
dungeon. Particularly well-off adherents may bribe the inhabitants of a branch
of the dungeon to turn a blind eye to their presence, or even to change their
allegiance.
entries.translation: 在 哥萨戈 看来，血肉与灵魂都不及财富，因此所有怪物死亡时都会化为黄金。其他怪物可能因幻想巨额财富而短暂分心。坚定的信徒可以购买药水以获得即时帮助，也可以付费吸引商人进入地下城。尤其富有的信徒能够贿赂某个地下城分支的居民，让他们对自己的存在视而不见，甚至倒戈。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
Hepliaklqana the Forgotten accepts the worship of those who would remember
their forebears, and fight alongside the greatest of them all. Acolytes of
Hepliaklqana sacrifice a small part of their life essence to manifest their
ancestor into the world; as they explore and form new experiences, they will
find themselves able to shape and control their ancestor's memory, eventually
bringing them into the ranks of the mythical heroes.
entries.translation: 被遗忘者 惠普利亚卡纳 接受那些愿意铭记先祖、并与其中最伟大的一位并肩作战的人所献上的信仰。信徒牺牲少量生命精华，使先祖显现于世。随着探索与阅历的增长，他们将逐渐能够塑造和掌控对先祖的记忆，最终使其跻身神话英雄之列。

entries.english:
Hepliaklqana's worshippers are served by a guardian formed from a part of their
life essence, in the shape of their greatest ancestor. This ancestor is at
first remembered as they were at the start of their fabled adventures, but will
advance in skill as their descendant does. Hepliaklqana always allows followers
to recall their ancestor to their side, and, even if the ancestor is destroyed,
Hepliaklqana will call it forth again not long after. Further advancement in
Hepliaklqana's service allows worshippers to restore and strengthen their
ancestor, to swap them with other creatures, and to choose how to remember
their life's talents.
entries.translation: 信徒由一位守护者侍奉，祂以信徒的部分生命精华构成，具有其最伟大先祖的形象。起初，先祖的记忆停留在传奇冒险刚开始时，但其本领会随子孙一同增长。惠普利亚卡纳 始终允许信徒将先祖召回身边；即使先祖被摧毁，祂也会在不久后将其重新召来。进一步效力后，信徒能够恢复并强化先祖、让先祖与其他生物交换位置，并选择如何铭记先祖生前的才能。

entries.english:
Hepliaklqana believes that the only reasonable punishment for turning one's
back on the path of memory is to be denied its use. All new experience is
denied to the unfortunate apostate, until Hepliaklqana decides they have
been punished enough. The life essence sacrificed to manifest an ancestor will
not be returned until Hepliaklqana is mollified, and this will not be quick:
unlike some, Hepliaklqana has a long memory.
entries.translation: 惠普利亚卡纳 认为，背离记忆之道的唯一合理惩罚，就是剥夺使用记忆的权利。不幸的叛教者将无法获得任何新经验，直到祂认为惩罚已经足够。为使先祖显现而牺牲的生命精华，也要等祂息怒后才会归还；这不会很快，因为祂不像某些神祇那样健忘。

entries.english:
Ignis the Dying Flame offers followers power over fire in many forms. All of
Ignis' power is offered unconditionally to any who would deign to worship, but
once used, it can never be replenished. Ignis' other worshippers deserted long
ago; the divine fire burns low, and soon it will go out.
entries.translation: 垂灭之焰 伊格尼斯 给予信徒多种操纵火焰的力量。只要有人愿意信奉，伊格尼斯 便无条件献出全部神力，但这些力量一旦用去，便永远无法补充。其他信徒早已离去，神圣的火焰日渐衰弱，不久就将熄灭。

entries.english:
Jiyva will gradually fill the dungeon with jellies. These and any other fellow
slimes will rapidly consume nearby items, as well as slowly consuming items from
elsewhere in the dungeon. As they spread slime across more of the dungeon, Jiyva
will grant followers increasingly rapid health and magic regeneration, and will
begin mutating them to better reflect Jiyva's image. Followers will later become
able to call forth acidic ooze from the walls of the dungeon, and to turn
monsters to slime with a touch.
entries.translation: 吉瓦 会逐渐让地下城遍布果冻怪。它们和其他同类软泥怪会迅速吞食附近物品，也会缓慢吞食地下城其他地方的物品。软泥遍及的范围越大，祂就赐予信徒越快的生命与魔力恢复，并开始使他们变异，更接近祂的形象。之后，信徒能够从地下城墙壁中唤出酸性黏液，也能以触碰将怪物化为软泥。

entries.english:
Jiyva's vengeance is swift and gurgling. All slimes turn against those who
offend Jiyva, and Jiyva ensures a plentiful supply of further slimes. Victims,
too, will find their own bodies becoming unstable; acquiring debilitating
mutations or contamination, as well as having any gifts of slime mutations
stripped away from them.
entries.translation: 吉瓦 的复仇迅速而咕噜作响。所有软泥怪都会敌视冒犯者，而祂还会确保更多软泥怪源源不断地出现。受罚者的身体也会变得不稳定，获得削弱自身的变异或魔法污染，同时失去所有作为恩赐获得的软泥变异。

entries.english:
Kikubaaqudgha is a terrible Demon-God, served by those who wish to indulge in
the powers of death. An evil god, Kikubaaqudgha requires worshippers to cause
the death and destruction of as many creatures as possible. In exchange,
Kikubaaqudgha offers great assistance to the aspiring necromancer: a supply of
useful bodies, knowledge of dark magic, and protection against necromantic
backlash.
entries.translation: 奇库巴库哈 是可怕的魔神，渴望沉迷于死亡力量的人为祂效力。作为邪神，祂要求信徒尽可能多地杀戮和毁灭生灵。作为交换，祂为有志于死灵术的人提供极大的帮助：有用的尸体、黑暗魔法知识，以及抵御死灵术反噬的庇护。

issues.review: context_review:有志于死灵术的人，职业描述而非背景标签

entries.english:
Kikubaaqudgha will enhance servants' necromantic prowess with gifts of
Necromancy spells. Kikubaaqudgha will protect followers from the effects of
necromantic miscasts and death curses, and may even shield them from unholy
torment. Followers can unearth dying wretches as necromantic fodder, and may
invoke the sign of ruin to harm their enemies. Kikubaaqudgha will eventually
allow followers to either receive knowledge of the most forbidden necromantic
magic, or to have their weapon imbued with pain.
entries.translation: 奇库巴库哈 通过赐予死灵系魔法的法术来增强仆从的死灵术本领。祂会保护信徒免受死灵术施法失误与死亡诅咒的影响，甚至可能使其免遭邪恶的折磨。信徒可以掘出濒死的可怜生物，作为死灵术的素材，并召唤毁灭征兆伤害敌人。最终，祂会让信徒在最禁忌的死灵术知识与为武器灌注痛苦之间作出选择。

entries.english:
Kikubaaqudgha's wrath brings forth all the dread powers of necromancy. Victims
may witness the devastating Sign of Ruin form upon themselves, or both doomed
and drained without any respect for their negative energy resistance.
Furthermore, Kikubaaqudgha's gifts become tainted: the dead rise again as foes,
and those that attempt to use necromantic magic to fend off wrath will find it
backfiring on them when least expected.
entries.translation: 奇库巴库哈 的怒火会唤出死灵术的一切可怖力量。受罚者可能看到毁灭性的毁灭征兆出现在自己身上，也可能同时遭受厄运和吸能，完全无视负能量抗性。此外，祂的恩赐会遭到玷污：死者重新起身成为敌人；试图用死灵系魔法抵御神罚的人，也会在最意想不到的时候遭到反噬。

issues.review: context_review:可怖的自然中文形容词

entries.english:
Followers of Lugonu gain powers to depart the Abyss at will, to banish monsters
there, and to flee back inside when needed. Lugonu will also banish nearby foes
if any other god attempts to interfere with their followers. Later, followers
will be able to corrupt the ordered world, opening a gate for creatures
of the Abyss to pass through, and to gate themselves directly into this realm of
chaos. Lugonu will protect followers who unwield weapons imbued with the
distorting energies of the Abyss, and eventually will offer to distort a
follower's melee weapon. Lugonu expects followers to spread unceasing
chaos in the overworld, and as such does not grant piety to worshippers while
they remain in the Abyss itself.
entries.translation: 信徒能够随意离开深渊，将怪物放逐到那里，并在需要时逃回其中。如果其他神祇试图干涉祂的信徒，卢戈努 还会放逐附近的敌人。之后，信徒能够腐化有序的世界，为深渊生物打开通道，并直接进入这片混乱领域。祂会保护卸下扭曲武器的信徒，最终还会提出为信徒的一件近战武器赋予扭曲。祂要求信徒在现世不停传播混乱，因此不会向停留在深渊中的信徒赐予虔诚。

entries.english:
Makhleb offers followers the ability to unleash bolts of chaotic destruction at
the cost of their own health as well as call in help from powerful (if sometimes
uncooperative) demons. The most devoted of worshippers will eventually be gifted
with knowledge of Infernal Marks, allowing them to ritually brand their own
bodies in exchange for one of the Destroyer's many hellish powers.

Makhleb's powers all come with a price in blood. However, Makhleb will grant
followers renewed health in return for killing beings of all kinds.
entries.translation:
马科列布 允许信徒以自身生命为代价释放混沌毁灭的射线，也能召来强大但有时不肯合作的恶魔。最虔诚的信徒最终会获得地狱印记的知识，以仪式在自己身上烙印，换取毁灭者诸多地狱力量中的一种。

祂的所有力量都要付出鲜血的代价。不过，祂会以恢复生命作为信徒杀死各种生物的回报。

entries.english:
Those who abandon Nemelex Xobeh have all of their gifted decks revoked
immediately. They are also regularly forced to draw from the deck of
Punishment, inflicting a range of unpleasant effects including draining,
torment and polymorphing, as well as calling upon other gods to assist in
inflicting wrath.
entries.translation: 背弃 尼姆雷斯・索布 的人，会立即被收回所有获赐的牌组。他们还会定期被迫从惩罚牌组抽牌，承受吸能、折磨、变形等各种不良效果，甚至引来其他神祇协助施罚。

entries.english:
Followers of Okawaru will gain the ability to temporarily increase their skills
in combat, and, much later, to deal much faster blows. Okawaru will eventually
gift followers with ammunition, weapons and armour. The most favoured of
Okawaru may challenge their foes to honourable single combat.
entries.translation: 信徒能够暂时提高战斗技能，在更晚的时候还能大幅加快攻击。奥格瓦如 最终会赐予弹药、武器和防具。最受宠者可以向敌人发起光荣的一对一决斗。

entries.english:
Qazlal Stormbringer is a violent god of tempests, who delights in unleashing
the forces of nature against the unsuspecting. Those who invite Qazlal's gaze
will find themselves the eye in a storm of elemental destruction, from which
only their God can protect them. Pious worshippers of Qazlal will gain the
ability to direct and control the destructive might of the storm.
entries.translation: 风暴使者 卡兹拉尔 是狂暴的风暴之神，乐于向毫无防备者释放自然之力。招来祂注视的人，会置身于元素毁灭风暴的中心，唯有这位神祇能够保护他们。虔诚的信徒将获得指引和控制风暴破坏力的能力。

entries.english:
Of all the gods, only Ru opposed creation. Not as folly, but as distraction.
Initiates of Ru can open channels to the powers underlying the visible world by
renouncing the fetters that bind them here. These sacrifices are not made to
Ru, but rather given up freely and permanently. Having made such sacrifices,
initiates will become able to draw upon this immense power to aid themselves,
eventually gaining the ability to unleash its destructive might against their
foes.
entries.translation: 众神之中，唯有 入 反对创世。祂认为创造并非愚举，却是分心之事。入门者通过舍弃将自己束缚于此世的羁绊，打开通往可见世界之下力量的通道。这些牺牲并非献给 入，而是自愿且永久地放弃。作出牺牲后，入门者便能借助这股浩瀚力量帮助自己，最终向敌人释放其毁灭之威。

entries.english:
Sif Muna grants followers the ability to rapidly restore their magical energy,
and to forget spells at will, so as to learn new ones. Worshippers can call
upon the Loreminder to help cast any spell they've discovered, even if it's
well beyond their current magical training. Over time, devout followers will
receive spellbooks containing a vast range of spells.
entries.translation: 信徒能够迅速恢复魔法能量，并随意遗忘法术，以学习新的法术。他们可以请求知识守护者帮助施展任何已经发现的法术，即使远远超出当前的魔法修为。随着时间推移，虔诚信徒会获得包含广泛法术的法术书。

entries.english:
Followers of the Shining One are bound to the code of the honourable warrior,
soldiers in their god's eternal crusade against evil. For forsaking dark magic
and underhanded tactics, the Shining One rewards them and their allies with the
power they need to slay demons and the undead. Especially devout warriors can
even call upon angels in times of need. The Shining One's followers can convert
to Elyvilon or Zin while keeping some piety.
entries.translation: 光明神 的信徒恪守荣耀战士的准则，是祂对抗邪恶的永恒圣战中的士兵。作为放弃黑暗魔法与卑劣手段的回报，祂赐予信徒及其盟友斩杀恶魔与亡灵所需的力量。尤其虔诚的战士甚至能在危难时召来天使。信徒改信 艾利维隆 或 辛 时，可以保留一部分虔诚。

entries.english:
Trog is an ancient god of anger and violence. Followers are expected to kill in
Trog's name, and especially to slay wizards. In return, worshippers of Trog
gain the ability to go berserk at will in combat, and will be granted
assistance in the form of powerful weapons and mighty allies. Followers are
absolutely forbidden the use of spell magic.
entries.translation: 特洛戈 是古老的愤怒与暴力之神。祂要求信徒以祂之名杀戮，尤其要杀死巫师。作为回报，信徒能够在战斗中随意狂暴，并获得强大武器与强力盟友的援助。信徒绝对不得使用法术魔法。

entries.english:
Trog offers various powers to help followers in battle. Followers will gain the
ability to go berserk at will, and Trog will extend the duration of their
berserk rage on killing foes. Trog will grant followers the ability to rapidly
heal their wounds while fortifying their willpower, and later the ability to
call in powerful raging allies. Eventually, Trog will gift followers with
weapons, often with antimagic effects.
entries.translation: 特洛戈 提供多种帮助战斗的力量。信徒能够随意狂暴，杀死敌人时祂会延长狂暴时间。祂还允许信徒迅速疗伤，同时强化意志，之后更能召来强大的狂暴盟友。最终，祂会赐予武器，且常常带有反魔法效果。

entries.english:
Uskayaw's wrath turns the powers of the dance against the offender. The prude
will find their foes going berserk and will be forced to helplessly watch as
foes execute their own solos. When the dance is getting too slow, Uskayaw will
cause noise to attract more revellers.
entries.translation: 阿斯卡亚 的神罚会让舞蹈之力反过来对付冒犯者。这些扫兴之人会看到敌人陷入狂暴，并被迫无助地旁观敌人的独舞。若舞蹈的节奏太慢，祂就会制造噪音，招来更多狂欢者。

entries.english:
Worshippers of Vehumet will quickly be able to recover their magical energy
upon killing beings. As they gain favour, they will also gain enhancements to
their destructive spells — first assistance in casting such spells and then
increased range for conjurations. Vehumet will offer followers the knowledge of
increasingly powerful destructive spells as they gain piety.
entries.translation: 信徒很快就能在杀死生物时恢复魔法能量。随着神宠增长，毁灭性法术也会得到增强：先是更容易施展，随后塑能系法术的射程增加。祂会随虔诚提高，传授越来越强大的毁灭性法术。

entries.english:
Those that anger Vehumet find destruction amply heaped upon them. Novices are
struck by flame and frost; archmages by crystal spears and firestorms. Their
own conjurations, too, are wont to misfire at the worst possible moments.
entries.translation: 激怒 维胡梅特 的人，会遭受无尽的毁灭。新手迎来火焰与冰霜，大法师迎来水晶矛和火焰风暴。他们自己的塑能法术，也容易在最糟糕的时刻出错。

entries.english:

issues.review: context_review:地图格子或界面条件标签，不是图块模式名称

entries.english:
Those who turn against the Council must be prepared to endure death by a
thousand cuts. No hiding place is secure, no disguise perfect enough to avoid
the sudden spring of traps, the flying daggers and the armies of animated
weapons that will ambush the betrayer.
entries.translation: 背叛 武剑会 的人，必须准备承受千刀万剐。没有藏身之处足够安全，也没有伪装足够完美，能够躲过突然发动的陷阱、飞来的匕首，以及伏击叛徒的活化武器大军。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
Followers of Yredelemnul carry the Black Torch, allowing them to gather souls
and surround themselves in darkness. They can raise foes who die in the light of
the torch as mindless servants, hurl torchlight to scour the living and empower
the dead, and bind especially noteworthy souls to fight for them in death with
the full capacities they held in life. Especially devout worshippers can even
call down the inescapable grip of the Fallen directly, binding foes helplessly
in place as the very life is sucked from them. Yredelemnul will also dispatch
undead servants to aid followers at the start of each new conquest.
entries.translation: 信徒携带黑色火炬，借此收集灵魂，并让黑暗环绕自身。他们能够把死于火炬光芒中的敌人唤起为无意识的仆从，投掷炬光以侵蚀活物、强化亡者，并束缚尤其出众的灵魂，使其死后仍能以生前的全部本领作战。尤其虔诚者甚至可以直接召来堕落者不可逃脱的掌握，将敌人束缚在原地，任其生命被吸走。每次开始新的征服时，伊莱德莱姆努尔 也会派遣亡灵仆从帮助信徒。

entries.english:
Those who anger Yredelemnul find themselves beset by legions of the dead.
Sometimes, the god will also intervene directly, binding the unfaithful in
inescapable chains as Yredelemnul's dark army demonstrates the price of
betrayal.
entries.translation: 激怒 伊莱德莱姆努尔 的人，会遭到亡者军团围攻。有时，祂还会亲自干预，用无法逃脱的锁链束缚背信者，让黑暗大军向其展示背叛的代价。

entries.english:
Zin grants followers the ability to preach to the unenlightened masses, and
powers to vitalise their bodies, protecting them from various afflictions.
Later, followers gain the ability to imprison their foes temporarily. Followers
can eventually find temporary safety in a divine refuge. As piety grows,
followers will be protected from mutation and the Hells, and Zin may even
occasionally directly intervene to save a follower's life.
entries.translation: 信徒能够向未开悟的大众布道，并使自身充满活力，抵御各种不良状态。之后，信徒能够暂时囚禁敌人。最终，他们可以在神圣庇护所中获得暂时的安全。随着虔诚提高，信徒将受到保护，抵御变异及地狱的影响；辛 有时甚至会直接干预，挽救信徒的生命。

entries.english:
Condolences! Your character's premature death is a sad, but common occurrence
in Crawl. Rest assured that with diligence and playing experience your
characters will last longer.

Perhaps the following advice can improve your playing style:
entries.translation:
很遗憾！角色英年早逝在 Crawl 中令人难过，却也十分常见。随着练习和经验积累，你的角色一定能活得更久。

以下建议也许能帮助你改进玩法：

entries.english:
Don't forget to go berserk when fighting particularly difficult foes. It's
risky, but makes you faster and beefier.
entries.translation: 对付特别难缠的敌人时，别忘了狂暴。它有风险，却能让你更快、更强壮。

issues.review: context_review:普通作战或格斗语境，不是技能标签

entries.english:
Rest between encounters, if possible in an area already explored and cleared of
monsters. Pressing <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles>, or
<input>clicking on the 'rest' button in the command bar'</input></localtiles>
will rest for 100 turns, or until fully healed.
entries.translation: 两次战斗之间要休息，最好在已经探索并清除怪物的区域。按 <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles>，或<input>点击命令栏的“休息”按钮</input></localtiles>，即可休息 100 回合，或直到生命完全恢复。

entries.english:
You can search among all items existing in the dungeon with the
<input>$cmd[CMD_SEARCH_STASHES]</input> command. For example,
<input>$cmd[CMD_SEARCH_STASHES]</input> <w>“dagger”</w> will list all daggers,
and allow you to travel to them. You can even search for dungeon features, like
<w>“shop”</w> or <w>“altar”</w>.
entries.translation: 用 <input>$cmd[CMD_SEARCH_STASHES]</input> 可以搜索地下城中已存在的物品。例如，输入 <input>$cmd[CMD_SEARCH_STASHES]</input> <w>“dagger”</w> 会列出所有匕首，并让你前往其位置。还能搜索地形设施，例如 <w>“shop”</w> 或 <w>“altar”</w>。

entries.english:
There is a convenient way to travel between distant dungeon levels: press
<input>$cmd[CMD_INTERLEVEL_TRAVEL]</input> and enter the desired destination.
If your travel gets interrupted, issuing <input>$cmd[CMD_INTERLEVEL_TRAVEL]
Enter</input> will continue it.
entries.translation:
跨越多个楼层有个方便的方法：按 <input>$cmd[CMD_INTERLEVEL_TRAVEL]</input>，再输入目的地。若旅行中断，按 <input>$cmd[CMD_INTERLEVEL_TRAVEL]
Enter</input> 即可继续。

issues.review: context_review:游戏标题或中文已说明当前楼层，不要求每句重复地下城

entries.english:
Uh-oh, you've wound up in the Abyss! The Abyss is a special place where you
cannot remember or map where you've been; it is filled with nasty monsters, and
you're probably going to die.

To increase your chances of survival until you can find the exit<console> (a
flickering <w>$1</w>)</console>, keep moving, don't fight any of the monsters,
and don't chase after items on the ground. If monsters are closing in, try to
use items and abilities to get away.
entries.translation:
糟了，你落入深渊了！在这个特殊地方，你无法记住或绘制走过的路线；这里遍布凶恶怪物，你很可能会死。

为了撑到找到出口<console>（闪烁的 <w>$1</w>）</console>，应不停移动，不与怪物交战，也不要追逐地上的物品。若怪物逼近，尝试用物品和能力脱身。

entries.english:
To prevent autotravel or autoexplore taking you into dangerous territory, you
can set travel exclusions by entering the map view (<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>)
and then toggling the exclusion radius on the monster position with <w>e</w>.
To make this easier, some immobile monsters listed in the <w>auto_exclude</w>
option (such as this one) are considered dangerous enough to warrant an
automatic setting of an exclusion. It will be automatically cleared if you
manage to kill the monster. You could also manually remove the exclusion with
<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]ee</w> but unless you remove this monster from the
auto_exclude list, the exclusion will be reset the next turn.
entries.translation: 为避免自动旅行或探索把你带进危险区域，可以在地图（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>）中，把光标移到怪物处，按 <w>e</w> 切换旅行禁区范围。<w>auto_exclude</w> 选项列出的部分不移动怪物（例如这一只）会被自动划为禁区；击杀后禁区自动清除。也可按 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]ee</w> 手动移除，但若未从 auto_exclude 列表中去掉此怪物，下一回合禁区就会重设。

entries.english:
Fully exploring a level and picking up all the interesting looking items can be
tedious. To save on this tedium you can press <w>$cmd[CMD_EXPLORE]</w> to
auto-explore, which will automatically explore unmapped regions, automatically
pick up interesting items, and stop if a monster or interesting dungeon feature
(stairs, altar, etc.) is encountered.
entries.translation: 探索完整楼层、捡起所有值得关注的物品可能很繁琐。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_EXPLORE]</w> 自动探索，游戏会探索未测绘区域、拾取值得关注的物品，遇到怪物或楼梯、祭坛等重要地形时停止。

issues.review: context_review:游戏标题或中文已说明当前楼层，不要求每句重复地下城

entries.english:
Upon gaining levels 3, 9, 15, etc., you get to choose an attribute to raise:
strength, intelligence, or dexterity.

<w>Strength</w> makes heavy armour less cumbersome and slightly increases most
weapons' damage.

<w>Intelligence</w> makes your spells more reliable and powerful.

<w>Dexterity</w> increases your evasion and stealth, and slightly increases the
damage of blades and ranged weapons.
entries.translation:
达到 3、9、15 等等级时，你可以选择提高力量、智力或敏捷中的一项。

<w>力量</w>减轻重甲的负担，并略微提高大多数武器的伤害。

<w>智力</w>让法术更可靠、更强。

<w>敏捷</w>提高闪避和潜行，并略微提高刀剑及远程武器的伤害。

entries.english:
You've just converted to worshipping <w>Gozag</w>. Unlike other gods, Gozag only
