cares about gold; each divine power costs gold, and your foes turn to gold on
death.
entries.translation: 你刚刚皈依了<w>哥萨戈</w>。与其他神不同，哥萨戈只关心金币。每项神力都需要花费金币，而敌人死亡后会化为金币。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
You've just converted to worshipping <w>Ru</w>. Unlike other gods, Ru grants
piety (divine favour) in exchange for permanent sacrifices, like losing the
ability to train certain skills, or permanently losing a hand. The more piety
you have, the more abilities Ru will grant, and the more powerful those
abilities will become. Ru will offer more sacrifices as you explore the depths
of the dungeon.
entries.translation: 你刚刚皈依了<w>入</w>。与其他神不同，入用虔诚换取永久牺牲，例如失去训练某些技能的能力，或永远失去一只手。虔诚越高，祂赐予的能力越多，能力也越强。随着你深入地下城，祂会提出更多牺牲。

issues.review: context_review:普通深处描述，不是深处以外的分支名
context_review:普通深处描述，不是分支名称

entries.english:
Hey, you've finished exploring the dungeon on this level! You can search for
stairs from the level map (<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>) by pressing <w>></w>.
The cursor will jump to the nearest staircase, and by pressing <w>.</w> or
<w>Enter</w> your character can move there, too. Each level of Crawl has three
<console>white </console>up and three <console>white </console>down stairs.
Unexplored parts can often be accessed via another level.
entries.translation: 你已经探索完本层地下城了！在楼层地图（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>）中按 <w>></w> 可寻找楼梯。光标会跳到最近的楼梯，按 <w>.</w> 或 <w>Enter</w> 即可前往。每层通常有三座<console>白色</console>上楼楼梯和三座<console>白色</console>下楼楼梯。尚未探索的区域往往能经由其他楼层到达。

issues.review: context_review:省略中文角色主语或人物描述，不是属性标签

entries.english:
Being skilled with ranged weapons will let you deal slightly more damage and
attack significantly faster with them. Remember that wearing heavy armour makes
you attack more slowly with ranged weapons.
entries.translation: 提高远程武器技能，会略微提高其伤害，并显著加快攻击速度。记住，重甲会减缓远程武器的攻击速度。

entries.english:
Your health is getting dangerously low. Retreating and/or quaffing a potion of
heal wounds or curing might be a good idea.
entries.translation: 你的生命已经低得很危险。考虑撤退，或饮用疗伤药水、治疗药水。

issues.review: context_review:完整药水名称愈伤药水，优先于同名法术标题

entries.english:
<tiles>A small symbol on an item tile signifies that there is at least one other
item in the same heap that you may want to check out.</tiles>
<console>If two or more items are on a single square, then the square will be
highlighted, and the symbol for the item on the top of the heap will be shown.
</console>
entries.translation: <tiles>物品图标上的小记号表示同一堆中至少还有另一件物品，值得查看。</tiles><console>同一格有两件以上物品时，格子会高亮，并显示物品堆最上面那件的符号。</console>

entries.english:
Fighting against a monster you cannot see is difficult. If you don't have a
source of see invisibility, you can find invisible monsters by luring them into
shallow water, opaque clouds (from a scroll of fog), or a corridor, where their
movements will be more predictable. If things go south, try teleporting out, or
leaving the level entirely!
entries.translation: 与看不见的怪物作战很困难。若无法看见隐形，可以把怪物引入浅水、不透明云雾（如迷雾卷轴产生的云雾），或走廊，让其移动更容易预测。情况不妙时，尝试传送逃离，甚至直接离开本层！

entries.english:
As you explore the dungeon and reveal new tiles, the malevolent forces of the
dungeon may randomly cause bad things to happen to you. When this happens,
pause, think carefully, and be ready to use consumables or abilities. Fight to
survive!"
entries.translation: 探索地下城、揭开新格子时，地下城的恶意力量可能随机让坏事发生。遇到这种情况，应停下来仔细思考，随时准备用消耗品或能力。为生存而战！

issues.review: context_review:地图格子或界面条件标签，不是图块模式名称

entries.english:
As you explore a level, orientation can become difficult. Press
<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w> to bring up the level map. Typing <w>?</w> shows
the list of level map commands. Most importantly, moving the cursor to a spot
and pressing <w>.</w> or <w>Enter</w> lets your character move there on its own.

<localtiles>Also, clicking on the right-side minimap with your <w>right mouse
button</w> will zoom into that dungeon area. Clicking with the <w>left mouse
button</w> instead will let you move there.</localtiles>
entries.translation:
探索楼层后可能不容易辨认方向。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w> 打开楼层地图，按 <w>?</w> 查看地图命令。最实用的是，把光标移到某处，按 <w>.</w> 或 <w>Enter</w>，角色就会自动前往。

<localtiles>在右侧小地图上按<w>鼠标右键</w>，会放大对应区域；按<w>鼠标左键</w>则会自动前往。</localtiles>

issues.review: context_review:游戏标题或中文已说明当前楼层，不要求每句重复地下城

entries.english:
If the spellcasting success chance is high (which can be checked by entering
<w>$cmd[CMD_CAST_SPELL]\?</w> or <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</w>) then a miscast
merely means the spell is not working, along with a harmless side effect.
However, for spells with a high failure rate, there's a chance of contaminating
yourself with magical energy, plus a chance of an additional harmful side
effect. Normally this isn't a problem, since magical contamination bleeds off
over time, but if you're repeatedly contaminated in a short amount of time
you'll mutate or suffer from other ill side effects.

Note that a miscast spell will still consume the full amount of MP that a
successfully cast spell would.
entries.translation:
若施法成功率较高（可按 <w>$cmd[CMD_CAST_SPELL]\?</w> 或 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</w> 查看），失败只意味着法术没生效，并伴随无害副作用。但失败率较高的法术，可能造成魔法污染，以及额外有害副作用。污染通常会随时间消退；若短时间内反复积累，则可能造成变异或其他不良后果。

注意，失败仍会消耗与成功施法相同的全部魔力。

entries.english:
That monster looks a bit unusual. You might wish to examine it a bit more
closely by <localtiles>hovering your mouse over its tile.</localtiles>
<nomouse>pressing <w>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</w> and moving the cursor onto its
square.</nomouse>
entries.translation: 那只怪物有点不寻常，值得仔细检查：<localtiles>将鼠标悬停在它的图标上。</localtiles><nomouse>按 <w>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</w>，将光标移到它所在格。</nomouse>

issues.review: context_review:情态动词、匹敌或普通力量描述，不是强力状态

entries.english:
You recently noticed an invisible monster, so unless you killed it or left the
scene, resting might not be safe. If you still need to replenish your health or
magic, you'll have to quaff an appropriate potion. For normal resting you will
first have to get away from the danger.
entries.translation: 你刚发现过隐形怪物，除非已经杀死它或离开现场，否则休息可能不安全。仍需补充生命或魔力时，得喝相应药水。想正常休息，应先摆脱危险。

entries.english:
You are lethally poisoned, so now would be a good time to
<w>$cmd[CMD_QUAFF]</w>uaff a potion of heal wounds or, better yet, a potion of
curing. If you have seen neither of these so far, try unknown potions in your
inventory. Good luck!
entries.translation: 你已致命中毒！现在应按 <w>$cmd[CMD_QUAFF]</w> 饮用愈伤药水，更好的是治疗药水。如果两种都没见过，可以试试物品栏中的未知药水。祝好运！

issues.review: context_review:完整药水名称愈伤药水，优先于同名法术标题

entries.english:
Well done! Reaching a new experience level is always a nice event. You get more
health and magic points, and occasionally increases to your attributes:
strength, intelligence, and dexterity.

{{
    if crawl.hints_type() == "magic" then
        return "Gaining an experience level also lets you learn more difficult"
               .. " spells. You can memorise a second spell with"
               .. " <w>$cmd[CMD_MEMORISE_SPELL]</w><tiles> or by"
               .. " <w>clicking</w> on it in the memorisation tab</tiles>."
    end
}}

issues.review: context_review:经历、体验或升级动作，不是独立经验数值标签

entries.english:
Whenever your health is very low and you're in danger of dying, check your
options carefully. Often, retreat or use of some item might be a viable
alternative to fighting on.
entries.translation: 生命极低、面临死亡时，应仔细检查可用手段。撤退或使用某件物品，往往比继续硬拼更可行。

issues.review: context_review:普通作战或格斗语境，不是技能标签

entries.english:
That<console> $1</console> is an altar.
<localtiles>By <w>right-clicking</w> on it with your mouse</localtiles>
<nomouse>If you target the altar with <w>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</w>, then press
<w>$cmd[CMD_TARGET_DESCRIBE]</w></nomouse> you can get a short description.

Press <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> or <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w> while
standing on the square to join the faith or read some information about the god
in question. Before taking up the corresponding faith you'll be asked for
confirmation.

{{
    if you.god() == "No God" and crawl.hints_type() == "magic" then
        return "The simplest god for an inexperienced conjurer is probably "
               .. "Vehumet, though many other gods, like Sif Muna, can also "
               .. "work well."
    end
}}

This is the first piece of armour<console> ('<w>$item[armour]</w>')</console>
you've picked up. <localtiles>You can click on it to wear it, and click again
to remove it. <w>Right-clicking</w> on it will give more information.
</localtiles><nomouse>Use <w>$cmd[CMD_WEAR_ARMOUR]</w> to wear it and
<w>$cmd[CMD_REMOVE_ARMOUR]</w> to take it off again. You can view its
properties from your <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>nventory.
</nomouse>

{{
    if you.get_base_mutation_level("horns") > 0 then
        return "Note that because of your horns you will be unable to wear"
               .. " helmets. (Press <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MUTATIONS]</w> to see"
               .. " a list of your mutations and innate abilities.)"
    end
}}

This<console> '$1'</console> is a portal to an inter-dimensional bazaar filled
with shops. It will disappear if you don't enter it soon, so hurry.
entries.translation: 这<console>个“$1”</console>是通往跨维度市集的传送门，里面有许多商店。如果不尽快进入，它就会消失，抓紧时间！

entries.english:
This<console> '$1'</console> is the entrance to a different branch of the
dungeon. Each branch has different terrain and monsters, and some contain
entrances to other branches. You can learn more by examining this
entrance<localtiles> by hovering your mouse over its tile</localtiles><nomouse
by pressing <w>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</w> and moving the cursor onto it."

Some branches will be much safer and more rewarding than your current branch.
Others can be very dangerous, better visited when your character is more
powerful.
entries.translation:
这<console>个“$1”</console>是另一个地下城分支的入口。各分支有不同的地形和怪物，有些还通往其他分支。查看入口可获得更多信息：<localtiles>将鼠标悬停在入口图标上</localtiles>，或按 <w>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</w> 并将光标移到入口。

有些分支比当前分支更安全、收获更多；另一些则很危险，最好等角色更强后再去。

entries.english:
That<console> $1</console> is a closed door. You can open it by walking into it.
Sometimes it is useful to close a door. Do so by <nomouse>pressing
<w>$cmd[CMD_CLOSE_DOOR]</w> while next to it. If there are several doors, you
will then be prompted for a direction.</nomouse><localtiles>clicking on the door
while next to it.</localtiles>
entries.translation: 那<console>个 $1</console>是一扇关闭的门，朝它走过去就能打开。有时关门很有用：<nomouse>站在旁边按 <w>$cmd[CMD_CLOSE_DOOR]</w>。若附近有多扇门，会要求选择方向。</nomouse><localtiles>站在旁边点击门即可。</localtiles>

entries.english:
This<console> '$1'</console> is an escape hatch. You can use it to leave a
level with <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> and <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w>
respectively<localtiles> (or by<w>left-clicking</w>)</localtiles>, like stairs;
unlike stairs, however, hatches are a one-way trip, so be careful when
descending!
entries.translation: 这<console>个“$1”</console>是逃生口。与楼梯一样，可以分别用 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> 或 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w><localtiles>（也可按<w>鼠标左键</w>）</localtiles>离开本层。但逃生口是单向的，下去时务必小心！

entries.english:
That <console>$1 </console>is an item. If you move there and press
<input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input><localtiles>, or <input>left-click</input> on it
in your inventory</localtiles>, you will pick it up.<console> Generally, items
are shown by non-letter symbols like <w>%?!"=()[</w>.</console> Some
objects<tiles>, marked with a green frame,</tiles> will be picked up
automatically.

Once it is in your inventory, you can drop it again with <localtiles>a
<input>Shift-left-click</input>. Whenever you <input>right-click</input> on an
item</localtiles><console><input>$cmd[CMD_DROP]</input>. Any time you look at an
item in your inventory (<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</input>)</console>,
you can read about its properties and its description.
entries.translation:
那<console>个 $1 </console>是一件物品。走到那里按 <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input><localtiles>，或在物品栏面板中对它按<input>鼠标左键</input></localtiles>，就能拾取。<console>物品通常用 <w>%?!"=()[</w> 等非字母符号表示。</console>部分物品<tiles>带有绿色边框，</tiles>会被自动拾取。

放入物品栏后，可用<localtiles><input>Shift-left-click</input> 丢弃。每当你对物品按<input>鼠标右键</input></localtiles><console><input>$cmd[CMD_DROP]</input> 丢弃。查看物品栏中的物品（<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</input>）时</console>，都能阅读它的属性和说明。

entries.english:
You have picked up your first pile of gold<console>
('<yellow>$item[gold]</yellow>')</console>. Press <w>$cmd[CMD_LIST_GOLD]</w> to
see how much you have. Gold is used in shops you'll find as you explore.
entries.translation: 你捡到了第一堆金币<console>（“<yellow>$item[gold]</yellow>”）</console>。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_LIST_GOLD]</w> 可查看数量。金币用于探索时遇到的商店。

entries.english:
You have picked up a piece of jewellery, either a ring
<console>('<w>$item[jewellery]</w>') </console>or an
amulet<console> ('<w>$item[amulet]</w>')</console>.
<nomouse>Press <w>$cmd[CMD_WEAR_JEWELLERY]</w> to put it on and
<w>$cmd[CMD_REMOVE_JEWELLERY]</w> to remove it. You can view its properties
from your <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>nventory.</nomouse>
<localtiles>You can click on it to put it on, and click again to remove it. By
<w>right-clicking</w> on it, you can view its properties.</localtiles>
entries.translation: 你捡到了一件首饰，可能是戒指<console>（“<w>$item[jewellery]</w>”）</console>或护身符<console>（“<w>$item[amulet]</w>”）</console>。<nomouse>按 <w>$cmd[CMD_WEAR_JEWELLERY]</w> 戴上，按 <w>$cmd[CMD_REMOVE_JEWELLERY]</w> 摘下。在背包（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>）中可查看属性。</nomouse><localtiles>点击可戴上，再点击可摘下；按<w>鼠标右键</w>可查看属性。</localtiles>

entries.english:
This is a curious object indeed. You can play around with it to find out what
it does by <localtiles>clicking on it to e<w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w>oke </localtiles>
<nomouse>e<w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w>oking </nomouse>it. As usual, selecting it from
your <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>nventory might give you more information.
entries.translation: 这是一件奇特的物品。你可以<localtiles>点击它，按 <w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w> 发动</localtiles><nomouse>按 <w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w> 发动</nomouse>，试试效果。如往常一样，在背包（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>）中选择它，也许能得到更多信息。

entries.english:
This is the first stack of missiles<console> ('<w>$item[missile]</w>')</console>
you've picked up. Missiles like boomerangs and throwing nets can be thrown by
hand, and become more effective as you train the Throwing skill.
<localtiles><w>Right-click</w> on</localtiles><nomouse>Select</nomouse>
the item in your <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>nventory to see more
information.

{{
    if crawl.hints_type() == "ranger" then
        return "As you're already trained in Ranged Weapons, you don't really "
               .. "need another type of ranged attack."
    elseif crawl.hints_type() == "magic" then
        return "However, as a spellslinger, you don't really need another type"
               .. " of ranged attack."
    else
        return ""
    end
}}
entries.translation:
这是你捡到的第一堆弹药<console>（“<w>$item[missile]</w>”）</console>。回旋镖、投网等弹药可以徒手投掷，训练投掷技能会提高效果。在背包（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>）中<localtiles><w>右键点击</w></localtiles><nomouse>选择</nomouse>物品，可查看更多信息。

{{
    if crawl.hints_type() == "ranger" then
        return "既然你已经训练远程武器，"
               .. "就不太需要另一类远程攻击了。"
    elseif crawl.hints_type() == "magic" then
        return "不过，作为施法者，你也不太需要"
               .. "另一类远程攻击。"
    else
        return ""
    end
}}

entries.english:
This<console> '$1'</console> is a portal to an optional level, offering extra
loot in exchange for extra danger. There's no penalty for skipping it, but the
portal will disappear if you wait, so you have to decide now if you want to risk
it.
entries.translation: 这<console>个“$1”</console>是通往可选楼层的传送门，以额外风险换取额外战利品。跳过没有惩罚，但等候会使入口消失，所以必须马上决定是否冒险。

entries.english:
You can enter a portal just like a set of stairs, by standing on it and
<localtiles><w>clicking</w> or </localtiles>pressing
<w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w>. To return, find <tiles>a similar looking portal.
</tiles><console>another $1 - but NOT the ancient stone arch you'll start out
on!</console>
entries.translation: 使用传送门和楼梯一样：站在上面，<localtiles><w>点击</w>或</localtiles>按 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w>。返回时，寻找<tiles>外观相似的传送门。</tiles><console>另一个 $1，而不是你进入时站着的古老石拱门！</console>

entries.english:
You have picked up your first potion<console> ('<w>$item[potion]</w>')</console>.
<localtiles>Simply <w>left-click</w> on it, or press</localtiles>
<nomouse>Press</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_QUAFF]</w> to quaff it.

Once you've identified a potion, either with a scroll of identification or by
drinking it, you'll automatically recognise all other potions of the same type;
this means it's sometimes useful to drink potions just to identify them.
entries.translation:
你捡到了第一瓶药水<console>（“<w>$item[potion]</w>”）</console>。<localtiles>对它按<w>鼠标左键</w>，或按</localtiles><nomouse>按</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_QUAFF]</w> 即可饮用。

用鉴定卷轴或饮用方式鉴定一种药水后，你会自动认出所有同类药水；所以有时为了鉴定而喝药也有价值。

entries.english:
That<console> $1</console> is a runed door, which is probably in front of
something unusually dangerous. Monsters will never open it. If you do, the runes
will be broken, and it will become a normal door.
entries.translation: 那<console>个 $1</console>是一扇符文门，后面很可能格外危险。怪物永远不会打开它。若你开门，符文就会破碎，它也会变成普通的门。

entries.english:
You have picked up your first scroll<console> ('<w>$item[scroll]</w>')</console>.
<localtiles>Simply <w>left-click</w> on it, or press</localtiles>
<nomouse>Press</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_READ]</w> to read it.

Once you've identified a scroll, either with a scroll of identification or by
reading it, you'll automatically recognise all other scrolls of the same type;
this means it's sometimes useful to read scrolls just to identify them.
entries.translation:
你捡到了第一张卷轴<console>（“<w>$item[scroll]</w>”）</console>。<localtiles>对它按<w>鼠标左键</w>，或按</localtiles><nomouse>按</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_READ]</w> 即可阅读。

用鉴定卷轴或阅读方式鉴定一种卷轴后，你会自动认出所有同类卷轴；所以有时为了鉴定而读卷轴也有价值。

entries.english:
That<console> $1</console> is a shop. You can enter it by typing
<w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> or <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w>
<tiles>, or by <w>left-clicking</w> on it<tiles>
while standing on the square.

If there's anything you want which you can't afford yet, you can hold
<w>Shift</w> and press the corresponding letter to put it on your shopping list.
The game will then remind you when you gather enough gold to buy it.
entries.translation:
那<console>个 $1</console>是一家商店。站在上面，按 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> 或 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w><tiles>，也可按<w>鼠标左键</w></tiles>即可进入。

若想买的商品暂时买不起，可以按住 <w>Shift</w> 再按对应字母，将其加入购物清单。金币足够时，游戏会提醒你。

entries.english:
You have picked up a magic staff<console> ('<w>$item[magical staff]</w>')</console>.
It must be <w>$cmd[CMD_WIELD_WEAPON]</w>ielded to be of use. Magicians use
staves to increase their power in certain spell schools. It can also be used as
a weapon.<localtiles> You can wield a staff by <w>left-clicking</w>.</localtiles>
entries.translation: 你捡到了一根魔法棍杖<console>（“<w>$item[magical staff]</w>”）</console>。必须持用（<w>$cmd[CMD_WIELD_WEAPON]</w>）才能发挥作用。施法者用棍杖增强特定魔法学派的威力，也能将它作为武器。<localtiles>对棍杖按<w>鼠标左键</w>即可持用。</localtiles>

entries.english:
These<console> '$1'</console> are downstairs. You can enter the next (deeper)
level by following them down (<w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w>). To return to this
level, press <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> while standing on the upstairs. When
you take stairs, you are guaranteed a opportunity to act before any monsters you
have not seen before; after that, monsters get to move first.

<localtiles>Alternatively, you can <w>left-click</w> on stairs you're standing
on to use them.</localtiles>
entries.translation:
这<console>个“$1”</console>是下楼楼梯。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</w> 可以前往更深一层。站在上楼楼梯上按 <w>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</w> 即可返回。使用楼梯后，你保证能在所有此前未见的怪物之前行动一次；之后则由怪物先移动。

<localtiles>也可以站在楼梯上，按<w>鼠标左键</w>使用它。</localtiles>

entries.english:
You have picked up your first wand<console> ('<w>$item[wand]</w>')</console>.
<localtiles>Simply <w>left-click</w> on it, or press</localtiles>
<nomouse>Press</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w> to evoke it.

If you find more wands of the same type, they'll merge into this wand and add
charges to it.
entries.translation:
你捡到了第一根魔杖<console>（“<w>$item[wand]</w>”）</console>。<localtiles>对它按<w>鼠标左键</w>，或按</localtiles><nomouse>按</nomouse> <w>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</w> 即可发动。

以后找到的同类魔杖会合并进这一根，增加它的充能次数。

entries.english:
This is the first weapon<console> ('<w>$item[weapon]</w>')</console> you've
picked up. Use <w>$cmd[CMD_WIELD_WEAPON]</w><localtiles> or
<w>left-click</w> on it</localtiles> to wield it, but be aware that this
weapon might train a different skill from your current one. You can view the
weapon's properties from your
<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_INVENTORY]</w>nventory<localtiles> or by
<w>right-clicking</w> on it</localtiles>.

{{
    if crawl.hints_type() == "berserk" then
        return "You should probably stick with axes. Checking other axes'"
               .. " enchantments can be worthwhile, though!"
    end
}}

That<console> $1</console> is $2. While <w>technically</w> a monster, it's
more like dungeon furniture, since it's harmless and doesn't move. If it's in
your way you can attack and kill it like other monsters, but you won't get any
experience for doing so.
entries.translation: 那<console>个 $1</console>是 $2。虽然<w>严格说来</w>也是怪物，但它无害且不移动，更像地下城家具。挡路时可以像其他怪物一样攻击并杀死它，但不会获得经验。

entries.english:
Walking around takes fewer keystrokes if you press <w>Shift-direction</w> or
<w>/ direction</w>. That will let you run until a monster comes into sight or
your character sees something interesting.
entries.translation: 按 <w>Shift-direction</w> 或 <w>/ direction</w> 可减少走路时的按键次数，持续前进，直到看见怪物或其他值得关注的事物。

issues.review: context_review:省略中文角色主语或人物描述，不是属性标签

entries.english:
One of your skills just reached a milestone. The skills you use are
automatically trained whenever you gain experience, by killing monsters. By
default, experience goes to skills you actively use. To view or manage your
skills, type <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SKILLS]</w><localtiles> or click on the skill
tab in the bottom-right</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 你的一项技能刚刚达到了新的里程碑。击杀怪物获得经验时，你使用的技能会自动得到训练。默认情况下，经验分配给你正在使用的技能。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SKILLS]</w><localtiles>，或点击右下方的技能标签</localtiles>，可查看并管理技能。

entries.english:
Miscasting a spell can have nasty consequences, particularly for the more
difficult spells. Your chance of successfully casting a spell increases with
your magic skills, and can also be improved with the help of some items. Use
the <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</w> command<localtiles> or mouse over the spell
tiles</localtiles> to check your current failure rates.
entries.translation: 施法失败可能带来严重后果，高难度法术尤其如此。魔法技能越高，成功率越高，一些物品也有帮助。按 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</w><localtiles>，或将鼠标悬停在法术图标上</localtiles>，可查看当前失败率。

entries.english:
<tiles>A small symbol on a stair tile signifies that there are items in that
position that you may want to check out.</tiles>
<console>If any items are covering stairs or an escape hatch, then that will
be indicated by highlighting the <w><<</w> or <w>></w> symbol, instead of hiding
the stair symbol with an item glyph.</console>
entries.translation: <tiles>楼梯图标上的小记号表示那里有物品，值得查看。</tiles><console>若物品盖住楼梯或逃生口，游戏会高亮 <w><<</w> 或 <w>></w> 符号，而不使用物品符号遮住它。</console>

entries.english:
<console>If any items are covering a trap, then that will be indicated by
highlighting the <w>^</w> symbol, instead of hiding the trap symbol with an item
glyph.</console>
entries.translation: <console>若物品盖住陷阱，游戏会高亮 <w>^</w> 符号，而不使用物品符号遮住陷阱。</console>

entries.english: You just miscast a spell.
entries.translation: 你刚刚施法失败了。

entries.english:
Most attacks in Crawl are defended against by your AC. Some, like fire or
draining attacks, can be further reduced by specific resistances. Other magical
effects, such as Slow or Confusion hexes, are resisted by your willpower.
You'll find items that increase both kinds of resistances.

To view your current set of resistances, <localtiles><w>right-click</w> on the
player avatar, or </localtiles>press <w>$cmd[CMD_RESISTS_SCREEN]</w>.
entries.translation:
大多数攻击由护甲值抵御。火焰或吸能等伤害，还能由特定抗性进一步减轻。减速、混乱等妖术，则由意志抵抗。你会找到能提高这些抗性的物品。

<localtiles>对角色图像按<w>鼠标右键</w>，或</localtiles>按 <w>$cmd[CMD_RESISTS_SCREEN]</w>，查看当前抗性。

entries.english:
While you are silenced, you cannot cast spells, read scrolls or use divine
invocations. The same is true for any monster within the effect radius. The
field of silence (recognizable by <tiles>the special-looking frame tiles</tiles>
<console>different-coloured floor squares</console>) is always centered on you
and will move along with you. The radius will gradually shrink, eventually
making you the only one affected, before the effect fades entirely.
entries.translation: 被静默时，你无法施法、阅读卷轴或使用神祇祈祷；效果范围内的怪物也一样。静默领域（可由<tiles>特殊边框图标</tiles><console>不同颜色的地面格</console>识别）始终以你为中心，随你移动。半径会逐渐缩小，最后只影响你，随后完全消失。

entries.english:
<white>Welcome to Dungeon Crawl!</white>

Your objective is to lead your <w>{{ return you.race() }} {{ return you.class()
}}</w> safely through the depths of the dungeon, retrieving the fabled Orb of
Zot and returning it to the surface. In the beginning, however, let discovery
be your main goal. Try to delve as deeply as possible but beware; death lurks
around every corner.

For the moment, just remember the following keys and their functions:
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_COMMANDS]?</input> — shows the items and the commands
  <input>$cmd[CMD_SAVE_GAME]</input>  — saves the game, to be resumed later
(but note that death is permanent)
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</input>  — examines something in your vicinity

The hint mode will help you play Crawl without reading any documentation. If
you haven't yet, you might want to try out the tutorial. Also, if you feel
intrigued, there is more information available in the following files from the
docs/ directory (all of which can also be read in-game):
  <lightblue>quickstart.txt</lightblue>     — A very short guide to Crawl.
  <lightblue>crawl_manual.txt</lightblue>   — This contains all details on
species, magic, skills, etc.
  <lightblue>options_guide.txt</lightblue>  — Crawl's interface is highly
configurable. This document explains all the options.

Happy Crawling!
entries.translation:
<white>欢迎来到 Dungeon Crawl！</white>

你的目标是带领<w>{{ return you.race() }} {{ return you.class()
}}</w>安全深入地下城，取回传说中的佐特宝珠，再将它带回地表。不过，刚开始时不妨以探索和发现为主，尽可能深入，但要小心：死亡潜伏在每个角落。

目前只需记住以下按键：
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_COMMANDS]?</input> — 查看物品符号与命令
  <input>$cmd[CMD_SAVE_GAME]</input> — 保存游戏，稍后继续
（但请注意，死亡是永久的）
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</input> — 检查周围的事物

提示模式能帮助你在不阅读文档的情况下游玩。若还没试过，也可以先玩教程。想了解更多，可阅读 docs/ 目录中的以下文件，也都能在游戏内打开：
  <lightblue>quickstart.txt</lightblue> — 极简入门指南。
  <lightblue>crawl_manual.txt</lightblue> — 种族、魔法、技能等的完整说明。
  <lightblue>options_guide.txt</lightblue> — 界面高度可定制，此文档解释全部配置选项。

祝探索愉快！

issues.review: context_review:普通深处描述，不是深处以外的分支名
context_review:普通深处描述，不是分支名称

entries.english:
The scales of an acid dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer with as
much protection as the armour made from the scales of some larger dragons, it is
somewhat lighter and less encumbering. It is also remarkably smooth, letting
corrosive slime flow off it like water.
entries.translation: 酸龙的鳞片。它的防护不如某些大型龙类的鳞甲，但稍轻，累赘也较少。表面还异常光滑，腐蚀性黏液会像水一样滑落。

entries.english:
A charm crafted to call the attention of the gods to its wearer. This divine
attention makes it easier to please your god, but your god will also take more
notice of your transgressions. The amulet will drain some of your divine favour
when removed.
entries.translation: 一种用来吸引神祇注意佩戴者的饰物。神祇的关注让你更容易取悦祂，但祂也会更留意你的过失。卸下护身符会损失一部分神恩。

entries.english:
A manuscript containing dark spells of Necromancy. Each page is filled with
grotesque art depicting scenes of disgusting decay.
entries.translation: 一本记载黑暗死灵法术的手稿，每页都布满描绘恶心腐败景象的怪诞图画。

entries.english:
A book containing advanced spells in the elemental school of Fire, stolen from
the secret college of the djinn.
entries.translation: 一本收录火系高阶法术的书，从灯灵的秘密学院偷来。

entries.english:
A spellbook containing an assortment of powerful Hexes, which sparkles and
shimmers as the pages are flipped.
entries.translation: 一本收录多种强大妖术的魔法书，翻页时闪烁着微光。

entries.english:
A macabre book containing basic Necromancy spells. Readers are recommended to
wear a pair of gloves they don't mind disposing of afterward.
entries.translation: 一本阴森的基础死灵魔法书。建议读者戴上用完即可丢弃的手套。

entries.english: A suit of armour made entirely out of tiny metal rings.
entries.translation: 一套完全由细小金属环编成的锁子甲。

entries.english: An incredibly heavy but extremely effective suit of crystalline armour.
entries.translation: 一套由晶体构成的板甲，极其沉重，却有极佳的防护。

entries.english:
A deck of magical cards, most of which hurl death and destruction at one's foes
(or, if unlucky, at oneself).
entries.translation: 一副魔法卡牌，多数会把死亡与毁灭抛向敌人；若运气不好，也可能抛向使用者自己。

entries.english: A deck of magical cards, mainly dealing with various forms of escape.
entries.translation: 一副主要提供各种逃生手段的魔法卡牌。

entries.english: A deck of magical cards which wreak havoc on the user.
entries.translation: 一副会给使用者招致灾祸的魔法卡牌。

entries.english: A deck of magical cards, depicting a range of weird and wonderful creatures.
entries.translation: 一副魔法卡牌，描绘着各种奇异而神妙的生物。

entries.english:
A rotten eggplant which you can throw at the Crawl developers. It's a bug if
you ever see this message.
entries.translation: 一根烂茄子，可以拿来扔 Crawl 开发者。如果你看到了这条消息，那就是程序缺陷。

entries.english: A mace with a short chain connecting the head to the haft.
entries.translation: 一种用短链连接锤头与握柄的锤。

entries.english:
A stone of unearthly beauty and almost immeasurable value outside the dungeon.
Within its confines, it is utterly useless.

Zot hoards these gems jealously, and will spitefully smash them soon after an
adventurer enters the branch of the Dungeon in which they rest. Still, a very
quick-moving adventurer might seize one first and keep its precious shards.
Zot cannot track gems outside their home branches, so with truly astonishing
speed, it might be possible to abscond with one still intact... but such a
feat is difficult to credit, and likely pointless besides.

Once the Orb of Zot is taken, Zot will be unable to smash any gems.
entries.translation:
一颗美得不似尘世之物的宝石，在地下城外价值几乎无法估量，但在其中却毫无用处。

佐特嫉妒地囤积这些宝石；冒险者进入宝石所在的地下城分支后不久，佐特就会恶意地将其击碎。不过，行动足够迅速的冒险者，也许能抢先拿到宝石，留住珍贵的碎片。宝石离开原属分支后，佐特便无法追踪；若速度快得惊人，或许真能带着完整宝石逃走……但这种壮举令人难以置信，而且多半也毫无意义。

佐特宝珠被取走后，佐特就无法再击碎任何宝石。

entries.english:
A heavy stone icon, bearing the countenance of some long-forgotten king or god.
Transforms the wearer into a slow, stone statue. The wearer's stone body is
immune to poison and miasma, and gains resistance to electricity, negative
energy, and torment. Shapeshifting skill increases armour granted.
entries.translation: 一尊沉重的石像，面容属于某位早已被遗忘的君王或神祇。它会把佩戴者变成缓慢的石像。石质身体免疫毒素与瘴气，并抵御电击、负能量及折磨。变形术技能会提高获得的护甲值。

entries.english: A blunt striking weapon, essentially equivalent to a mace.
entries.translation: 一件钝击武器，实质上与钉头锤相当。

issues.review: context_review:普通击打或叩击，不是专名

entries.english: A cloth hat.
entries.translation: 一顶布帽。

entries.english:
A painted eyepatch made from a scrap of wolf pelt. Transforms the wearer into a
vicious werewolf, muscles surging with predatory instinct. Killing enemies with
melee attacks in this form will give a stacking bonus to your damage and
accuracy, and slaying enough of them in a row will cause you to unleash a
vicious howl that makes any still alive cower in fear - and leaves them
susceptible to a devastating leaping takedown.
entries.translation: 一块狼皮做成的彩绘眼罩。它会把佩戴者变成凶猛的狼人，肌肉充满捕猎本能。此形态下以近战击杀敌人，会获得可叠加的伤害与命中加成。连续杀死足够多的敌人后，会发出凶狠的嚎叫，使幸存者畏缩，并容易遭受毁灭性的跳跃扑杀。

entries.english:
A strange substance, produced by ghost moths. Consuming it causes regeneration
of health and magic, along with total befuddlement. The two effects are
fundamentally linked – the regeneration ends the moment the confusion does.
entries.translation: 一种由幽灵蛾产生的奇异物质。饮用后会恢复生命和魔力，同时陷入彻底的混乱。两种效果紧密相连：混乱一结束，再生效果也会立即结束。

entries.english:
A potion which makes the drinker attract enemies, translocating them quickly closer
for the duration of the effect. The effect is surprisingly subtle, and unwary
victims may sleep through it entirely.
entries.translation: 一种能让饮用者吸引敌人的药水，在效果持续期间将敌人迅速位移到更近的位置。这种效果出奇地轻微，毫无防备的受害者甚至可能在被拉动时一直熟睡。

entries.english:
A potion which can send one into an incoherent rage, granting them a great but
temporary increase to their health, damage, and speed. In exchange, their mind
is clouded by anger, only allowing them to move and attack in melee. The rage
will wear off quickly if they do not attack monsters, and upon expiry, the
imbiber will be fatigued, causing them to slow dramatically and rendering them
unable to berserk again for a short duration.
entries.translation: 一种能使饮用者陷入失去理智的狂暴的药水，暂时大幅提高生命、伤害和速度。代价是愤怒蒙蔽了心智，只能移动和进行近战攻击。不攻击怪物时，狂暴会迅速消退；结束后饮用者会感到疲惫，速度大幅降低，且短时间内无法再次狂暴。

issues.review: context_review:迟缓、反应慢、减缓速度是描述语，不强制使用法术名

entries.english: A truly wonderful and very rare drink, which grants experience when consumed.
entries.translation: 一种极为珍稀的奇妙饮品，饮用后能获得经验。

entries.english:
A potion which transforms the imbiber into an animated tree with sap for blood and
branches capable of holding weapons. Such a tree has minimal evasion but increased
health and natural armour, and is resistant to poison, and immune to torment and
drowning. However, it is rooted in place while the transformation lasts, and
cannot teleport.
entries.translation: 一种能使饮用者变成活动树木的药水，树液化为血液，枝干可以持握武器。这棵树的闪避极低，但生命和天然护甲值提高，具备毒素抗性，并免疫折磨和溺水。然而，变形持续期间会扎根原地，无法传送。

entries.english:
The scales of a quicksilver dragon. Although it does not provide its wearer
with as much protection as the scales of some heavier dragons, it is somewhat
lighter and less encumbering. The armour repels both attacks on the wearer's
willpower and magical modification of itself - it cannot be enchanted.
entries.translation: 水银龙的鳞片。它的防护不如某些更沉重的龙鳞，但稍轻，累赘也较少。它既能抵御针对佩戴者意志的攻击，也会排斥对自身的魔法改造，因此无法附魔。

entries.english: A ring that allows its wearer to see invisible things.
entries.translation: 一种能让佩戴者看见隐形事物的戒指。

issues.review: context_review:看见隐形事物的效果说明，不强制使用属性标题

entries.english:
A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It
offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or
spellcasting.
entries.translation: 一件用轻薄布料制成的宽松宽袖外袍。它对物理伤害的防护很弱，但不妨碍闪避或施法。

entries.english:
A wonderful scroll which causes the creation of a valuable item, with the
reader choosing from a small selection. The items offered will often be a
good match for the reader's skills; and if nothing recommends itself, the
reader can always choose a heap of gold.
entries.translation: 一种能创造贵重物品的奇妙卷轴，阅读者可以从少量选项中挑选。提供的物品通常很适合阅读者的技能；如果没有中意的物品，也总能选择一堆金币。

entries.english:
A scroll that places an enchantment on a piece of armour chosen by the reader.
Body armour and bardings can be enchanted up to the same value as their base
armour rating. Bucklers, kite shields and tower shields can be enchanted up to
+3, +5 or +8 respectively, and other armour can be enchanted up to +2. Magical
artefacts cannot be enchanted at all.
entries.translation: 一种能为阅读者选定的防具附魔的卷轴。躯干防具和腹甲的强化上限等于其基础护甲值。小圆盾、鸢盾和塔盾的强化上限分别为 +3、+5 和 +8，其他防具则为 +2。魔法神器完全无法附魔。

issues.review: context_review:shields 作保护动词或复数盾类，不是技能名称

entries.english:
A scroll that eliminates all sound near the reader. This makes reading scrolls,
casting spells, invoking divine abilities, or shouting impossible in the
reader's vicinity.

Certain monsters have innate magical or special abilities which will still be
usable while silenced.

The effect starts out with a large radius, which will then shrink, eventually
covering only the reader, before it times out.
entries.translation:
一种能消除阅读者附近所有声音的卷轴。在阅读者周围，任何生物都无法阅读卷轴、施放法术、调用神赐能力或喊叫。

某些怪物拥有天赋魔法或特殊能力，即使被沉默也依然能够使用。

效果起初范围很大，随后逐渐缩小，最终只覆盖阅读者自身，再完全消失。

entries.english:
A scroll that calls on the powers of darkness to inflict great pain on any
nearby creature — including the reader! This halves the resilience of all
living creatures and cuts down all holy creature resilence by about a third,
although it is never directly fatal.
entries.translation: 一种会召来黑暗力量、使附近生物遭受极大痛苦的卷轴，连阅读者也不例外！它会使所有活物的生命减半，使所有神圣生物的生命减少约三分之一，但绝不会直接致命。

entries.english:
A jade snake coiled around a fossilised egg. Transforms the wearer into an
amphisbaena - a legendary two-headed serpent. It is capable of wearing two
pieces of headgear at once and its powerful coils can wind around foes and crush
them to death, but its cold blood leaves it succeptible to being slowed by cold
attacks.
entries.translation: 一条盘绕在化石蛋上的玉蛇。它会把佩戴者变成传说中的双头蛇，能够同时佩戴两件头部装备，并以强大的身体缠住敌人，将其绞死。但冷血的身体容易被寒冷攻击减速。

entries.english:
A strange charm made from shed arachnid exoskeletons bound together with silk.
Transforms the wearer into an agile jumping spider who can move swiftly towards
foes and inflict grievous damage on any it catches unaware. It cannot be
ensnared by webs, but its attacks can ensnare its enemies in them. It can also
leap briskly away from many dangers.
entries.translation: 一件奇异的饰物，由蛛丝捆扎蜕下的蜘蛛外骨骼制成。它会把佩戴者变成敏捷的跳蛛，能迅速接近敌人，对毫无防备的目标造成重伤。它不会被蛛网困住，但攻击可以用蛛网缠住敌人。它也能敏捷地跳离许多危险。

entries.english:
A small chunk of dense but otherwise unremarkable natural mineral. It can be
thrown to cause minor damage.
entries.translation: 一小块致密而平凡的天然矿物，可以投掷以造成少量伤害。

entries.english:
Lightning trapped, impossibly, in a bottle. Lets the wearer walk through the air
as a raging, lightning-filled tempest. The wearer's melee attacks are electrified
and strike all adjacent foes. The wearer also flies, gains immunity to poison,
miasma, petrification, constriction, and sticky flame, and also resists
electricity. They can launch themselves as a lightning bolt, blasting through
everything in their way.
entries.translation: 一瓶以不可思议的方式封住的闪电。它让佩戴者化为充满雷电的狂暴风暴，在空中行走。佩戴者的近战攻击带有电力，并打击所有相邻敌人。佩戴者还能飞行，免疫毒素、瘴气、石化、缠绕和黏附火焰，并抵御电击。他们可以化作一道闪电飞出，轰穿沿途的一切。

issues.review: context_review:化作一道闪电的动作，不是闪电束法术

entries.english: A fishing spear improved with a longer shaft and a three-pronged metal head.
entries.translation: 一种改良鱼叉，杆更长，装有三齿金属叉头。

issues.review: context_review:fishing spear 指鱼叉，不是武器长矛

entries.english:
A magical device which fires a ray of searing light, injuring and blinding
those struck. Only living, undead, demonic and angelic monsters can be blinded,
and tougher monsters will recover their vision more quickly.
entries.translation: 一种能射出灼热光线、伤害并致盲命中者的魔法装置。只有活物、亡灵、恶魔和天使怪物能够被致盲；更强壮的怪物恢复视力更快。

entries.english:
A magical device which launches a psychic attack on a target creature. If it
overcomes their willpower, it 'blows their mind' in a violently literal fashion,
dealing damage that bypasses their armour entirely. It is useless against
mindless creatures.
entries.translation: 一种能对目标生物发动精神攻击的魔法装置。若克服了目标的意志，就会以极其直白而猛烈的方式“炸裂其心智”，造成完全无视护甲的伤害。对无心智的生物无效。

entries.english:
A magical device which fires a magical seed, entangling its target and adjacent
foes in quick-growing tree roots. Those entangled will be immobilised and take
damage over time until they escape or the roots wither away. The roots will only
sprout from solid ground.
entries.translation: 一种能射出魔法种子的魔法装置，以迅速生长的树根缠住目标及相邻敌人。被缠住者无法移动，并持续受到伤害，直到挣脱或树根枯萎。树根只能从坚实地面上长出。

entries.english:
This creature cannot move under its own power, but may still use translocations
or be forcibly displaced by someone else.
entries.translation: 这个生物无法自行移动，但仍可使用位移魔法，或被其他生物强行移位。

entries.english:
This monster has been called from a parallel reality. Killing it will grant no
experience points, but it will be immediately cast back to its original reality
as soon as the tesseract is destroyed.
entries.translation: 这个怪物从平行现实中被唤来。击杀它不会获得经验；一旦超立方体被摧毁，它就会立即被送回原来的现实。

entries.english:
This formerly-friendly creature has been charmed by another creature to join their
side. If you slay the source of this charm, it will regain its senses.
entries.translation: 这个原本友善的生物受到另一生物的魅惑，加入了对方阵营。杀死魅惑来源后，它会恢复神志。

entries.english:
This creature is unable to evade attacks or turn invisible. If it dies, it will leave
behind a cloud of magnetised fragments.

Each time Magnavolt is cast, a beam of electricity will automatically be fired at this
creature.
entries.translation:
这个生物无法躲避攻击或隐形。它死亡后会留下磁化碎片云。

每次施放 巨磁电涌，都会自动向它射出一道闪电束。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
This creature has been afflicted with illusory wounds by a flayed ghost. These wounds
will disappear with time or when the flayed ghost is destroyed.
entries.translation: 剥皮鬼在这个生物身上造成了幻觉伤口。伤口会随时间消失，或在剥皮鬼被摧毁时消失。

entries.english:
This creature is stuck in liquefied ground, causing it to move more slowly and also
fumble 25% of the melee attacks it makes.
entries.translation: 这个生物陷在液化地面中，移动更慢，且有 25% 的近战攻击会失手。

entries.english:
This creature has glows with the perfection of their best self. They deal 100%
more damage with melee attacks, have additional AC, and cast spells with
substantially more strength.
entries.translation: 这个生物焕发出理想自我的完美光辉。近战伤害提高 100%，护甲值增加，施放的法术也强大得多。

entries.english:
This creature has been roused into great speed by the wrath of Gozag Ym Sagoz.
Their haste or berserk state is permanent and will not wear off with time
or through deliberate magical intervention.
entries.translation: 哥萨戈的怒火使这个生物行动神速。它的加速或狂暴状态是永久的，不会随时间消退，也无法通过魔法手段消除。

entries.english:
This creature has been magically vexed and is forced to attack a random adjacent
space each turn instead of performing any other actions. It is more likely to
attack a space containing a creature than an empty one, but will attack its own
allies as readily as its enemies.
entries.translation: 这个生物受到魔法烦扰，每回合被迫攻击随机相邻格，无法执行其他动作。它更可能攻击有生物的格子，而不是空格，但攻击盟友和敌人的意愿完全相同。

entries.english:
This creature has built up part of the charge it needs to cast a spell or
activate an ability.
entries.translation: 这个生物已经积蓄了施法或发动能力所需的部分能量。

entries.english:
This creature will soon become fully petrified. Its movement and actions are
50% slower and it is nearly unable to dodge attacks, though it also takes 33%
less damage.

[[low-tier stab monstatus]]
entries.translation:
这个生物即将完全石化。移动和行动速度降低 50%，几乎无法闪避攻击，但受到的伤害也减少 33%。

[[low-tier stab monstatus]]

entries.english:
This creature is surrounded by a field of unnatural silence which eliminates
all noise made within it as well as preventing the vocalisations required for
many creatures (including you) to read scrolls, cast spells, or invoke divine
aid.

If this effect was caused by a spell, the radius of the field will shrink over
time.
entries.translation:
这个生物周围环绕着超自然的静默领域。领域内所有声音都会消失，也无法进行许多生物（包括你）阅读卷轴、施放法术或祈求神助所需的发声。

若此效果由法术造成，领域半径会随时间缩小。

entries.english: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]
entries.translation: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]

entries.english: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]
entries.translation: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]

entries.english: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]
entries.translation: [[sharing its pain monstatus]]

entries.english:
This creature is engulfed in a field of unnatural silence, preventing any noise
it might make, including the vocalisations required for many creatures to cast
spells.
entries.translation: 这个生物被超自然的静默领域笼罩，无法发出任何声音，包括许多生物施法所需的吟诵。

issues.review: context_review:情态动词、匹敌或普通力量描述，不是强力状态

entries.english: This creature will take minor damage whenever it moves.
entries.translation: 这个生物每次移动都会受到少量伤害。

entries.english:
This creature's soul will be bound in service to you once they die, though
allowing them to stray from your line of sight for more than a brief moment
will cause you to lose your grasp on it.
entries.translation: 这个生物死后，灵魂会受你束缚并为你效力。但若让它离开你的视野稍久，你就会失去对其灵魂的掌握。

entries.english: This creature's spells are strengthened and it will cast them more frequently.
entries.translation: 这个生物的法术得到强化，施法也更加频繁。

entries.english:
This creature has contributed to the death of one of your apostles. Defeating all
targets of orcish vengeance will significantly speed up the time it takes for
Beogh to resurrect your apostles.
entries.translation: 这个生物参与了杀害你的一位使徒。击败所有兽人复仇目标，将显著缩短比欧弗复活你的使徒所需的时间。

entries.english:
This creature is unable to breathe and cannot cast spells or invoke divine aid.
It also takes minor asphyxiation damage every turn.
entries.translation: 这个生物无法呼吸，不能施放法术或祈求神助，每回合还会受到少量窒息伤害。

entries.english:
Despite being engulfed in unnatural silence, this creature's magic does not
require vocalisations and thus is unaffected.
entries.translation: 虽然被超自然的静默笼罩，但这个生物的魔法无需发声，因此不受影响。

entries.english: This creature provides no experience or piety when slain.
entries.translation: 击杀这个生物不会获得经验或虔诚。

entries.english:
A common dungeon snake, a species of troglodytic reptile commonly found in
subterranean spaces.
entries.translation: 一条普通的地下城蛇，它是一种在地下常见的穴居爬行类动物。

entries.english:
A self-styled monarch of a shambling black alder, half respected and half
ridiculed by other fae. It backs up its aspirations to sovereignty with
unearthly vile magic quite close to a touch of death.
entries.translation: 一株蹒跚黑桤木，自封君王，受到其他精怪半是尊重、半是嘲笑。为了支撑自己的王权野心，它运用几乎如死亡之触般邪恶的异世魔法。

entries.english:
Amaemon always knew he was different, but it was still a horrific surprise when
his demonic heritage manifested. As his body twisted, Amaemon was forced to flee
far from the surface. The passage of time has only left him more obsessed with
what he has lost - consumed by poison both physical and spiritual.
entries.translation: 阿玛埃蒙一直知道自己与众不同，但恶魔血统显现时，仍令他惊骇万分。身体开始扭曲后，他被迫逃离地表。岁月只让他愈加执着于失去的一切，肉体与心灵都被毒素吞噬。

issues.review: context_review:穿行、时间流逝或出口语境，不强制使用通道

entries.english:
A very large snake that moves with startling swiftness. It kills not by poison
but by constricting its prey.
entries.translation: 一条非常大的蛇，移动速度惊人。它不是通过毒液而是通过束缚猎物进行猎杀。

issues.review: context_review:普通速度描述或迅捷效果，保留上下文表达

entries.english:
A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though
perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still
they seem somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past.
The memory and the memorialist fight in concert, each able to fire past the
other.
entries.translation: 一个由无实体记忆构成的人形造物，漂浮在空中。虽然外形或许有些改变，且少有可辨特征，仍依稀像一位来自遥远记忆的战士。记忆与追忆者并肩作战，双方都能让飞射物穿过彼此。

entries.english:
A divine warrior of the Shining One. It is a towering winged figure of
unnatural beauty surrounded by an aura of brilliant white light.
entries.translation: 光明神的神圣战士。它身形高大、背生双翼，拥有超凡之美，周围环绕着明亮白光。

entries.english:
Once a hero among the titans, Antaeus grew jealous of the titan queen. In
single combat he challenged and slew her, and for this crime he was exiled and
descended into the Hells. Finding the inhabitants of that place no match for his
might, Antaeus tore from its substance a fourth Hell, Cocytus, a realm born of
frozen spite.
entries.translation:
安泰俄斯曾经是泰坦中的英雄，但他嫉妒泰坦女王。
在一次战斗中，他发起挑战并杀死了她，因此随后被流放到了地狱。
安泰俄斯发现栖息在那个地方的生灵无法与他匹敌，
于是他从其实质上撕开了第四层地狱——悲叹河，一个由冰冻和怨恨而生的领域。

issues.review: context_review:情态动词、匹敌或普通力量描述，不是强力状态

entries.english:
An opalescent crab with jet black eyes, and chaotic mists effusing from its
mandibles. Rumours claim that this species is waiting for the end of time.
entries.translation:
一个乳白色的螃蟹，长有黑玉般的眼睛，口器散发着迷雾。
传言称，这个物种在等待着时间的终结。

entries.english:
Once a talented human weaver, Arachne was transformed into a monstrous
half-spider by a jealous rival's curse. Driven out of her village, she found
sanctuary for a time among the jorogumo before a bitter feud forced her to
flee once more.

Now she wanders other corners of the dungeon with a small retinue of loyal
students in tow, seeking a new domain in which they can spin their peerless
tapestries in peace.
entries.translation:
阿拉克涅曾是才华横溢的人类织工，被嫉妒她的对手诅咒，变成半蜘蛛怪物。被村庄赶走后，她曾在络新妇中暂得庇护，却又因一场激烈纷争被迫逃亡。

如今，她带着少数忠心学生游荡于地下城其他角落，寻找新的领地，好让她们安宁地织造无与伦比的挂毯。

entries.english:
The divided and churning remains of a protean progenitor, striving desperately
for form. Whatever they become, the last of their progenitor's power ensure it
will be stronger and swifter than any such creature found elsewhere in the
dungeon.
entries.translation:
一个万变始祖的分裂、搅动的遗骸，竭力变化着形态。无论它们变成什么，
它们祖先的最后力量将确保它比任何在地下城其他地方碰到的那种生物更强、更快。

entries.english:
One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. It is a
horrendous imitation of the human form, consisting of an unrecognisable mass of
meat stitched together with limbs sewn on seemingly at random. Its skin hangs
off loosely in some places and bulges repulsively in others. Each one bears a
large symbol carved into its flesh, a mark of pride from its twisted creator.
entries.translation:
由肉雕师制造的憎恶军团中的一员。
这是一件可怕的人形仿制品，由一大堆无法辨认的肉连在一起，
肢体似乎随意缝在上面。在有些地方它的皮肤松弛下垂，有些地方则臃肿地隆起。
每个都有着一个刻在其肉里的巨大符号，这是其性格扭曲的创造者的骄傲的象征。

entries.english:
A lumpy reddish fungus covered in knobbly rhizome growths, growing well in the
dank underground dungeon. When it senses a threat, the ballistomycete may
release a deadly floating spore that explodes on its victims.
entries.translation:
一种块状淡红色真菌，覆有多节的根瘤，在阴湿的地下城中生长良好。
当它受到威胁时，可能会产生飘浮着的致命孢子，这会在受害者身上爆炸。

issues.review: context_review:前文真菌的指代，名称由独立怪物名映射提供

entries.english: A crested lizard of middling size with a terrible petrifying gaze.
entries.translation: 一个中等大小、有羽冠的蜥蜴，有着可怕的石化凝视。

entries.english:
A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though
perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still
it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past,
skilled with both conjurations and melee combat.
entries.translation: 一个由无实体记忆构成的人形造物，漂浮在空中。虽然外形或许有些改变，且少有可辨特征，仍依稀像一位来自遥远记忆、兼擅塑能系魔法与近战的战士。

entries.english:
A minor hairy maggot spirit, phasing in and out of this plane. Each regional
variant inflicts different minor ailments: the ones found in the Dungeon
cause one's magic to grow weak.
entries.translation: 一只毛茸茸的微小蛆虫精灵，在此位面中时隐时现。不同地区的变种会引发不同小病；地下城中的这一种会削弱人的魔法。

entries.english:
A volatile elemental spark encased in a shell of slag iron. If destroyed while
its fires still blaze, the exposed core will violently detonate a moment later.
entries.translation:
它的渣铁外壳包裹着不稳定的元素火花。
如果它在其火焰仍在燃烧时被摧毁，暴露的核心将在片刻后剧烈爆炸。

entries.english:
A species of frog that possesses the ability to blink at will. It can blink
itself close to its intended prey, or blink away to escape harm. It is commonly
found in packs.
entries.translation:
一种能自行闪现的大型蛙。
它既可以通过闪现来接近猎物，也可以利用闪现来逃脱伤害。这种蛙经常成群行动。

issues.review: context_review:闪现逃脱或闪烁离开的动作，不强制套用法术名

entries.english: A block of ice shaped like a statue, but worked by no living hands.
entries.translation: 这块冰像个雕塑，但并非人工所造。

issues.review: context_review:这块冰的指代，名称由独立怪物名映射提供

entries.english:
A mighty undead abomination, pieced together from the broken bones of many
dragons by powerful necromantic magic. The collective despair of such
desecrated dragons gives this horror its own undying breath weapon, in
billowing clouds of excruciating misery.
entries.translation: 一个由强大死灵魔法将众多龙的碎骨拼成的强大亡灵怪物。被亵渎之龙共同的绝望，赋予它不朽的吐息武器：翻滚的云雾，带来难以忍受的痛苦。

entries.english:
An ancient and powerful lich. Like all true liches, Boris is immortal, and will
regenerate his desiccated skeletal remains even if completely disintegrated.
The same cannot be said for his many victims over his many centuries, from
which he collects and channels their dying woes and regrets.
entries.translation:
一个强大的远古巫妖。和所有真正的巫妖一样，
鲍里斯是不朽的，即使被完全解离得只剩骨灰也能复生。
但对于几个世纪里他的那些受害者而言却并非如此，
在这些岁月中，他收集、引导着受害者临终的痛苦和遗憾。

entries.english:
A large, brightly coloured butterfly with beautifully patterned wings,
fluttering incongruously through the darkness of the cave.
entries.translation:
一只亮丽的大蝴蝶，翅膀上有着漂亮的图案，
它飞舞的身影在这黑暗的洞窟中显得很不协调。

entries.english:
A maniacal demon, brimming with accursed power. Its gleeful laughter rarely
ceases, even in the heat of battle.
entries.translation: 一只疯癫的恶魔，体内充满诅咒之力。即使激战正酣，它欢快的笑声也很少停歇。

entries.english:
As a young woman, Cassandra bound herself in service to Ashenzari and was
blessed and cursed in equal measure - granted the ability to foresee disasters,
but only those she was powerless to prevent.

Eventually driven from her homeland as a harbinger of the very plagues she'd
spent a lifetime warning against, she has come to the dungeon in her final days
in hope of averting one last catastrophe.
entries.translation:
卡珊德拉年轻时便立誓侍奉艾申扎利，所得祝福与诅咒同样深重：她能预见灾难，却只能预见自己无力阻止的灾难。

她一生都在警告世人提防瘟疫，最终却被当作瘟疫的先兆逐出故乡。在生命最后的日子里，她来到地下城，希望能阻止最后一场浩劫。

entries.english:
A hybrid with the torso of a human atop the body of a horse. It is highly
skilled in archery.
entries.translation: 一个混种生物，在马的身体上有着人的躯干。其箭术很高超。

entries.english:
A violent and wrathful demon, Cerebov appears as a giant humanoid covered in
shining golden armour and wielding a huge twisted sword.
entries.translation:
瑟雷波夫是一个残暴易怒的恶魔。
他有一个巨大的人形身躯，身穿黄金铠甲，手持一把扭曲的巨剑。

entries.english:
A small, wilful minor demon. Its wings, far larger than its scrawny body, were
made to soar, and it lands only rarely and with the greatest reluctance.
entries.translation:
一个矮小、任性的低阶恶魔。它的翅膀比它那瘦骨嶙峋的身体要大得多，
生来就是为了飞翔。它也很少、很不情愿着陆。

entries.english:
A strange wizard who has attained mastery over clouds, making deft and
foreboding mystic gestures.
entries.translation:
这位奇怪的法师已经掌握了云雾的奥秘，
他的施法的神秘手势不仅娴熟而且还给人一种威压感。

entries.english:
A wizened, headless corpse, animated not by conventional necromancy but by the
mournful malice of dead stars. Its psychic eyes, floating disjointedly from its
body's movements, relentlessly burrow through its victims' minds.
entries.translation: 一具干瘪无头的尸体，并非由通常的死灵魔法驱动，而是由死去恒星悲哀的恶意驱动。它的灵能眼睛独立于身体动作漂浮，执拗地钻入受害者心智。

entries.english:
A statue able to harness the mightiest of pure conjurations ever devised by
Iskenderun.
entries.translation: 一尊能驾驭伊斯肯德伦所发明的最强大纯粹塑能系法术的雕像。

entries.english:
A small, ugly minor demon. Its fanged maw seems locked in a permanent malign
grin, and its horns protrude obscenely from its scaly pate.
entries.translation:
一个矮小、丑陋的低阶恶魔。它那长满尖牙的嘴似乎永远保持着一副恶意的咧嘴笑，
它的角从有鳞的脑袋里可憎地突出来。

entries.english:
A giant with one eye in the centre of its forehead. Despite its lack of
binocular vision, it is able to throw boulders with fearsome accuracy.
entries.translation:
这个巨人的额头正中长着一只眼睛。
虽然独眼巨人只有一只眼视物，但他投出的石块命中率却很高。

issues.review: context_review:投出或发射动作，允许自然语序

entries.english:
A dark and baleful minor dragon. It breathes a lethally potent miasma from its
pestilential maw.
entries.translation: 一条阴暗邪恶的亚龙，能从散播瘟疫的巨口中吐出致命的浓烈瘴气。

issues.review: context_review:低阶恶魔、亚龙等语境，不是次级法术前缀

entries.english: A warrior-priest of Yredelemnul, chanting fearful supplications to its dark god.
entries.translation: 一个伊莱德莱姆努尔的战斗祭司，向黑暗之神吟诵着可怕的祈求。

entries.english:
A noxious and deadly fungus suffused with negative energy. While parasitic in
life, undeath has granted it the ability to absorb its nutrients directly from
the life force of others.
entries.translation: 一种充满负能量的剧毒真菌。生前依靠寄生，化为亡灵后，则能直接从其他生物的生命力中汲取营养。

entries.english:
A deep elf surrounded by a shimmering aura of negative energy, as a result of
its practice of necromancy and life-sapping magic.
entries.translation:
一个地底精灵，被闪烁的负能量光环所环绕，
这是他练习死灵术和衰竭生命力的魔法的结果。

entries.english:
A deep elf commanding the primal forces of the universe. It is renowned for its
ability to pin down even the most elusive foes with powerful, unavoidable magic.
entries.translation:
一个支配宇宙原始力量的地底精灵。即使再难以捉摸的敌人，
他也能用强大的、不可回避的魔法进行牵制和锁定，他也因此而闻名。

entries.english:
A hellish insectoid creature, fueled by some infernal power that constantly
regrows its chitinous segments. Nothing short of a lethal blow will stop it
for long.
entries.translation:
一个地狱的昆虫类生物，由某种地狱般的力量刺激着，不断代谢着它的壳节。
除非是致命的一击，否则没有什么能长久地阻挡它。

entries.english:
A half-mortal, half-demonic creature, oozing with dark energies. It twists
space around itself, and can corrupt weapons, armour and even the very flesh of
its opponents.
entries.translation:
一个半人半魔的生物，散发着黑暗能量。
他扭曲了自身周围的空间，可以腐蚀武器、盔甲甚至对方的血肉。

issues.review: context_review:腐蚀对手物品和血肉的普通动作描述

entries.english:
The destroyers begin to descend upon you. They come in numbers and with wrath,
maws gaping like abaddon, bottomless and abyssal. They bring your doom and will
feast on your remains.
entries.translation: 毁灭者开始向你降临。它们成群而来，满怀怒火，巨口张开如毁灭之渊，深不见底。它们带来你的末日，并将饱食你的遗骸。

entries.english: <wolf spider>
entries.translation: <wolf spider>

entries.english:
{{
    local descript = "An adventurer just like you, trying to find the Orb."

    if you.race() ~= "Merfolk" and you.race() ~= "Octopode" then
        descript = descript .. " Unlike you, and d"
    else
        descript = descript .. " D"
    end

    descript = descript .. "espite his hatred of it, he takes to water " ..
                           "like a fowl."

    return descript
}}
entries.translation:
{{
    local descript = "一个和你一样寻找宝珠的冒险者。"

    if you.race() ~= "Merfolk" and you.race() ~= "Octopode" then
        descript = descript .. "与你不同，尽管"
    else
        descript = descript .. "尽管"
    end

    descript = descript .. "他厌恶水，却能在水中" ..
                           "像水禽一样自如。"

    return descript
}}

entries.english:
A drowsy, fluffy ovine whose coat sparkles with motes of dream dust. It gathers
in herds and fills the air with dream dust, overwhelming its victims and
putting them to sleep.
entries.translation:
一只睡意朦胧、毛绒绒的绵羊，毛上闪耀着梦尘。
它们成群聚在一起，让空气中充满了梦尘。梦尘覆盖在受害者身上，使之陷入沉睡。

entries.english:
A cold and hollow apparition of the drowned dead, chained by some lingering
attachment to the depths in which it perished. It rushes to embrace the living,
sharing the last moments of its watery fate with whatever it touches.
entries.translation:
一个冰冷、空洞的溺死者的亡灵，被某种挥之不去的情感束缚在它死去的深渊中。
它冲过去抱住生者，
要让接触到的任何人也品尝到它生命的最后一刻淹在水里的滋味。

entries.english:
A spirit of nature, bound to the forest in which it resides. It is capable of
calling upon the trees to defend against incursions.
entries.translation: 一个自然之灵，与栖息的森林紧密相连。她能够召唤树木以抵御入侵。

entries.english:
An immense, squamous appendage of some unseen creature, dripping with ichor and
tipped with a single, terrible-looking claw.
entries.translation:
这条巨大、多鳞的肢体属于某个看不见的生物，败液从上面滴落，
在肢体的末端还长有一个骇人的爪子。

entries.english:
Greatest and most inexorable of the Lords of Hell, Ereshkigal was born when
first a mortal breathed her last. Noiselessly she laughs at lives cut short and
loved ones separated by untimely death, enwreathed in the silence of the grave.
entries.translation: 埃列什基伽勒是最伟大、最不可违抗的地狱领主，诞生于第一位凡人咽下最后一口气息之时。她笼罩在坟墓般的寂静中，无声嘲笑那些夭折的生命，以及因横死而永远分离的亲人。

entries.english:
A hybrid with the torso of a human atop the forelegs of a goat. It is fabled
for its ability to play with the minds of those who intrude into its domain.
entries.translation:
一个混种生物，在山羊的前腿上有着人的躯干。
传说中，他能够玩弄闯入其领地的生物的心灵。

entries.english:
Followers of the ancient swamp ways, these witches rise above the muck and mire
on a pair of stilt-like chicken legs. They are masters of pain and poison.
entries.translation:
这些女巫践行着古代的沼泽道路，她们踩着一双高跷状的鸡腿越过淤泥和泥沼。
她们是痛楚和毒药大师。

entries.english:
A variety of crab prized for its brilliantly jewelled shell. The rarity of the
shells is only enhanced by its almost supernatural ability to wade through
molten lava and expel massive quantities of flames.
entries.translation: 一种因璀璨宝石外壳而备受珍视的螃蟹。它近乎超自然地能够跋涉熔岩、喷出大量火焰，这让能取得的甲壳更加稀少。

entries.english:
A great reptilian beast with powerful claws on its limbs, covered in thick
red scales and with two huge bat-like wings. Little trails of smoke spill
from its toothy maw.
entries.translation:
一条巨大的爬行类野兽，四肢上有强力的爪子，覆盖着厚厚的红色鳞片，
长有两只巨大的蝠翼形翅膀。它那长满利牙的口中冒出几缕烟雾。

entries.english:
An ornately worked statue of an orc holding a torch aloft, hewn from black
basalt. The air around it shimmers.
entries.translation: 一尊由黑色玄武岩雕成的华丽兽人像，高举着火炬。周围空气微微晃动。

entries.english: A swirling cloud of flame. After striking a foe, it disintegrates.
entries.translation: 一团旋转的火焰云。击中敌人后，它会解体。

entries.english:
A hideous floating undead creature, the anguished spirit of a tortured victim,
with torn skin hanging from an emaciated body. It restlessly stalks the
dungeon, inflicting the anguish it felt in life upon those still living.
entries.translation:
一个丑陋、飘浮着的亡灵。
它是饱受折磨的受害者的苦痛灵魂，瘦骨嶙峋的身体上垂着撕裂的皮肤。
它不停在地下城中搜寻着，想把它受到痛苦强加给那些还活着的人。

issues.review: context_review:普通痛苦描述，不是法术名称

entries.english:
A thin wisp of flaming swamp gas. It will burn the first hostile thing it
touches and then dissipate.
entries.translation: 一缕燃烧的稀薄沼气，烧伤接触到的第一个敌对目标后便会消散。

issues.review: context_review:沼气或沼泽污泥，不是沼泽分支

entries.english:
A stout warrior who once bested a powerful lord of Pandemonium in combat,
gaining control over the demon's realm and thanes. The battle left her with a
deep facial scar, one that she carries as a badge of honour rather than a
symbol of shame.
entries.translation: 一位壮实的战士，曾在战斗中击败强大的魔窟领主，夺得其领地与部属的控制权。那场战斗在她脸上留下深深的伤疤，她将其视为荣誉勋章，而非耻辱印记。

entries.english:
A svelte fighter-mage with a gold-rimmed monocle, a keen sense of tradition,
and the blood of the gods running through his veins. He's here looking for a
worthy opponent, but he's yet to find one.
entries.translation:
一个身材苗条的战斗法师，戴着金边单片眼镜，有着强烈的传统观念，
血脉中流淌着众神的血。他正在寻找一个值得重视的对手，但还没有找到一个。

issues.review: context_review:战斗法师的复合职业，不是战士背景名

entries.english:
A friendly monster whose presence has been {{
    if you.god() == "Ashenzari" then
        return "revealed by the power of Ashenzari"
    else
        return "detected"
    end
}}.
entries.translation:
一个友好的怪物，其存在已被{{
    if you.god() == "Ashenzari" then
        return "艾申扎利的力量所揭示"
    else
        return "察觉"
    end
}}。

entries.english:
A voracious and surprisingly intelligent slug, devoted to eating everything and
everyone he comes across, with a pointed hat perched rakishly atop his head. He
acquired the hat the same way he acquired his intelligence and his knowledge of
spells: by consuming their former owner, a powerful wizard.
entries.translation:
一条贪婪且出奇聪明的蛞蝓，它会吃掉它遇到的所有人和物，
头上放荡地顶着一个尖帽子。他获得帽子与获得智慧和法术知识的方式相同：
吃掉帽子的前主人——一个强大的巫师。

entries.english:
A vile interdimensional predator that feeds on the life force of living beings.
It resembles an enormous, spiny moth.
entries.translation:
一只穿梭在次元间的邪恶捕食者，以活物的生命力为食。
它看起来像是一只巨大的、长刺的飞蛾。

entries.english:
A decayed cadaver, reanimated and accursed with a terrible hunger. It desires
nothing but to feed on the flesh of the living, and will fell its victims with
its vicious claws.
entries.translation:
一具活过来的腐烂的尸体，被极度的饥饿所诅咒。
它只想以活人的肉为食，并会用其恶毒的爪子击倒受害者。

entries.english: A shadowy figure clothed in profound darkness.
entries.translation: 一个被深邃黑暗笼罩中的身影。

entries.english:
A huge pulsating brain, floating just off the floor and glowing with mutagenic
energies. It radiates a constant psychic influence upon nearby allies, using its
vast intellect to empower their spellcasting abilities.
entries.translation: 一个巨大的搏动大脑，悬浮在离地不远处，闪耀着致变异能量。它持续向附近盟友施加精神影响，用广博智慧增强它们的施法能力。

issues.expected: 地面/楼层/地板/向下取整
issues.review: context_review:地板、楼层或 Lua math.floor 函数，按语境区分

entries.english:
A shapeshifter which has lost control over its transformations, and is
constantly changing form.
entries.translation: 这个变形者已经失去了对变形的控制能力，在不断地变换形态。

entries.english:
A gnoll witch possessed by a spirit of spite which flashes out from behind
their eyes. Its strange chants and ululations send other gnolls into a wild
frenzy.
entries.translation:
一个被怨灵附身的豺狼人女巫，怨灵在其眼后闪现。
它那奇怪的吟唱和呼喊能让其他豺狼人陷入疯狂。

issues.review: context_review:疯狂或狂暴描述，按具体效果表述

entries.english: <master elementalist>
entries.translation: <master elementalist>

entries.english:
A mighty spirit drawn from the elemental plane of air, surrounded by a
deadly vortex of frost.
entries.translation: 一个来自气元素位面的强大灵体，周围环绕着致命的冰霜旋涡。

issues.review: context_review:涡旋或旋涡的物理描述，不是完整法术名

entries.english: <great orb of eyes>
entries.translation: <great orb of eyes>

entries.english: An ancient warrior, embalmed and cursed to walk in undeath for eternity.
entries.translation: 一个远古的战士，其尸体被防腐处理，被诅咒永远以死者之躯行走在世上。

entries.english:
A middle-aged bounty hunter, anxious to retire after one final job. He hopes to
settle down somewhere and live a quiet life with his family, using the money
from his final bounty: you.
entries.translation: 一位中年赏金猎人，急着做完最后一单便退休。他希望用最后一笔赏金——也就是你——找个地方安家，与家人过上平静生活。

entries.english:
A bird-like creature with a human face that roams the coasts endlessly, feared
for its sharp claws and harrying strikes.
entries.translation: 一个长有人脸的鸟状生物，无休止地在海岸上飞荡，要当心她的利爪和扑打。

entries.english:
A powerful warrior-mage who instructs aspiring students in physical, magical,
and anti-magical combat.
entries.translation: 一位强大的战斗法师，指导有抱负的学生进行物理、魔法和反魔法战斗。

entries.english:
A heavily armoured warrior, in league with the powers of Hell, and usually
accompanied by other unsavoury beings of its ilk.
entries.translation: 一名身着重甲的战士，与地狱力量结盟，经常与其他令人作呕的家伙集群行动。

entries.english:
A unusually large rat. Its weird, knobbly orange skin glows with the infernal
energies that spawned it.
entries.translation: 一只特别大的老鼠。它那怪异的、长满疙瘩的橙色表皮散发着孕育它的地狱能量。

entries.english:
A towering monolith constructed and possessed by demonic forces. A thousand
eyes leer through slits in its jagged, spiked armour.
entries.translation:
一块巨大的雕像，由恶魔力量构造和控制。
千只眼睛透过它那凹凸不平、长满尖刺的铠甲的缝隙窥视着。

entries.english:
A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though
perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still
it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past,
ready with debilitating spells and deadly knifework.
entries.translation: 一个由无实体记忆构成的人形造物，漂浮在空中。虽然外形或许有些改变，且少有可辨特征，仍依稀像一位来自遥远记忆的战士，随时准备用衰弱法术与致命刀法作战。

entries.english:
A large creature with the hindquarters of a horse and the wings, head and
talons of a great eagle. As popular heraldric creatures, some fortresses may
keep them as symbols and defenders alike, where they in turn launch intruders
into the waiting blades of their masters.
entries.translation: 一种大型生物，后躯如马，翅膀、头和利爪则如巨鹰。它们是流行的纹章形象，一些堡垒将其作为象征和守卫饲养。它们会把入侵者抛向主人等候的刀刃。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
While a mortal cannot turn into a demon aside from divine intervention, this is
what happened to Ignacio after Makhleb saw his love for his job and smiled upon
him. He is now slated to continue the joy of his life for all eternity.

Although his new form includes a number of large razor-sharp blades growing
from his demonic appendages, he kept his favourite axe and is eager to let you
test its edge.
entries.translation:
若是没有神明的介入，凡人是不可能变为恶魔的。
当马科列布看到伊格纳西欧对他的工作的热爱并对他微笑后，
伊格纳西奥身上就发生了这样的事情。现在他将永远继续他一生的乐趣了。

尽管他的新形态有着从恶魔附肢长出的大量锋利的刀片，
但他还是保留了他最喜欢的斧头，并想用你来测试它的锋利程度。

entries.english:
A deadly merfolk water-witch, who uses her dominion over the tides to draw
unwitting adventurers to their deaths.
entries.translation: 一个致命的人鱼水系女巫，她会驾御潮水将没有察觉到危险的冒险者引向死亡。

entries.english:
A warrior initiated in the mysteries of a dying cult, dedicated to serve
thrones long-fallen. Its blows strip away magical defences, leaving its foes
vulnerable to even the simplest hexes.
entries.translation: 一个受教于衰亡教派奥秘的战士，仍侍奉早已倾覆的王座。其攻击能剥去魔法防御，让敌人连最简单的妖术都难以抵挡。

entries.english:
A very heavy, slow and apparently flightless dragon. It is named for its
scales, which are so tough they might be iron. Small flakes of metal trail from
its nostrils.
entries.translation:
这条龙非常沉重、迟缓，而且似乎不会飞。
它因其鳞片而得名，鳞片坚韧得像铁一样。铁屑从它的鼻孔中飞出。

entries.english:
A huge, rusting monolith, larger than any other species of giant. It packs
an incredible punch.
entries.translation: 一个生锈的巨像，比其他任何各类的巨人都要大。他有着惊人的冲击力。

entries.english: An ugly, twisted little minor demon with metal skin.
entries.translation: 一个丑陋、扭曲的低阶恶魔，长有钢铁皮肤。

issues.review: context_review:低阶恶魔、亚龙等语境，不是次级法术前缀

entries.english:
A guardian mage clad in pattern-etched armour. It can recite words of power
to summon distant allies and imbue them with unnatural might.
entries.translation: 一个身披蚀纹防具的守卫法师，能吟诵真言，将远处盟友召来，并赋予它们超自然的力量。

issues.review: context_review:吟诵或诵读动作，不强制套用能力标题

entries.english:
An emaciated warrior-mage, bound to guard long-coveted treasures. It calls
forth deadly frost from its surrounds, freezing foes that are next to walls.
entries.translation:
一个憔悴的战斗法师，致力于守护渴望已久的宝藏。
他会从周围召唤出致命的冰霜，冻结靠近墙边的敌人。

entries.english:
Jeremiah was a peaceful dreamer, prone to impromptu naps. They slipped into
slumber while gazing into a magical orb, and dreamed of an old and hateful
power binding them into service. Now Jeremiah stumbles through the dungeon,
searching for the precious dreamshard that will restore their master’s power,
unsure whether they wake or slumber still. Their dreams leak into reality in
the form of a constant stream of butterflies.
entries.translation:
耶利米是一个爱好和平的神游者，时常随兴打盹。
他们凝视着一个神秘的水晶球进入睡眠，
梦到有一种古老而可恨的力量把他们束缚在侍奉上。
现在耶利米跌跌撞撞地穿过地下城，寻找珍贵的、能恢复主人力量的梦碎片，
但不确定他们是醒着还是在沉睡。他们的梦以源源不断的蝴蝶流的形式渗入现实。

entries.english:
A formidable necromancer, committed to her craft even after it left her aged,
decaying, and half-undead herself.
entries.translation:
一位令人敬畏的死灵法师，
即使在她年老、腐朽、半死不活的情况下仍致力于她的技艺。

entries.english: A giant bee, bearing a deadly barb which can sting repeatedly.
entries.translation: 一只巨型的蜂，长着致命的倒刺，可以反复刺叮。

entries.english:
A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though
perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still
it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past,
well equipped with arms and armour both.
entries.translation: 一个由无实体记忆构成的人形造物，漂浮在空中。虽然外形或许有些改变，且少有可辨特征，仍依稀像一位来自遥远记忆的战士，武器和防具都装备精良。

entries.english:
A skull-masked kobold, its body mutated by forbidden magics. It conducts vile
experiments in the service of demonic powers, formulating ever more terrible
monstrosities as vessels for devilish minds.
entries.translation: 一个戴着头骨面具、身体被禁忌魔法改变的狗头人。它为恶魔势力进行邪恶试验，制造越来越可怕的怪物，作为恶魔心智的容器。

entries.english:
One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Its
bloated hulk pulsates and throbs constantly with accursed fires. It looks as if
it could explode into a torrent of viscera at any moment.
entries.translation:
由肉雕师制造的憎恶军团中的一员。它那肿胀的身躯随着诅咒的火焰不停悸动着。
它似乎随时都有可能爆成内脏的洪流。

entries.english:
An accursed soul magically bound to hellish servitude for the highest bidder.
If its master is slain, it will be freed, departing this realm with gratitude.
entries.translation:
一个被诅咒的灵魂，被魔法束缚在地狱般的奴役之下，会为最高出价者而战。
如果它的主人被杀，它将得到自由，带着感激离开这个世界。

entries.english:
The echo of an unmourned soul. Though the memories of its living self are
long-faded, it is drawn to the moment of death by some lingering instinct. It
seizes upon the passage of other souls, losing the last vestiges of its being
in the memories of another's life.
entries.translation:
一个无人哀悼的灵魂的回音。尽管它自己生前的记忆已经褪去很久了，
但还是被某种弥留的本能拉到了死亡的那一刻。
它夺取他人灵魂的旅程，在别人生命的记忆中失去了自己存在的最后一丝痕迹。

issues.review: context_review:穿行、时间流逝或出口语境，不强制使用通道

entries.english:
A mighty sorceress, clad from head to toe in heavy armour. Once an adventurer
looking for the fabled Orb of Zot, she was cast into the Abyss and got
hopelessly lost there. Toyed with by some greater power, she was stuck on the
hostile plane for nearly a decade. When she finally emerged from the Abyss,
Louise had become powerful indeed, but had also gone fully insane. She now
wanders the halls of the dungeon, seeking other adventurers to share her fate.
entries.translation:
一个强大的女术师，用重甲全副武装。
她曾经是一个寻找传说中的佐特宝珠的冒险者，但却在途中被打入无尽深渊。
她被某个强大的存在玩弄着，被困在那个充满敌意的位面中长达十年之久。
在最终逃离深渊的时候，路易丝变得极为强大，但也完全失去了理智。
现在她徘徊在地下城之中，想让其他冒险者也承受与她一样的命运。

entries.english: <zot statue>
entries.translation: <zot statue>

entries.english:
A young merfolk that looks deeply ill, but is still capable of bespelling its
audience.
entries.translation: 一个年轻的人鱼，看起来病得很重，但仍能吸引听众。

entries.english:
A hideous cross-breed, bearing the features of a human and a lion, with great
bat-like wings. Its tail bristles with spikes that can be loosed at potential
prey.
entries.translation:
一个狰狞的混种动物：它身上既有人的特征也有狮子的特征，
还长着一对巨大的蝠翼形翅膀。它的尾巴上长满的尖刺，会射向潜在的猎物。

entries.english:
A mighty old lich, notorious for blasting people with powerful conjurations at
the slightest provocation, or just on a whim.
entries.translation:
一个强大的老巫妖，它臭名昭著，因为它只要受到一点挑拨
（甚至有时只是心情不好）就会用强大的塑能法术轰杀别人。

entries.english:
One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Ablaze
with demonic frenzy, it gores and tramples with ferocity unmatched. Its skin is
flayed, exposing the glistening tendons and sinew underneath, and the teeth
inside its cavernous maw are stained with blood.
entries.translation: 血肉领主的肉雕师制造的憎恶军团之一。它燃烧着恶魔狂乱，凶猛无比地顶撞、践踏。皮肤被剥开，露出闪亮的筋腱，洞穴般巨口内的牙齿沾满鲜血。

entries.english:
One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Each of
its eight necks is distended and elongated, connected to a colossal body
crumpled and dripping with ichor. Its many heads spew blood while writhing and
convulsing in agony, as it brings torment to itself and anything else that
beholds its foul visage.
entries.translation:
由肉雕师制造的憎恶军团中的一员。
它的八个脖子都被伸展拉长，与一个起皱的、滴着腐液的巨大身体相连。
它的许多头痛苦地翻滚、痉挛着，并吐出鲜血，
它给它自己和任何见到它那污秽容貌的人带来了痛苦。

entries.english:
A nymphal hybrid, with a winged torso of a human atop the stinging abdomen
of a bee. The meliai serve under many roles: priestesses of nature, nurses to
the divine, and warrior-champions for their hives.
entries.translation:
一个仙女的混种，上方是带有翅膀的人类躯体，下方是长有蜂刺的腹部。
墨利亚扮演着众多角色：自然的祭司、神圣的看护者和蜂巢的战士。

entries.english:
A hybrid with the torso of a human and the tail of a fish. It is capable of
dwelling both in water and on land, and fiercely defends its domain.
entries.translation: 一个人身鱼尾的混种生物。他能在水中和陆地上栖居，并会激烈地捍卫其领地。

entries.english:
A slender merfolk mystic with unusually webby hands. Its form shifts and
glistens as if seen through ocean spray.
entries.translation:
一个纤细的人鱼秘术师，有着不同寻常的蹼状手。
他的形态变幻、发光，仿佛是透过海浪所看到的。

entries.english:
A beguiling merfolk whose voice mesmerises listeners. It carries no weapon,
but its song summons drowned souls to defend the sea against intruders.
entries.translation:
一个迷人的人鱼，她的声音令听众陶醉其中。
她虽然没有持任何武器，但她的歌声能召唤溺魂，抵抗入侵者，保卫海洋。

entries.english: A powerfully muscled merfolk warrior, bearing a deadly weapon.
entries.translation: 一个强壮的人鱼战士，手持一把致命的武器。

entries.english:
A fearsome merfolk champion with a piercing gaze and a large bundle of
javelins.
entries.translation: 一名值得敬畏的人鱼勇士，目光锐利，还携有一大捆标枪。

entries.english: A beguiling merfolk whose voice can mesmerise listeners.
entries.translation: 一个迷人的人鱼，她的声音会迷住听众。

entries.english:
A large muscular human with the head of a bull. It makes its home in a
gauntlet where it awaits worthy challengers.
entries.translation: 一个高大、壮硕的人形生物，长着一颗牛头。他居住在竞技场，等待值得较量的挑战者。

entries.english:
A flying munitions factory, held aloft on jets of fiery exhaust and packed to
the brim with explosives. It can rapidly fill an area with bomblets, and when
commanded by its creator, will explode them all (and itself) to devastating
effect.
entries.translation: 一座靠烈焰尾喷悬空、塞满炸药的飞行军火工厂。它能迅速在一片区域布满小炸弹，并依创造者的命令，将所有炸弹连同自己一起引爆，造成毁灭性效果。

entries.english: <naga warrior>
entries.translation: <naga warrior>

entries.english: A fearsome naga warrior clad in sturdy armour and wielding a mighty weapon.
entries.translation: 一个令人敬畏的娜迦战士，身穿坚甲，手拿利器。

entries.english:
A malign force from the space between planes. It is hostile to the magic forces
that removed it from its home. These horrors are often the result of mistaken
summoning spells and have slain many aspiring wizards.
entries.translation:
一个来自位面之间的邪恶力量。它对把它带离家园的魔法力量充满敌意。
这个恐怖通常是召唤魔法出错的结果，并杀死了许多有抱负的巫师。

entries.english:
An ancient stone creature that has lived among these frozen caves since before
Antaeus rent Cocytus into being. It tolerates its new neighbors begrudgingly,
preferring the company of its petrified enemies. Veins of ice permeate its
frozen stone flesh.
entries.translation: 一种古老石质生物，早在安泰俄斯撕出悲叹河之前，就已栖居于这些冰洞。它勉强容忍新邻居，更愿与被自己石化的敌人为伴。冰脉遍布它冻结的石质血肉。

entries.english:
A fast-moving magical cat. Once a powerful wizard's familiar, Natasha was
abandoned after her master was consumed by the very necromantic forces he sought
to control. Now she patrols the dungeon, taking a bloody vengeance with spell
and claw upon any adventurer who crosses her path.

This cat doesn't have nine lives, but just one death isn't going to be enough
to put her down for good.
entries.translation:
一只移动迅速、有魔力的猫。娜塔莎曾是一个强大的巫师的伙伴，
但在她的主人被他试图控制的死灵力量吞噬后，她被遗弃了。
现在她在地下城里巡游，用法术和利爪对任何经过她的路线的冒险者进行血腥的报复。

这只猫没有九条命，但仅仅一死也不足以让她安息。

entries.english:
A vile undead creation of the most unholy necromancy, made from the decaying
corpses of humanoid creatures. It exists to spread disease and decay.
entries.translation:
一个被最邪恶的死灵法术创造出来的亡灵造物，其身体由人形生物的腐尸拼凑而成。
它的存在的就是为了散布疾病与腐化。

entries.english:
A centaur warrior, skilled at warfare and deceit. They slew a mighty hydra, and
now its deadly blood drips, still-fuming, from their arrows.
entries.translation:
一个半人马战士，擅长作战和诈术。
他曾杀死过一只强大的海德拉，现在它的致命血液从箭上滴落，仍在冒烟。

entries.english:
You see the unseen, you stare and they stare back. They whisper and laugh, they
grin and cry, they leer at you with contempt and gaze at you in adoration. They
are the observers, they are the judge of your worth and will decide your end.
entries.translation:
你看着看不见的，你凝视着他们，他们也凝视着你。
他们低语着，笑着，他们又笑又哭，他们轻蔑地睨视着你，崇敬地凝望着你。
他们是观察者，他们是你的价值的仲裁，并决定着你的结局。

entries.english:
A more intelligent cousin of the mighty kraken, capable of using tools and
spells. It is fully amphibious, but most of its species choose to stay beneath
the waves and serve their King.
entries.translation:
强大的海妖的一个近亲，但比海妖更聪明，能够使用工具和魔法。
它是完全两栖的，但它们大多数物种还是选择留在波涛之下，服侍它们的王。

entries.translation: <oklob plant annihilator>
