entries.english:
Fire Magic focuses mainly on dealing fire damage over long distances, with many
effective Conjurations.

Being skilled in Fire Magic increases the success rate and spell power of
spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools,
in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill
in these schools.
entries.translation:
火系魔法主要用来从远处造成火焰伤害，包含许多强力的塑能法术。

精通火系魔法能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

entries.english:
Forgecraft is the art of shaping tangible objects out of magic. Forgecraft
spells can construct a wide array of mechanical creatures that will fight
alongside the caster, as well as create traps and barricades and even turn the
physical resilience of one's armour into a weapon.

Being skilled in Forgecraft increases the success rate and spell power of
spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools,
in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill
in these schools.
entries.translation:
锻造术是用魔法塑造实体物件的技艺。此类法术能创造多种机械生物与施法者并肩作战，也能制造陷阱和路障，甚至把防具的物理坚固性化为武器。

精通锻造术能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

issues.review: context_review:turn into / in turn / turn against 等动词或惯用语，不是回合

entries.english:
Ice Magic contains a range of direct damage spells, as well as some defensive
effects - for example, crafting temporary ice armour.

Being skilled in Ice Magic increases the success rate and spell power of spells
in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in
which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in
these schools.
entries.translation:
冰系魔法包含多种直接伤害法术，也有一些防御效果，例如制造临时冰甲。

精通冰系魔法能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

entries.english:
Being skilled with Long Blades will allow you to attack more quickly with all
weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them.

Being skilled with Long Blades increases your effectiveness with Short Blades,
and vice versa.
entries.translation:
精通长刃能提高使用此类所有武器时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

精通长刃也能提高使用短刃的效能，反之亦然。

entries.english:
Being skilled with Maces & Flails will allow you to attack more quickly with
all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with
them.

Being skilled with Maces & Flails increases your effectiveness with Axes and
Staves, and vice versa.
entries.translation:
精通锤与连枷能提高使用此类所有武器时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

精通锤与连枷也能提高使用斧、棍杖的效能，反之亦然。

entries.english:
Necromancy is the art of draining and gaining life, although most often
associated with zombies and other undead. As such, Necromancy spells have a
wide range of effects, ranging from spells to create or disrupt the undead to
spells granting unholy healing in various forms.

Being skilled in Necromancy increases the success rate and spell power of
spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools,
in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill
in these schools.
entries.translation:
死灵系魔法是汲取与获取生命的技艺，尽管通常与僵尸及其他亡灵联系在一起。因此，这类法术的效果非常广泛，既能创造或破坏亡灵，也能以各种方式提供邪恶的治疗。

精通死灵系魔法能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

entries.english:
Polearms can be evoked with ‘v’ to attack enemies from two spaces away.

Being skilled with Polearms will allow you to attack more quickly with all
weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them.

Being skilled with Polearms increases your effectiveness with Axes and Staves,
and vice versa.
entries.translation:
长柄武器可用“v”键发动攻击，命中两格远的敌人。

精通长柄武器能提高使用此类所有武器时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

精通长柄武器也能提高使用斧、棍杖的效能，反之亦然。

entries.english:
Being skilled with Ranged Weapons will let you attack more quickly with all
bows, crossbows and slings, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with
them.
entries.translation: 精通远程武器能提高使用所有弓、弩和投石索时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

entries.english:
A high Shields skill helps you block melee attacks or projectiles (both magical
and non-magical) with your equipped shield, and reduces their penalty to your
evasion, attack speed and spellcasting success.
entries.translation: 较高的盾牌技能有助于用所装备的盾牌格挡近战攻击或投射物，无论其是否具有魔法性质，也能减轻盾牌对闪避、攻击速度和施法成功率的惩罚。

entries.english:
Short Blades are more effective than any other weapon type at stabbing helpless
foes.

Being skilled with Short Blades will allow you to attack more quickly with all
weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them.

Being skilled with Short Blades increases your effectiveness with Long Blades,
and vice versa.
entries.translation:
短刃比其他任何武器类型都更擅长刺杀无力反抗的敌人。

精通短刃能提高使用此类所有武器时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

精通短刃也能提高使用长刃的效能，反之亦然。

entries.english:
{{
    if you.race() == "Djinni" then
        return "Being skilled in Spellcasting increases the success rate and spell "..
               "power of all spells."
    else
        return "Being skilled in Spellcasting slightly increases the success " ..
                "rate and spell power of all spells, along with increasing your " ..
                "magical reserves. Training Spellcasting also gives you more spell " ..
                "slots to spend on new spells."
    end
}}
entries.translation:
{{
    if you.race() == "Djinni" then
        return "精通施法能提高所有法术的成功率和"..
               "法术强度。"
    else
        return "精通施法能略微提高所有法术的成功率" ..
                "和法术强度，并增加你的" ..
                "魔力储备。训练施法还能增加" ..
                "用于学习新法术的法术槽。"
    end
}}

entries.english:
Staves require a relatively low amount of skill to be used most effectively,
although they lack the high damage potential of some other weapon classes.

Being skilled with Staves will allow you to attack more quickly with all
weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them.

Being skilled with Staves increases your effectiveness with Maces & Flails and
Polearms, and vice versa.
entries.translation:
棍杖只需相对较低的技能等级就能发挥最大效能，但伤害潜力不及某些其他武器类型。

精通棍杖能提高使用此类所有武器时的攻击速度、命中率和伤害。

精通棍杖也能提高使用锤与连枷、长柄武器的效能，反之亦然。

entries.english:
By training Stealth, you can make it less likely that monsters will notice you
if they are asleep or otherwise unalert, and increase your chances of monsters
losing track of you after you leave their vision. Note that more powerful
monsters tend to be more suspicious and observant.

Stealth skill, along with the weapon skill for your equipped weapon, also
governs the likelihood of doing a great amount of damage when attacking a
distracted or helpless creature, as well as the amount of extra damage dealt.
entries.translation:
训练潜行能降低熟睡或其他未警觉怪物注意到你的几率，也能提高你离开怪物视野后使其失去踪迹的几率。注意，越强大的怪物通常越多疑、越敏锐。

潜行技能与所持武器的技能共同影响你攻击分心或无力反抗的生物时造成大量伤害的几率，以及额外伤害的大小。

entries.english:
Summonings deals with summoning creatures from another plane of reality to
temporarily aid you. Increasing Summonings skill may grant a number of effects
depending on the spell, such as longer duration or more powerful allies. Note
that summoned beings do not leave corpses and give no experience when killed,
and their equipment is as ephemeral as they are.

Being skilled in Summonings increases the success rate and spell power of
spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools,
in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill
in these schools.
entries.translation:
召唤系魔法从其他现实位面召来生物，暂时为你提供帮助。提高召唤系魔法技能可能产生不同效果，例如延长持续时间或召来更强大的盟友，具体取决于法术。注意，召唤生物死亡时不留下尸体、不提供经验，它们的装备也和它们一样只是暂时存在。

精通召唤系魔法能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

entries.english:
Training Throwing will make thrown weapons (such as javelins) more accurate
and damaging. It also makes certain magical darts more likely to have an
effect.
entries.translation: 训练投掷能提高投掷武器（如标枪）的命中率和伤害，也能让某些魔法飞镖更容易生效。

entries.english:
Translocations focus on the spatial movement of beings or objects, including
useful spells to translocate yourself over short distances quickly or to
transport your enemies away from you.

Being skilled in Translocations increases the success rate and spell power of
spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools,
in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill
in these schools.
entries.translation:
位移系魔法专注于生物或物体在空间中的移动，包含使自己快速移动一小段距离、将敌人传送到远处等实用法术。

精通位移系魔法能提高该流派法术的成功率和法术强度。许多法术同时属于多个流派，此时施法成功率和法术强度取决于这些流派技能的平均值。

entries.english:
Demonspawn are half human, half demon. They acquire strong demonic mutations as
they grow.
entries.translation: 魔人半人半魔，随着成长会获得强大的恶魔变异。

issues.review: context_review:人、半人或可读性语境，允许中文省略类字

entries.english:
Half fish, half human, Merfolk are citizens of both water and land. They are
strong combatants, and adept at using magic to assist in battle.
entries.translation: 人鱼半人半鱼，既能在水中也能在陆地生活。它们擅长战斗，也擅长用魔法辅助作战。

issues.review: context_review:人、半人或可读性语境，允许中文省略类字

entries.english:
Mountain Dwarves are strong melee fighters and capable heavy-armoured casters.
They can use scrolls to enchant even some artefacts.
entries.translation: 山地矮人是强壮的近战斗士，也是能穿重甲施法的能手。它们甚至能用卷轴强化某些神器。

entries.english:
Nagas are hybrids: human from the waist up, with a snake-like tail instead of
legs. They move very slowly but are naturally resilient.
entries.translation: 娜迦上半身似人，下半身是蛇尾而非双腿。它们移动十分缓慢，但天生坚韧。

issues.review: context_review:人、半人或可读性语境，允许中文省略类字

entries.english:
Octopodes are a species of amphibious cephalopods. They can wear eight rings,
but almost no armour fits them.
entries.translation: 章鱼人是一种两栖头足类生物。它们可以佩戴八枚戒指，但几乎没有防具适合它们。

entries.english:
Causes the air around a creature to twist itself into a whirling vortex of
meteorological fury. It does more damage to targets surrounded by empty space.
entries.translation: 使一个生物周围的空气扭曲成猛烈旋转的气象涡旋。目标周围的空位越多，伤害越高。

issues.review: context_review:涡旋或旋涡的物理描述，不是完整法术名

entries.english:
Converts a small portion of the brain matter of those around you into alcohol,
attempting to confuse all intelligent creatures within view (although
poison-resistant creatures may resist the effects). The caster will experience
vertigo briefly if they successfully make contact with other minds. It is
frequently used as an icebreaker at wizard parties.
entries.translation: 将周围生物少量的脑组织转化为酒精，尝试使视野内所有有智慧的生物混乱；具有毒素抗性的生物可能抵抗此效果。如果成功接触到其他心智，施法者会短暂眩晕。巫师聚会经常用它来打破冷场。

issues.review: context_review:经历、体验或升级动作，不是独立经验数值标签

entries.english:
Afflicts nearby foes with supernatural anguish, causing all damage they deal to
rebound on them for the duration of the effect. Strong-willed foes can resist the
necromantic visions of pain and suffering, and mindless creatures are unaffected.
entries.translation: 使附近敌人承受超自然的痛苦，在效果持续期间，它们造成的所有伤害都会反弹到自身。意志坚定的敌人可以抵抗这种充满痛苦与折磨的死灵幻象；没有心智的生物不受影响。

issues.review: context_review:普通痛苦描述，不是法术名称

entries.english: <Berserk ability>
entries.translation: <Berserk ability>

entries.english:
Transforms the caster into a lightning bolt, and translocates the caster to
the bolt's destination.
entries.translation: 使施法者化为一道闪电，并易位到闪电的终点。

issues.review: context_review:化作一道闪电的动作，不是闪电束法术

entries.english:
Summons an inugami to the caster's aid. These mystical canines form a bond with
their summoner, strengthening them in direct proportion with the caster's
spellpower.

Recasting this spell while your familiar is nearby will imbue it with additional
magic, mending some of its wounds, cleansing it of poison, and causing its next
attack to strike more quickly and cleave adjacent foes.
entries.translation:
召来一只犬神帮助施法者。这些神秘的犬类会与召唤者建立纽带，其力量与施法者的法术强度成正比。

魔宠在附近时重新施法，会为其灌注额外魔力，治疗部分伤势、清除毒素，并使其下一次攻击更快，还能劈砍相邻敌人。

issues.review: context_review:召唤者或施法者，不是背景名

entries.english:
Calls forth a minor demon from the pits of Hell, equipped with a spear with
which to jab at the caster's enemies. The quality of the imp's weaponry rises
with spell power.
entries.translation: 从地狱深处召来一只小恶魔，它装备一根矛，用来刺击施法者的敌人。小恶魔的武器品质随法术强度提高。

entries.english:
Causes fear in those near to the caster, causing those affected to be unable to
approach the caster, and to sometimes fail to attack them in melee. Leaving the
caster's line of sight will end the effect.
entries.translation: 使施法者附近的生物恐惧。受影响者无法接近施法者，尝试近战攻击施法者时也可能失败。离开施法者视野就会终止效果。

entries.english: Fires a bolt of accursed malice which inflicts Doom.
entries.translation: 发射一道蕴含诅咒恶意的射线，施加厄运。

entries.english:
Issues a powerful call to a draconic realm, beckoning forth dragon after dragon
to engage the summoner's enemies. The spell is taxing to maintain, and each new
dragon which answers the call will further drain the summoner's magical
reserves. After the call ends, it cannot be issued again for a short time. The
duration of the call and the species of dragons called depend on spell power.
entries.translation: 向龙族领域发出强大的呼唤，召来一条又一条龙，与召唤者的敌人交战。维持呼唤十分吃力，每条响应的新龙还会进一步消耗召唤者的魔力。呼唤结束后，短时间内无法再次发出。呼唤持续时间及召来的龙种取决于法术强度。

issues.review: context_review:召唤者或施法者，不是背景名

entries.english:
Lowers its target's metabolic rate, inducing hibernation. After awakening, the
target will be unable to be put to sleep again for some time.
entries.translation: 降低目标的代谢速率，使其进入冬眠。醒来后，目标在一段时间内无法再次被催眠。

entries.english:
Blasts the caster's surroundings with a wave of fire. If the caster maintains
focus and supplies the spell with magical power (by waiting in place and not
taking any other actions), more and larger flame waves will radiate outward.
entries.translation: 以火焰波浪轰击施法者周围。若施法者保持专注并持续供给魔力，也就是原地等待、不做其他动作，就会继续向外释放更多、更大的火焰波浪。

entries.english:
Conjures two balls of burning swamp gas adjacent to the caster. The balls will
rapidly seek the nearest monster and burn them. They will dissipate harmlessly
if unable to reach a target or if the caster swaps places with them.
entries.translation: 在施法者身旁创造两团燃烧的沼气。火团会迅速寻找最近的怪物并将其烧伤。如果无法接近目标，或施法者与火团交换位置，火团就会无害地消散。

issues.review: context_review:沼气或沼泽污泥，不是沼泽分支

entries.english:
Freezes an adjacent creature, dealing damage that bypasses any armour the
target may have. This may temporarily slow cold-blooded creatures.
entries.translation: 冻结相邻生物，造成无视目标所有护甲的伤害。这还可能使冷血生物暂时减速。

entries.english:
Transmutes an ultra-thin layer of the caster's skin (or equivalent) directly
into pure magical energy, blasting adjacent creatures. It may heavily deform
its victims, weakening them and reducing their armour. The caster is not left
entirely unaffected; some of the magic lingers, enough to leave them
dangerously contaminated after a few castings.
entries.translation: 将施法者极薄的一层皮肤（或相应结构）直接转化为纯粹魔法能量，轰击相邻生物。它可能使受害者严重畸变，削弱其力量并降低护甲值。施法者也并非毫发无损；部分魔力会残留，施放数次后就足以造成危险的魔法污染。

entries.english:
Calls the attention of trickster spirits. While it holds, the spirits will
follow up on the caster's attacks. If the spell overcomes victims' willpower,
they will suffer minor damage and be drained by the sprites' playful malice.

Fae assistance is fickle, however; they cannot be beckoned unless a susceptible
victim is visible, and will depart rapidly once no more remain. Calling on the
fae also reduces the caster's own willpower for a time.
entries.translation:
吸引恶作剧精魂的注意。法术持续期间，它们会跟随施法者的攻击发动追击。若法术克服了受害者的意志，精魂顽皮的恶意就会造成少量伤害并施加吸能。

然而，妖精的帮助反复无常：只有视野内存在会受其影响的受害者时才能召来它们，而此类目标一旦全部消失，它们也会迅速离去。呼唤妖精还会在一段时间内削弱施法者自身的意志。

entries.english:
Weaves a thin kinetic filament around the caster's melee weapon and launches the
other end of it at a nearby enemy. If this grapnel successfully hits and does
damage, it will become lodged in them, allowing the next melee attack the caster
performs against them to strike with perfect accuracy and a small slaying bonus.
entries.translation: 在施法者的近战武器上缠绕一根细小的动能丝线，再将另一端射向附近敌人。如果抓钩命中并造成伤害，就会嵌入目标体内，使施法者下一次对该目标的近战攻击必定命中，并获得少量杀戮加成。

entries.english:
Conjures forth a fragment of the caster's essence and twists it into a fragment
of death, painfully draining the victim. The caster, too, will find their health
reduced, until they gain enough experience to recover.
entries.translation: 从施法者的本质中抽取一小片，扭曲为死亡的碎片，痛苦地吸取受害者的生命。施法者的生命也会减少，直到获得足够经验才会恢复。

entries.english:
Fragments a wall or a suitably brittle visible monster into an explosion of
deadly shrapnel. It can be used on monsters made of ice, bone, or any wall-like
substance, as well as those turned to stone by petrification. Its damage is
strongly reduced by armour.

Targets made from rock, stone, ice or bone will cause a small explosion. Metal
targets will cause a small but more damaging explosion, and targets made from
crystal will cause a large and more damaging explosion.
entries.translation:
将墙壁或视野中足够脆硬的怪物炸成致命的碎片。它可以用于由冰、骨或任何类似墙壁的物质构成的怪物，也能用于因石化而变成石头的怪物。护甲会大幅削减其伤害。

岩石、石头、冰或骨质目标会产生小型爆炸。金属目标的爆炸范围小，但伤害更高；水晶目标则会产生范围更大、伤害也更高的爆炸。

entries.english:
Tears a gash in reality, creating a self-sustained but temporary portal to an
unknown, tainted otherworld. It requires open space to succeed. After a short
time, a powerful clawed tentacle will reach through the portal, remaining bound
to the caster's will for a duration depending on power. With the portal's
expiry, the tentacle will be severed and turn on the caster. The duration of
the portal increases with spell power.
entries.translation: 撕裂现实，创造一道通往未知污秽异界、能自行维持的临时传送门。法术需要开阔空间才能成功。稍后，一条强大、带爪的触手会伸出传送门，在一段取决于法术强度的时间内受施法者意志约束。传送门消失时，触手会被切断，并转而攻击施法者。法术强度越高，传送门持续越久。

entries.english: Fires a burst of metal splinters. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.
entries.translation: 发射一阵金属碎片，其伤害会被护甲大幅削减。

entries.english:
Blasts a target with energy borrowed from the caster's own future movement. For
a short time afterward, the caster will be left immotile - unable to walk, fly
around, slither, etc. Only motile creatures can cast this spell.
entries.translation: 借用施法者未来移动的能量轰击目标。随后短时间内，施法者将无法自行移动，不能行走、飞行、爬行等。只有具备移动能力的生物才能施放此法术。

entries.english:
Causes the caster to radiate toxic energy, continuously inflicting poison on
everything in line of sight for as long as the spell lasts.
entries.translation: 使施法者放射有毒能量，在法术持续期间不断使视野内的一切生物中毒。

entries.english:
Turns the air bitterly cold, freezing all other creatures in line of sight.
This is less effective against creatures packed tightly together - those
adjacent to their allies will be partly insulated from the cold, taking less
damage.
entries.translation: 使空气变得酷寒，冻结视线范围内的所有其他生物。对紧密聚集的生物效果较弱：与盟友相邻的生物能部分隔绝寒冷，因此受到较少伤害。

entries.english:
Allows the caster to travel a short distance through an adjacent rock wall and
emerge again on the other side. This spell takes an unusally long time to cast,
during which the caster will be unable to act, but also gain increased armour
from their attunement to the rock.
entries.translation: 允许施法者短距离穿过相邻岩壁，从另一侧重新出现。施放此法术需要异常长的时间，期间施法者无法行动，但与岩石的调谐也会提高护甲值。

entries.english:
Turns the air around the caster into a freezing vortex, doing tremendous damage
to everyone caught in it that can only be half-mitigated by resistance to
cold. Those affected will also be swept up into the air and tossed around.
Only the eye of the storm is a safe place, and it follows the caster. The
vortex is unable to follow the caster through long-distance translocations.
The spell's effectiveness is greatly diminished in closed areas. After the
vortex fades, it cannot be called forth again for a short time.
entries.translation: 将施法者周围的空气变成冰冻漩涡，对卷入其中的所有人造成巨量伤害；寒冷抗性只能削减其中一半伤害。受影响者还会被卷上空中，抛来甩去。只有风眼是安全的，它会跟随施法者移动，但漩涡无法随施法者进行远距离易位。在封闭区域中，法术效果会大幅减弱。漩涡消散后，短时间内无法再次召来。

entries.english:
Blasts a target with high-velocity rock shards. Gathering the rock from ambient
grit is slow, making this spell take one-and-a-half times as long to cast as
most. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.
entries.translation: 用高速岩石碎片轰击目标。从周围沙砾中收集岩石需要时间，因此此法术的施放耗时是大多数法术的 1.5 倍。护甲能大幅减轻其伤害。

issues.review: context_review:迟缓、反应慢、减缓速度是描述语，不强制使用法术名

entries.english:
Fires a continuous piercing ray of arcane energy from the caster's hands. So
long as the caster maintains focus upon the spell and supplies it with magical
power (by waiting in place and not taking any other actions), the ray will
follow the caster's target if it should move.
entries.translation: 从施法者手中射出一道持续、具有穿透力的奥术能量射线。只要施法者保持专注并持续供给魔力，也就是原地等待、不做其他动作，即使目标移动，射线也会持续追踪它。

entries.english: Throws a bouncing bolt of electricity. It bypasses half of defenders' armour.
entries.translation: 射出一道能够反弹的电流，穿透防御者一半的护甲。

entries.english:
Creates two sigils nearby. Anyone who passes over them will be bound, able to
act and dodge normally but unable to move away. When the effect wears off,
their movement speed will rebound, giving them temporary swiftness. Swiftness
from any source grants immunity to binding.

Only one set of sigils can be maintained at a time, and they will expire
prematurely if they leave your sight.
entries.translation:
在附近创造两个符印。任何经过符印的生物都会被束缚，仍可正常行动和闪避，但无法移开。效果结束后，其移动速度会反弹，暂时获得迅捷。来自任何来源的迅捷都能使生物免疫束缚。

同时只能维持一组符印，且符印离开你的视野时会提前消失。

issues.review: context_review:普通速度描述或迅捷效果，保留上下文表达

entries.english: Fires a burst of wooden splinters. Its damage is strongly reduced by armour.
entries.translation: 发射一阵木质碎片，其伤害会被护甲大幅削减。

entries.english:
Releases electrical charges against those next to the caster. These may arc to
other adjacent creatures, or back to the caster, before eventually grounding
out. It deals reduced damage when arcing to the caster, and the damage dealt
bypasses half of defenders' armour.
entries.translation: 向施法者身旁的生物释放电荷。电流可能传导到其他相邻生物，也可能传回施法者，最后才导入地面。传回施法者时造成的伤害较低；此法术的伤害会穿透防御者一半的护甲。

entries.english:
Unleashes a short-ranged spray of incendiary goo that clings to an adjacent
creature and deals armour-ignoring fire damage over several turns. If the victim
is allowed to move, it will put out the fire prematurely.

If the target is insubstantial, the liquid fire will fail to stick.
entries.translation:
向相邻生物喷射短距离的燃烧黏液，黏附后在数回合内造成无视护甲的火焰伤害。若受害者能够移动，就会提前扑灭火焰。

若目标没有实体，液态火焰便无法黏附。

entries.english: Summons between one and three minor (rank 5) demons.
entries.translation: 召唤一至三只低阶（第 5 阶）恶魔。

issues.review: context_review:低阶恶魔、亚龙等语境，不是次级法术前缀

entries.english:
Summons the egg of a brutish lizard, just on the verge of hatching. So long as
there are foes nearby and the caster remains adjacent to the egg, it will hatch
several turns after being summoned to wreak havoc upon its summoner's foes.

Even as a juvenile, a seismosaurus is a force to be reckoned with. It is nearly
as hardy as a mountain, and its footfalls are capable of creating violent
seismic shockwaves. Each shockwave deals considerable damage to non-flying
enemies, and may sometimes even cause them to lose their footing altogether.

Spell power increases the egg's durability and the strength of the seismosaur
within, but not the time it takes to hatch.
entries.translation:
召来一枚即将孵化的凶猛蜥蜴蛋。只要附近有敌人，且施法者一直与蛋相邻，它就会在召来数回合后孵化，重创召唤者的敌人。

即使还很年幼，震龙也不可小觑。它几乎像山一样坚韧，脚步还能制造猛烈的地震冲击波。每次冲击波都会对不飞行的敌人造成可观伤害，有时甚至使其站立不稳。

法术强度提高蛋的耐久和其中震龙的力量，但不会改变孵化所需时间。

issues.review: context_review:召唤者或施法者，不是背景名

entries.english:
Sends the caster hurtling at a chosen nearby enemy, launching a high-accuracy
melee attack on arrival. Additional electric damage will be dealt based on the
length of the charge, the power of the spell, and the physical damage of the
attack. The caster is wrapped in an envelope of twisted space, allowing them
to safely pass through creatures, traps, and harmful terrain, and to displace
creatures at their destination. The time taken by the spell is the greater of
the time normally needed to cast a spell or that needed to launch one melee
attack.
entries.translation: 使施法者冲向选定的附近敌人，抵达时发动一次高命中率的近战攻击。额外电击伤害取决于冲锋距离、法术强度和该次攻击的物理伤害。施法者被扭曲空间包裹，能安全穿过生物、陷阱和有害地形，并挤开目的地上的生物。此法术的耗时取正常施法耗时与一次近战攻击耗时中的较大值。

entries.english:
You cannot walk, fly around, slither, etc. You can still take other actions,
and can still be moved via translocations or by being pushed, pulled, and so on.
entries.translation: 你无法自行行走、飞行、爬行等，但仍能进行其他动作，也仍可通过位移魔法或被推、被拉等方式移动。

entries.english:
You have recently finished reciting Zin's laws, and cannot recite again for a
short duration.
entries.translation: 你刚结束诵读辛的律法，短时间内无法再次诵读。

issues.review: context_review:吟诵或诵读动作，不强制套用能力标题

entries.english:
Your body is covered in congealed blood, serving as armour for as long as you
remain seriously injured.
entries.translation: 你的身体覆盖着凝固的血液；只要你仍身受重伤，这层血液就能充当护甲。

entries.english:
You are being constricted by an enemy. Your evasion is impaired, and you will
take damage over time. You are unable to move away from the enemy, although you
can struggle to escape by attempting to do so, and will become increasingly more
likely to succeed and break the constriction when doing so multiple times.
entries.translation: 你正被敌人绞缠，闪避受到削弱，并会持续受到伤害。你无法离开敌人，但尝试移动可以挣脱；多次尝试会逐渐提高成功解除绞缠的几率。

entries.english:
You are corroded, reducing your damage in physical combat and your armour by an
amount depending on the severity of the corrosion.
entries.translation: 你遭到腐蚀，物理战斗伤害和护甲值都会降低，降低程度取决于腐蚀的严重程度。

entries.english:
A malevolent fate is gathering around you. If your Doom reaches 100%, you will
be afflicted by a random bane and your Doom will reset to 0. Banes have diverse
negative effects that can significantly endanger your character for an extended
period of time.

Both Doom and Banes are only cured by gaining experience, though Banes typically
last much longer.
entries.translation:
恶毒的命运正在你身边聚集。厄运达到 100% 时，你会遭受一种随机灾厄，随后厄运重置为 0。灾厄具有多种负面效果，可能在很长时间内严重危及角色。

厄运与灾厄都只能靠获取经验消除，不过灾厄通常持续得更久。

entries.english:
Your maximum health has been temporarily drained by negative energy. This
status will not wear off by waiting, but will gradually expire as you gain
experience.
entries.translation: 你的生命值上限被负能量暂时吸取。等待无法消除此状态，但获取经验会使其逐渐消退。

entries.english: <Fire status>
entries.translation: <Fire status>

entries.english: <Fire status>
entries.translation: <Fire status>

entries.english:
You are flying above the ground, and are able to cross water and lava or fight
above shallow water without penalties. Most types of flight will time out – be
careful what you are above when that happens!
entries.translation: 你正飞离地面，可以穿越水面和熔岩，也能在浅水上方战斗而不受惩罚。大多数飞行有时限，请留意结束时自己正处于什么地形上方！

entries.english:
Your weapon is temporarily enhanced by the souls of the damned, providing
slaying bonuses that increase with every enemy killed. At the maximum bonus,
foes adjacent to your attacks' targets suffer pain damage.
entries.translation: 你的武器暂时被受诅咒的灵魂强化，每杀死一个敌人，杀戮加成就会提高。达到最大加成后，与你攻击目标相邻的敌人会受到痛楚伤害。

entries.english:
Your connection to the divine has been partially cut-off, temporarily reducing
your effective piety. Gaining experience will eventually recover all piety that
has been locked away this way.
entries.translation: 你与神祇的联系被部分切断，有效虔诚暂时降低。获取经验最终会恢复所有以这种方式被封锁的虔诚。

entries.english:
Trog's Hand is simultaneously making you regenerate health at an unnaturally
fast rate and strengthening your willpower to protect you against many magical
effects.
entries.translation: 特洛格之手同时使你以异常快的速度恢复生命，并增强意志以抵御多种魔法效果。

entries.english: You have been sickened, and your health will no longer regenerate.
entries.translation: 你生病了，生命将不再自然恢复。

entries.english:
Your wielded weapon or your fists are coated in slime, and will turn the next
living or corporeal undead monster you hit into a neutral slime.
entries.translation: 你手持的武器或双拳被黏液覆盖，下一次命中活物或有实体的亡灵怪物时，会将其变为中立的史莱姆。

entries.english:
You are petrified, and completely unable to act. You are very easy to hit,
but all damage taken is substantially reduced.
entries.translation: 你已完全石化，无法进行任何动作，也非常容易被击中，但受到的所有伤害都大幅降低。

entries.english:
You are in the eye of a mighty ice storm. After the vortex fades, it cannot be
called forth again for a short time.
entries.translation: 你位于一场强劲冰风暴的中心。涡旋消退后，短时间内无法再次唤起。

entries.english:
:nowrap
Move diagonally with the <input>number pad</input> (try Numlock on/off)<localtiles>,</localtiles> <console>or the </console><input>vi keys</input><console>.</console><localtiles>, or <input>mouse</input>.</localtiles>

  Numpad:     <w>7 8 9</w>       vi-keys: <w>   $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_RIGHT]</w><localtiles>    Mouse:     <w>click</w> on the floor</localtiles>
               \|/                     \|/
              <w>4</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>6</w> <w>                  $cmd[CMD_MOVE_LEFT]</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_RIGHT]</w>
               /|\                     /|\
              <w>1 2 3</w> <w>                  $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_RIGHT]</w>
entries.translation:
:nowrap
用<input>数字键盘</input>（试试开关 Numlock）<localtiles>、</localtiles><console>或</console><input>vi 键</input><console>斜向移动。</console><localtiles>，或用<input>鼠标</input>斜向移动。</localtiles>

  数字键盘： <w>7 8 9</w>       vi-keys: <w>   $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_RIGHT]</w><localtiles>    鼠标：<w>点击</w>地面</localtiles>
               \|/                     \|/
              <w>4</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>6</w> <w>                  $cmd[CMD_MOVE_LEFT]</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_RIGHT]</w>
               /|\                     /|\
              <w>1 2 3</w> <w>                  $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_RIGHT]</w>

entries.english:
:nowrap
<white>Tutorial 1 summary: Movement</white>

<yellow>Movement commands</yellow>
   Numpad:       <w>7 8 9</w>           vi-keys:    <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_RIGHT]</w>
                  \|/                         \|/
                 <w>4</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>6</w>                       <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_LEFT]</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_RIGHT]</w>
                  /|\                         /|\
                 <w>1 2 3</w>                       <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_RIGHT]</w>

  <input>Shift + direction</input> moves you several squares in this direction.<localtiles>
  You also can move by <input>clicking</input> somewhere in sight or on the <w>minimap</w>.</localtiles>

<yellow>Staircases</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</input>  go back to the previous level
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</input>  enter the next level
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]></input>/<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]<<</input> travel to the nearest up/downstairs

<yellow>Doors</yellow> can be opened by walking into them
  <input>$cmd[CMD_CLOSE_DOOR]</input>  close an open door

<yellow>Travel</yellow><localtiles>
  mouseclick on the <w>minimap</w></localtiles><nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</input>  enter the level map, travel with <input>Enter</input></nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_EXPLORE]</input>  autoexplore
entries.translation:
:nowrap
<white>教程 1 小结：移动</white>

<yellow>移动命令</yellow>
   数字键盘：   <w>7 8 9</w>           vi-keys:    <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_UP_RIGHT]</w>
                  \|/                         \|/
                 <w>4</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>6</w>                       <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_LEFT]</w>-<w>.</w>-<w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_RIGHT]</w>
                  /|\                         /|\
                 <w>1 2 3</w>                       <w>$cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_LEFT] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN] $cmd[CMD_MOVE_DOWN_RIGHT]</w>

  <input>Shift + 方向键</input>  向该方向移动数格。<localtiles>
  也可以<input>点击</input>视野中的位置或<w>小地图</w>来移动。</localtiles>

<yellow>楼梯</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_UPSTAIRS]</input>  返回上一层
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</input>  进入下一层
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]></input>/<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]<<</input>  前往最近的下／上楼梯

<yellow>门</yellow>  朝门走去即可开门
  <input>$cmd[CMD_CLOSE_DOOR]</input>  关门

<yellow>旅行</yellow><localtiles>
  鼠标点击<w>小地图</w></localtiles><nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</input>  打开楼层地图，按 <input>Enter</input> 前往</nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_EXPLORE]</input>  自动探索

entries.english:
What's this? To find out where you are, <tiles>have a look at the
<w>minimap</w> to the right of the screen.</tiles><localtiles> You can have a
closer look at a part of the map with a <input>right mouse click</input> and
also can travel there with a <input>left click</input>.</localtiles><webtiles>
You can </webtiles><nomouse>enter the overmap view with
<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</input> and then move the cursor around to look
around the level. You also can travel wherever your cursor is pointing by
pressing <input>.</input> or <input>Enter</input>. Press <input>Escape</input>
to return to the normal game mode.</nomouse>
entries.translation: 这是哪里？<tiles>查看屏幕右侧的<w>小地图</w>，就能知道自己的位置。</tiles><localtiles>用<input>鼠标右键</input>点击地图某处，可以仔细查看；用<input>左键单击</input>则能前往那里。</localtiles><webtiles>你也可以</webtiles><nomouse>按 <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</input> 进入楼层地图，然后移动光标查看各处。按 <input>.</input> 或 <input>Enter</input>，即可前往光标位置。按 <input>Escape</input> 返回正常游戏。</nomouse>

entries.english:
In this lesson you're going to learn how to move around and explore a level.
You can move <localtiles>by clicking somewhere with your <input>Mouse</input>,
or </localtiles>with the <input>arrow keys</input>.
entries.translation: 本课介绍如何移动和探索楼层。你可以<localtiles>用<input>鼠标</input>点击目标位置，或</localtiles>使用<input>方向键</input>移动。

entries.english:
:nowrap
<white>Tutorial 2 summary: Combat</white>

<yellow>Weapons<console> <cyan>)</cyan></console></yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input>  pick up an item
  <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input>  equip an item<localtiles>
  You can also do this by <input>clicking</input> on the weapon in your inventory.</localtiles>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input>  adjust your quiver

<yellow>Monsters</yellow><localtiles>
  <input>mouseover</input>  examine a monster
  <input>rightclick</input> read a more detailed description</localtiles><nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</input>  examine a monster
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_DESCRIBE]</input> read a more detailed description</nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_PRIMARY_ATTACK]</input> fire held weapon
  <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_SELECT]</input> fire quiver at pre-targeted monster
  <input>shift-tab</input>, <input>p</input> fire quiver at closest monster
  <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_CYCLE_FORWARD]</input> target another monster<localtiles>
  You can also fire a missile by <input>clicking</input> on it, then confirming the target with <input>Enter</input>.</localtiles>

<yellow>Resting</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_WAIT]</input>  wait and rest a single turn
  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  wait and rest up to 100 turns
entries.translation:
:nowrap
<white>教程 2 小结：战斗</white>

<yellow>武器<console> <cyan>)</cyan></console></yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input>  拾取物品
  <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input>  装备物品<localtiles>
  也可以在物品栏中<input>点击</input>武器来操作。</localtiles>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input>  调整备投物

<yellow>怪物</yellow><localtiles>
  <input>鼠标悬停</input>  查看怪物
  <input>右键单击</input>  阅读详细描述</localtiles><nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]</input>  查看怪物
  <input>$cmd[CMD_LOOK_AROUND]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_DESCRIBE]</input>  阅读详细描述</nomouse>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_PRIMARY_ATTACK]</input>  使用手持武器射击
  <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_SELECT]</input>  向预选目标发射备投物
  <input>shift-tab</input>、<input>p</input>  向最近怪物发射备投物
  <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]$cmd[CMD_TARGET_CYCLE_FORWARD]</input>  选择另一目标<localtiles>
  也可以<input>点击</input>投射物，再按 <input>Enter</input> 确认目标。</localtiles>

<yellow>休息</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_WAIT]</input>  等待并休息一回合
  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  等待并休息最多 100 回合

entries.english:
Pick up this weapon<localtiles> by clicking on it in the inventory panel, and
then wield it by clicking on it again. Alternatively, pick it up</localtiles>
with <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input> or <input>g</input> and then wield it with
<input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input>.
entries.translation: 拾取这把武器<localtiles>时，可以在物品面板点击它，再点一次便能装备。也可以</localtiles>按 <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input> 或 <input>g</input> 拾取，再按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input> 装备。

entries.english:
This lesson will teach you about monsters and fighting. First, we need a
weapon! Go and grab the one lying over there.
entries.translation: 本课介绍怪物与战斗。首先，我们需要一把武器！去拿起那边地上的武器吧。

entries.english:
You can fire your boomerangs at a monster with <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]</input>
<localtiles> or by <input>clicking</input> on them in the inventory
panel</localtiles>. To confirm the auto-targeted monster, press
<input>$cmd[CMD_TARGET_SELECT]</input> or <input>Enter</input>. You can skip
this and fire at the closest monster with <input>shift-tab</input> or <input>p</input>.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板<input>点击</input>回旋镖</localtiles>，可以向怪物投掷。按 <input>$cmd[CMD_TARGET_SELECT]</input> 或 <input>Enter</input> 确认自动选中的目标。也可以跳过选目标这一步，按 <input>shift-tab</input> 或 <input>p</input> 直接攻击最近的怪物。

entries.english:
Jewellery is put on with <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles>
or with <input>mouseclick</input> in the inventory panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板用<input>鼠标点击</input></localtiles>，可以戴上首饰。

entries.english:
Pick up these boots with <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input> and wear them with
<input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input>.<localtiles> Or simply <input>mouseclick</input>
on them in the inventory panel.</localtiles>
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_PICKUP]</input> 拾取这双靴子，再按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input> 穿上。<localtiles>也可以直接在物品面板用<input>鼠标点击</input>它们。</localtiles>

entries.english:
Items with <w>unusual names</w> are artefacts. Artefacts can have a number of
special properties. Some unique artefacts (such as this cloak) are always
identified and may have special properties that cannot be found anywhere else!
Others are generated with a random selection of properties, and are
unidentified until you step on top of them. Try equipping this cloak with
<input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles> or <input>mouseclick</input>
in the inventory panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 带有<w>特殊名称</w>的物品是神器，可能具有多种特殊属性。有些独特神器（例如这件斗篷）始终处于已鉴定状态，还可能拥有其他物品没有的特殊属性！另一些则随机生成属性，要走到上面才会鉴定。试着按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板用<input>鼠标点击</input></localtiles>装备这件斗篷。

entries.english:
Some types of items<tiles>, marked with a green frame,</tiles> are picked up
automatically as you step on them.
entries.translation: 有些类型的物品<tiles>带有绿色边框，</tiles>走到上面就会自动拾取。

entries.english:
This amulet would be very powerful if your character had a god to worship,
but here and now, it's useless. You may want to drop it with
<input>$cmd[CMD_DROP]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>Shift-leftclicking</input> it in the inventory panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 如果角色信奉神祇，这枚护身符会非常强大；但此时此地它毫无用处。你可以按 <input>$cmd[CMD_DROP]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板按住 <input>Shift 并左键单击</input>它</localtiles>，将它丢下。

entries.english:
Many items are unidentified when you find them. One way to find out what they
do is to use them. Try reading this scroll with <input>$cmd[CMD_READ]</input>
<localtiles> or with <input>mouseclick</input> in the inventory
panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 许多物品刚发现时尚未鉴定。使用它们，是了解其效果的一种办法。试试按 <input>$cmd[CMD_READ]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板用<input>鼠标点击</input></localtiles>阅读这张卷轴。

entries.english:
You can evoke a wand with <input>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</input><localtiles> or with
<input>mouseclick</input> in the inventory panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板用<input>鼠标点击</input></localtiles>，可以唤发魔杖。

entries.english:
:nowrap
<white>Tutorial 4 summary: Magic</white>

<yellow>Spellcasting commands</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_MEMORISE_SPELL]</input>  learn a new spell
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</input>  check spell proficiency
  <input>$cmd[CMD_CAST_SPELL]</input>  cast a spell<localtiles>
  You can also learn new spells via the <w>memorisation tab</w>.
  You can cast memorised spells via <input>leftclick</input>, and read their descriptions and check your spell proficiency by <input>mouseover</input> or <input>rightclick</input></localtiles>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input>  adjust your quiver

  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  rest up to 100 turns to regain magic points and health
  <input>$cmd[CMD_SHOUT]</input>  order allies
  <input>$cmd[CMD_UNEQUIP]</input>  take off equipment
entries.translation:
:nowrap
<white>教程 4 小结：魔法</white>

<yellow>施法命令</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_MEMORISE_SPELL]</input>  学习新法术
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</input>  查看施法熟练程度
  <input>$cmd[CMD_CAST_SPELL]</input>  施放法术<localtiles>
  也可以通过<w>记忆标签页</w>学习法术。
  <input>左键单击</input>可以施放已记忆法术；
  <input>鼠标悬停</input>或<input>右键单击</input>可以阅读描述并查看施法熟练程度。</localtiles>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input>  调整备投物

  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  休息最多 100 回合，恢复魔力与生命
  <input>$cmd[CMD_SHOUT]</input>  命令盟友
  <input>$cmd[CMD_UNEQUIP]</input>  卸下装备

entries.english:
Gaining experience levels and raising your Spellcasting skill gives you spell
slots to spend on spells. You can also <w>forget a memorised spell</w> to make
space for a new one by reading a scroll of amnesia. Read the scroll (with
<input>$cmd[CMD_READ]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>clicking</input> on it</localtiles>), and then select the spell you want
to forget. You can relearn forgotten spells from your spell library later, as
long as you have spell slots available.
entries.translation: 提高经验等级或施法技能，会获得用于记忆法术的法术栏位。你也可以阅读遗忘卷轴，<w>遗忘一个已记忆的法术</w>，为新法术腾出空间。按 <input>$cmd[CMD_READ]</input><localtiles>，或<input>点击</input>卷轴</localtiles>阅读，再选择要遗忘的法术。以后只要有空余法术栏位，仍可从法术库重新学习。

entries.english:
Heavy armour really hampers spellcasting. Try putting on that mail and shield
(with <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>clicking</input> on them</localtiles>), and compare your spellcasting
failure rates with <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>mouseovering</input> your memorised spells</localtiles>. You can take
armour off again with <input>$cmd[CMD_UNEQUIP]</input><localtiles> or,
again, via <input>mouseclick</input></localtiles>.
entries.translation: 重甲会严重妨碍施法。试着按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles>，或<input>点击</input></localtiles>装备这件甲与盾，再按 <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_SPELLS]</input><localtiles>，或将<input>鼠标悬停</input>在已记忆法术上</localtiles>，比较施法失败率。之后可以按 <input>$cmd[CMD_UNEQUIP]</input><localtiles>，或再次用<input>鼠标点击</input></localtiles>卸下防具。

entries.english:
Mephitic Cloud is a level 3 spell, so you can't memorise it yet. To level up
quickly, here are more training dummies — without stones to throw this time.

At experience level 3, you'll be able to increase one of your stats — choosing
<input>I</input>ntelligence will help your spellcasting even further.
entries.translation:
臭云术是 3 级法术，所以你现在还不能记忆。这里还有一些训练假人，能让你快速升级——这回它们没有石头可扔。

经验等级达到 3 时，你可以提高一项属性；选择智力（<input>I</input>）能进一步帮助施法。

entries.english:
Make sure you are at full health and magic points before entering a new area.
If necessary, rest up with <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>mouseclick</input> in the command panel</localtiles>.

You can only summon a limited number of allies at once from any given spell,
so try to take advantage of a wide range of spells. For example, your summoned
imps are resistant to poison, so you can cast Mephitic Cloud to fight alongside
them without harming your allies.
entries.translation:
进入新区域前，请确保生命与魔力全满。必要时按 <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles>，或用<input>鼠标点击</input>命令面板</localtiles>休息恢复。

每种法术能同时召唤的盟友数量有限，因此尽量使用多种法术。例如，你召唤的小恶魔抵御毒素，所以可以施放臭云术协同作战，而不会伤害它们。

entries.english:
Put on this ring with <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles> or
by <input>clicking</input> it in the inventory panel</localtiles>, and then
rest up to your new full potential.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_EQUIP]</input><localtiles>，或在物品面板<input>点击</input></localtiles>戴上这枚戒指，然后休息，恢复到新的上限。

entries.english:
You can memorise a spell from your spell library with
<input>$cmd[CMD_MEMORISE_SPELL]</input><localtiles> or by
<input>clicking</input> on the memorisation tab and selecting the spell
tile</localtiles>. At experience level 1, only level 1 spells are available to
you. This will change as you gain experience. To find new spells, find and pick
up spellbooks, and the spells will be added to your library.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_MEMORISE_SPELL]</input><localtiles>，或<input>点击</input>记忆标签页并选择法术图标</localtiles>，可以从法术库记忆法术。经验等级为 1 时，你只能学习 1 级法术；获得更多经验后，就能学习更高级的法术。寻找并拾取法术书，其中的法术就会加入法术库。

entries.english:
Spells, like ammo, are shown in the quiver slot, so you can use
<input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input> to ready a spell in the quiver. Use
<input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]</input> or <input>shift-tab</input> to fire the currently
quivered spell.

Once you are out of magic points, retreat and rest to regain them with
<input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles> or by <input>clicking</input> the
rest icon in the command panel</localtiles>.
entries.translation:
法术与弹药一样，会显示在备投栏中，因此可以用 <input>$cmd[CMD_QUIVER_ITEM]</input> 将法术设为备投。按 <input>$cmd[CMD_FIRE]</input> 或 <input>shift-tab</input> 施放当前备投法术。

魔力耗尽后，请撤退并按 <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles>，或<input>点击</input>命令面板的休息图标</localtiles>，通过休息恢复魔力。

entries.english:
Congratulations, you're a real wizard now! To exit the tutorial, simply go down
these stairs.
entries.translation: 恭喜，你现在是真正的法师了！沿这处楼梯向下，即可退出教程。

entries.english:
A berserker rage is truly exhausting. After it ends, you cannot berserk again
for a short while and are slowed. It's best to rest with
<input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles> (or via the
<w>command panel</w>)</localtiles> until you feel fit again.
entries.translation: 狂暴非常消耗体力。结束后，你会短暂减速，并在一段时间内无法再次狂暴。最好按 <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input><localtiles>（或使用<w>命令面板</w>）</localtiles>休息，直到恢复状态。

issues.review: context_review:狂暴效果或动作，不要求重复狂战士前缀

entries.english:
:nowrap
<white>Tutorial 5 summary: Religion</white>

<yellow>Religious commands</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</input>  pray at an altar to join a god
  <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>  use a divine ability
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_RELIGION]</input>  check your religious standing<localtiles>
  A <input>rightclick</input> on the player tile will also bring up the religion screen.</localtiles>

<yellow>Resting</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_WAIT]</input>  wait and rest a single turn
  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  wait and rest up to 100 turns

<yellow>Other commands</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_OVERMAP]</input> display an overview of the dungeon
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_COMMANDS]/</input>  search the description database
entries.translation:
:nowrap
<white>教程 5 小结：信仰</white>

<yellow>宗教命令</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_GO_DOWNSTAIRS]</input>  在祭坛祈祷，信奉神祇
  <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>  使用神赐能力
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_RELIGION]</input>  查看信仰状况<localtiles>
  在角色图标上<input>右键单击</input>也能打开宗教界面。</localtiles>

<yellow>休息</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_WAIT]</input>  等待并休息一回合
  <input>$cmd[CMD_REST]</input>  等待并休息最多 100 回合

<yellow>其他命令</yellow>
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_OVERMAP]</input>  显示地下城总览
  <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_COMMANDS]/</input>  搜索描述数据库

entries.english:
Have a look at your current religious standing with
<input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_RELIGION]</input><localtiles> (or via the <w>religion
button</w> in the command panel, or by <input>Shift-rightclicking</input> on
the player tile)</localtiles>. Again, pressing <input>!</input><localtiles> or
<input>rightclicking</input></localtiles> will bring up a more detailed
description of your god.
entries.translation: 按 <input>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_RELIGION]</input><localtiles>（或使用命令面板的<w>宗教按钮</w>，或在角色图标上按住 <input>Shift 并右键单击</input>）</localtiles>，可以查看当前信仰状况。同样，按 <input>!</input><localtiles>，或用<input>右键单击</input></localtiles>，可以显示更详细的神祇描述。

entries.english:
A jewelled amulet famed for its powers of resilience and recuperation. Its
greatest notoriety came from its use by the dread necromancer Borgnjor, who
relied upon it to maintain her slender hold on life. After her final demise,
the amulet vanished from the pages of history.
entries.translation: 一枚以坚韧和恢复能力闻名的宝石护身符。它最出名的事迹，是曾被可怕的死灵法师博格尼尔用来维持岌岌可危的生命。她最终死去后，这枚护身符也从史书中消失了。

entries.english:
A huge and weighty suit of bronze plate armour. Only one with a correspondingly
huge body can wear it.
entries.translation: 一套巨大而沉重的青铜板甲，只有身躯同样巨大的人才能穿戴。

entries.english:
An infamous weapon, once used by a vile pirate captain to slaughter countless
innocents. He finally met his destiny when a kraken swallowed his ship, and the
cutlass was thought to be lost with him.
entries.translation:
曾经有个邪恶的海盗船长用这件臭名昭著的武器杀了无数的无辜之人。
当一只海妖吞下他的船时，他终于碰到了自己的劫数，
而那把短弯刀曾被认为和他一样，不知所踪。

entries.english:
This orb is the work of a master artificer, contracted to retrieve the orb, who
valued their life more than their professional integrity. While this fake
faithfully recreates the eerie glow and space-warping properties of the true
orb, the power it grants is artificial and only accessible to skilled evokers.
entries.translation: 这颗宝球出自一位受雇寻找佐特宝珠的魔法工匠大师之手。比起职业操守，此人更珍惜自己的性命。骗子宝球忠实再现了真宝珠的诡异光芒和扭曲空间的特性，但所赋予的力量只是人造的，只有精于唤发的人才能运用。

issues.review: context_review:魔法工匠的普通职业，不是玩家背景标签

entries.english:
The handiwork of a mad mycologist who once attempted to overcome the genetic
anxiety of wandering mushrooms by cultivating a species that could be easily
transported without disturbing them. The result is as much a living organism as
it is a piece of clothing, every linen fibre twined together with fungal mycelia
that draw both nutrients and confidence from whoever wears it. And in exchange
for such trifles as blood or peptides, the colony will instinctively lash out to
defend its wearer from whatever they perceive as a threat.

It's like wearing a thousand tiny friends at once! And the humming they fill
your mind with in the dark is actually quite lulling....

(This item also occupies your helmet slot.)
entries.translation:
一位疯狂的真菌学家曾试图克服游荡蘑菇天生的焦虑，培育出能在搬运时不受惊扰的品种。这件披风便是他的作品。它既是衣物，也同样是活的生物：每根亚麻纤维都缠着菌丝，从穿戴者身上汲取营养和信心。只需付出血液或肽之类的微小代价，这个菌落就会本能地出击，保护穿戴者免受它认定的任何威胁。

就像同时穿着一千位小朋友！而且，在黑暗中回荡于你脑海的嗡鸣其实还挺催眠……

（此物品也会占用头盔栏位。）

entries.english:
A pair of thick steel gauntlets. They were Okawaru's reward for a mighty
warlord. The owner is destined to die in battle, but what a death it will be!
entries.translation: 一副厚重的钢护手，是奥格瓦如赐给一位强大军阀的奖赏。它的主人注定战死，但那将是何等壮烈的死亡！

entries.english:
A sling made of weird green leather, oozing corrosive slime. Originally the
weapon of a notorious mischief-maker and general scamp, it's since fallen into
less savoury hands.
entries.translation: 一条用古怪的绿色皮革制成、渗出腐蚀黏液的投石索。它原本属于一个臭名昭著、四处捣乱的恶作剧高手，后来又落入了更不堪的人手中。

entries.english:
A dirty hat. It bears signs of surviving many weird explosions, which suggests
it may have means of protecting the head inside from the risks involved with
alchemy experiments.
entries.translation:
一顶肮脏的帽子。它似乎经过许多次奇怪的爆炸，但还是幸存下来，由此来看，
这顶帽子应该能在碰到炼金实验事故时保护下面的脑袋不受伤害。

entries.english:
A fur hat once owned by Ukta, a powerful ogre shaman. It houses the spirit of
an especially mighty bear, whose rages devastated the ogres until it was slain.
entries.translation: 一顶曾属于强大食人魔萨满乌克塔的毛皮帽。里面寄宿着一头极其强壮的熊的灵魂。这头熊生前狂怒肆虐，曾重创食人魔，直到最终被杀死。

entries.english:
A relic of some ancient wizarding war. Centuries later, it still crackles with
effects from the residual hexes and magical energies it was once subjected to
on a daily basis; spellcasters able to get a handle on its power, however, will
find it enhances the power of their spells.
entries.translation: 一场古代巫师战争的遗物。数百年后，当年日复一日承受的妖术和魔法能量仍残留其上，噼啪作响。不过，能掌握其中力量的施法者，会发现自己的法术得到增强。

entries.english:
The sacred weapon of Toth-Mos, first apostle of the god Ashenzari. It grants
the wielder a fraction of Ashenzari's own vision, ensuring that every shot will
land true.
entries.translation: 这是艾申扎利首位使徒托斯莫斯的神圣武器。它让持用者获得艾申扎利自身视野的一小部分，确保每一发都准确命中。

entries.english:
A coat of armour said to have been forged for Queen Kryia in her old age. She
continued to insist on leading her armies from the front even into her dotage,
and as her aging body failed her, this coat helped to enhance the healing
draughts that kept her alive.
entries.translation: 据说，这件链甲是为晚年的克里亚女王打造的。直到老迈昏聩，她仍坚持身先士卒。随着衰老的身体渐渐不支，这件链甲增强了维持她生命的治疗药剂。

entries.english:
This brutal weapon, long thought lost to history, combines the extended reach
of a polearm with the cleaving sharpness of an axe. Ghosts of ancient warriors
linger about it, draining fickle users.
entries.translation: 这件残暴的武器曾长期被认为已湮没于历史，兼具长柄武器的攻击距离与斧头的劈砍锋芒。古代战士的幽灵萦绕其上，会吸取反复换用武器者的生命力。

entries.english:
A suit of armour created by the famous inventor Maxwell, providing unparalleled
protective qualities at a very affordable price. His unorthodox materials left
it with certain shortcomings, but he's yet to have anyone come back for a
refund.
entries.translation:
由著名发明家麦克斯韦制造的一套铠甲，以非常实惠的价格提供无与伦比的防护性能。
他用的非正统材料给它带来了一定的缺陷，但还没有人回来退款。

entries.english:
A suit of armour rumoured to have been created by enchanting the hide of a
now-extinct species of troll. Whether the name rings true or is merely
appropriated to add mystique is something of a mystery. The armour's innate
powers of regeneration and magical protection, however, are hard to dispute.
entries.translation: 据说，这件皮甲由一种现已灭绝的巨魔皮施法制成。其名称究竟确有其事，还是仅为增添神秘色彩，至今仍是个谜。不过，它固有的再生与魔法防护能力确凿无疑。

entries.english:
These sturdy boots were created by an artificer who lived high up on a remote
mountain peak, as protection against the mountain's near-constant avalanches,
rockslides, and snowstorms. No force short of translocations magic will budge
the wearer from their position.
entries.translation: 这双坚固的靴子由一位居住在偏远高峰的魔法工匠制造，用以抵御山间几乎不停的雪崩、落石与暴风雪。除了位移系魔法，任何力量都无法使穿戴者离开原位。

issues.review: context_review:魔法工匠的普通职业，不是玩家背景标签

entries.english:
A necklace made of bloodstained human and animal teeth, and something that
appears to be a piece of spine.
entries.translation: 一条串着沾有血迹的各种人与野兽的牙齿的项链，似乎还有一段被砍下来的脊椎骨。

issues.review: context_review:人、半人或可读性语境，允许中文省略类字

entries.english:
An orb pulsing with unholy energies, granting the power to unleash damnation
when held — although not without draining the wielder's vitality in the
process. It carries with it some of the corrosive malice of the Iron City of
Dis.
entries.translation: 一颗涌动着邪恶能量的宝珠。持有它便能释放天谴，但也会在过程中耗损持用者的生命力。它带着狄斯铁城那腐蚀万物的恶意。

entries.english:
A triple sword made of weird glowing metal. It irradiates those it strikes,
causing a range of unpredictable effects — if they survive the impact of the
blade itself, that is.
entries.translation: 一把由奇异发光金属制成的三重剑。它会辐照受击者，产生种种难以预料的效果——当然，前提是对方先能在剑刃的打击下活下来。

entries.english:
A long black robe made of strange glossy material. It shrouds its wearer in
darkness, reducing the range of vision. According to legend, it was the gift
of Rutra, a renowned demigoddess of the night, to one of her followers.
entries.translation: 一件由奇异光滑材料制成的黑色长袍。它将穿戴者笼罩在黑暗中，缩小视野。传说这是著名的暗夜半女神鲁特拉送给一位追随者的礼物。

entries.english:
Most salamanders' bodies are consigned to the fiery depths from which they
sprang. Rarely, though, salamanders instead preserve the skins of those that
passed. The runes and decorations on this hide suggest it once belonged to a
respected warrior or priest - perhaps even a king. The fiery spirit remains in
the skin, granting its power to the wearer.
entries.translation: 大多数沙罗曼蛇死后，尸体都会被送回它们诞生的火焰深渊。不过，沙罗曼蛇偶尔也会保存逝者的皮。皮上的符文和装饰表明，它曾属于一位受敬重的战士或祭司，甚至可能是一位王者。炽热的灵魂仍留在皮中，将力量赋予穿戴者。

entries.english:
An accursed bone sceptre, created by some unknown hellish power. When used in
combat, it causes agonising pain in all those unfortunate enough to gaze upon
it, save for the wielder.
entries.translation:
一把被诅咒的骨制节杖，由某种未知的地狱力量创造。
在战斗中使用时，它会给所有注视它的不幸者带来极度痛楚，除了持用者。

entries.english: <Singing Sword>
entries.translation: <Singing Sword>

entries.english:
An enchanted pair of boots which grant the ability to take strides of incredible
length, as long as the wearer is advancing bravely towards their foes.
entries.translation: 一双注入了魔法的靴子，只要穿着它勇敢地朝敌人前进，就可以迈出难以置信的步伐。

entries.english:
A bronze shield, looking almost exactly like a tortoise's shell. It was built
by the adherents of an obscure minor faith, who imbued it with the power of
their god. As the god is said to, this shield protects against sword and sling,
frost and flame.
entries.translation: 一面形状几乎与龟壳完全相同的青铜盾。一个鲜为人知的小教派打造了它，并灌注了所信神祇的力量。据说那位神能抵御刀剑与投石、寒霜与烈焰，而这面盾也能如此。

entries.english:
A heavy bronze gong that can be worn as a shield. Locked away in a temple for
many years, its bearer is shielded by decades of accumulated prayer.
entries.translation:
一个沉重的铜锣，可当盾牌用。
它被锁在寺庙里多年，它的持用者将承载着几十年积累的祈祷的庇佑。

entries.english:
The skull of a legendary necromancer, seemingly parted from the rest of its
body. When held, it seems disinclined to explain the precise circumstances of
its ending up in this state, but offers no objection to others siphoning what
considerable necromantic power still remains in its ancient bones.
entries.translation: 一位传奇死灵法师的头骨，似乎已与身体其余部分分离。被人持有时，它好像不愿详述自己为何落得这般境地，却不反对别人汲取其古老骨骸中依然可观的死灵力量。

entries.english:
A dark and malign artefact. It increases the potency of hexes cast by anyone
unwise enough to risk wielding it.
entries.translation: 一把黑暗、邪恶的神器。它能强化那些不理智的要持握它的人施放妖术。

entries.english:
A sacred relic of the Monks of St. Lee, followers of the renunciate archmage. Just
as St. Lee sought to atone for the destruction his spells wrought by protecting
others, so his staff protects its wielder.
entries.translation: 隐修大法师圣李的追随者——圣李僧团——的一件圣物。圣李通过保护他人，为自己的法术造成的破坏赎罪；同样，这根棍杖也保护着持用者。

entries.english: <Singing Sword>
entries.translation: <Singing Sword>

entries.english:
A bloodstained axe that was the favourite weapon of the old god Trog, before it
was lost. It induces a bloodthirsty berserker rage when used in battle, although
mere mortals who wield it will find themselves temporarily overwhelmed by Trog's
power.
entries.translation: 这把血迹斑斑的斧头在遗失之前，曾是古神特洛戈最爱的武器。在战斗中使用它会引发嗜血的狂暴，而持用它的凡人也会暂时被特洛戈的力量压倒。

issues.review: context_review:狂暴效果或动作，不要求重复狂战士前缀
